chunks.title: Session 2024-10-10: Welcome to Saltmarsh -- Episode One - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-10: Welcome to Saltmarsh -- Episode One - summary
The party rode into Saltmarsh on Edward's wagon, passing the bright Silverstand and the ominous Dreadwood. Gellen hired them at generous pay to watch the Reeking House for two weeks without entering. In town they met the halfling trader Winnie, who hinted at crime and doubts about the silver mine. At the Reeking House they killed four weasels from a burrow under a giant rosebush and then heard a wooden thudding.

chunks.title: Session 2024-10-24: The Cliff Watch -- Episode 2 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-10-24: The Cliff Watch -- Episode 2 - The Cliff Watch -- Episode Two - summary
The party kept watch at the Reeking House and tracked the thudding sound. Cuckoo, Istyl and Islinel scouted the weasel den and giant snake tracks, then entered the house and rescued Ned, a bound prisoner from Seaton. Ned was sent to Winnie and Gellen, who hired him as a guard. Over ten days the party turned back some travelers, found that two giant snakes with young nest in the well, and decided not to risk it. At the end they saw a four-man rowboat head out to sea and return laden with cargo under the cliffs.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-02: The Reeking House -- Episode 3 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-02: The Reeking House -- Episode 3 - The Reeking House - Episode 3 - summary
The party, accompanied by Ned, entered the Reeking House through the Snake Garden and explored the library and study, where Snarky was poisoned by yellow mold and a double-sized healing potion was found. They discovered a hidden trapdoor leading to a cellar used as bandit living quarters and fought the bandits there. In a well-furnished room they killed the wizard Sanbalet and the Bandit Scout, but Ned betrayed them with a hand crossbow and fled through a hidden door, warning his confederates. Islinel was left unconscious but stable, and a door marked 'DANGER!!!' remains unexplored.

chunks.title: Session 2024-11-22: The Reeking House (part 2) -- Episode 4 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-11-22: The Reeking House (part 2) -- Episode 4 - The Reeking House (part 2)--Episode 4 - summary
The party finished searching the wizard's room, taking a spellbook, books, coins and an oilskin coat. While resting at their guard post, they saw an overladen jolly boat and Snarky followed it to Gellen's mansion, where cargo was unloaded. Cuckoo and Abbigael spoke with Captain Fireborn and Lady Oweland, and the party met with Gellen, who seemed evasive and paid them 125 gp. Back in the Reeking House, a scream deterred them from the cellar stairs, and they fought a spider swarm upstairs, where Islinel was knocked out and stabilized.

chunks.title: Session 2024-12-05: The End of the Reeking House (part 3) -- Episode 5 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2024-12-05: The End of the Reeking House (part 3) -- Episode 5 - The End of the Reeking House (part 4)--Episode 5 - summary
The party explored the upper floor of the Reeking House and found a fireburst mushroom in the fireplace. Islinel broke a jar of green slime onto it, starting a fire, and the party fled by window and rope while Snarky insisted on checking the basement. Below, they fought metal-plated skeletons and a acid-throwing skelalchemist, who dropped Snarky until he was revived. After looting, they escaped through caverns to a smugglers' rowboat while the burning house was visible from Saltmarsh.

chunks.title: Session 2025-01-30: A Giant Crab and a Vampire Walk into a Bar -- Episode 6 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-01-30: A Giant Crab and a Vampire Walk into a Bar -- Episode 6 - Back to Saltmarsh--Episode 6 - summary
The party explored an abandoned house at Crabber's Cove and fought a giant crab living beneath it, which Snarky killed with his shortbow. In a hidden basement they opened a coffin and met the vampire Xolec, who offered information on the Scarlet Brotherhood in exchange for silence and freedom; the party held off on freeing him. At the Snapping Line Inn they had the crab cooked, told Fireborn and Oweland about the jollyboat delivery to Gellen's house, and received 500 gold plus offers of 500 and 1000 more for the smuggling ship. They learned of the traditionalist and loyalist split and lizardfolk rumors, then took a long rest.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-23: A Four Hour Tour of Saltmarsh -- Episode 7 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-23: A Four Hour Tour of Saltmarsh -- Episode 7 - A Four Hour Saltmarsh Tour--Episode 7 - summary
The party spent downtime at the Snapping Line Inn studying books on the Dreadwood, languages and the almanac until news of the Witchlight Carnival arrived. At the Weekly Market they met Sella, who warned of shark-like fiendish creatures in the Hool Marshes, and the suspicious Jade, and Snarky bought a self-mending rope and smart hook. At Winnie's shop they sold gear, learned of weapons smuggled to the lizardfolk and examined a Cursed Luck Stone and a Pipe of Remembrance, while Islinel was rudely turned away by the wizard Keledek. Using the almanac, the party took position at the cliff ruins and spotted signal lights from an offshore ship, intercepting a coded message about a shipment.

chunks.title: Session 2025-02-27: Misadventures on the Sea Ghost (Coast to Coast) -- Episode 8 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-02-27: Misadventures on the Sea Ghost (Coast to Coast) -- Episode 8 - Misadventures on the Sea Ghost (Coast to Coast)--Episode 8 - summary
The party approached the smuggling ship Sea Ghost in a borrowed jollyboat, using the code sheet to pose as smugglers sent by Gellen Primewater. Captain Snake Eyes grew suspicious and ordered them off, and a fight broke out in which Abbigael was dropped by a crossbow bolt. The party retreated without casualties, with Cuckoo carrying Abbigael to the jollyboat. Back in Saltmarsh, Eda Oweland paid 500 gold for identifying the ship and discussed weapons smuggled to the lizardfolk and the 'devil men from the sea', and the party heard rumors about Keledek.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-14: The Carnivals in Town -- Episode 9 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-14: The Carnivals in Town -- Episode 9 - The Carnival's in Town--Episode 9 - summary
The party spent downtime in Saltmarsh, then investigated the Reeking House ruins, where well snakes bit Islinel unconscious until Abbigael frightened them off with Thaumaturgy. They discussed using the underground lair as a hideout, spoke with Sella about lizardfolk weapons needs, and at Winnie's shop Snarky received a warning message about a kender and Olin's release. At the Snapping Line, Abbigael revealed her three-headed dog. The party then entered the Witchlight Carnival through deals with a goblin ticket taker and had first encounters with Dirlagraun, Vero, a treant and the button monkey.

chunks.title: Session 2025-03-27: Punkin' Patch Punking -- Episode 10 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-03-27: Punkin' Patch Punking -- Episode 10 - Punkin' Patch Punking--Episode 10 - summary
At the Witchlight Carnival the party read a pumpkin contest notice, met the fairy dragon Pifflewiff, and watched pixie chariot races in the Big Top. Istyl restored the carousel unicorns' names, learning about the Hourglass Coven's takeover of Prismere and the items needed for a quest. At Matty's pumpkin farm they fought blights, and Matty revealed that his patron Zybilna is missing and that each party member had been helped by her. They received a wand and a contest pumpkin, and Cuckoo returned a lost child and earned Star's mirrored ball from Dirlagraun.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-10: Swans, Swoons & Secrets -- Episode 11 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-10: Swans, Swoons & Secrets -- Episode 11 - Swans, Swoons, & Secrets--Episode 11 - summary
The party won the Witchlight Carnival pumpkin contest by rolling their giant pumpkin, earning prizes including pixie dust and magic face paint. They rescued a dwarf on the dragonfly rides, took a swan gondola ride, and captured the kenku warlock Kettlesteam, who serves Zybilna. They restored Candlefoot's voice and reunited him with Palasha, and Cuckoo reunited Reuben with Wean in the Hall of Illusions. During the extravaganza, Snarky stole Mr. Witch's pocket watch under cover of the party's performances.

chunks.title: Session 2025-04-24: Monarchs and Mirrors -- Episode 12 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-04-24: Monarchs and Mirrors -- Episode 12 - Monarchs and Mirrors--Episode 12 - summary
Snarky examined Mr. Witch's stolen watch, then the party met the carnival masters. Cuckoo implied they had the watch, and the masters explained the three rules of Prismere. After shopping at Winnie's, the party fought bullywugs and a giant toad in a misty swamp. Istyl won a fairy cake contest and was crowned Witchlight Monarch. The party then entered Prismere through the Hall of Illusions, where Islinel became a bullywug and the party met bipedal rabbits and a giant snail.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-19: Exploring Hither -- Episode 13 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-19: Exploring Hither -- Episode 13 - Exploring Hither--Episode 13 - summary
In Prismere the party faced down harengon brigands by intimidation, then found Sir Talavar, a fairy dragon knight caged atop a leaning tower. They killed two giant snakes, and Abbigael had a long run of wild magic surges. At Telami Hill they traded the Reeking House iron key to Jingle Jangle for the silver key that freed Sir Talavar, and rested in her cave. Sir Talavar explained the hag coven's takeover and gave them a map and +1 dagger. Heading north toward Downfall, they met a walking inn.

chunks.title: Session 2025-06-26: Gwab dat Wabbit! -- Episode 14 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-06-26: Gwab dat Wabbit! -- Episode 14 - summary
The party was welcomed by Sue Harbacks at the walking Inn at the End of the Road, where they ate pie and learned about Bavlorna and the mists. They found a vision stream showing disturbing scenes of Bavlorna's domain, then were ambushed by Agdon Longscarf on the causeways. Istyl's Celestial Revelation frightened Agdon into returning stolen goods and sharing intelligence, including that Bavlorna's cauldron is in the Soggy Court. Snarky claimed an abandoned skiff past animated armor, and the party rowed into Downfall, where bullywug guards greeted them.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-17: Soggy Court and Downfall -- Episode 15 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-17: Soggy Court and Downfall -- Episode 15 - summary
The party was welcomed at Downfall by bullywugs, then killed two Merrows on the stepping stones with the help of a talking rock named Grompi. They put out six animated coals in the balloon factory and were rewarded with brass pilot wings by the Duke. They met Clapperclaw, learned gossip from the chattering heads, and King Gullop XIX offered them Soggy Court membership in exchange for returning Bavlorna's Big Book of Bad Blood. After being fitted for court attire and meeting the Darkling merchants, who had sold an alicorn to someone in Yon, they entered Bavlorna's cottage and Abbigael's detect magic revealed magical objects as frogs swarmed outside.

chunks.title: Session 2025-07-24: Downfall Discoveries -- Episode 16 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-07-24: Downfall Discoveries -- Episode 16 - summary
The party explored Bavlorna's cottage, opening her hourglass cabinet, passing the emotion-stripping mirror and shrinking hallway, and spying on Bavlorna having tea with the shadowless darkling Charm. They captured Lornlings for the mirror password to the Witchlight Carnival and helped the redcap Cooky, who freed the satyr Vansel, whom they sent to safety. Meeting Bavlorna, they learned she holds Istyl's sense of direction legitimately and will only negotiate after they fix her pool, return her Book of Bad Blood and bring a crate of blue items. Istyl noticed Charm glancing upstairs as the party left to plan.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-07: Square Cube in a Round Well -- Episode 17 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-07: Square Cube in a Round Well -- Episode 17 - summary
The party fixed Bavlorna's clogged well by baiting out and destroying a gelatinous cube with Cookie's help. They saw Charm's shadow return from upstairs and deduced she stole something from Bavlorna. After King Gullop sent knights to watch them, they tricked the knights with a deception. Searching south for the hunter's crate, they found Illig, who took them for co-conspirators and declared himself future king.

chunks.title: Session 2025-08-21: Rebels and Revelations -- Episode 18 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-08-21: Rebels and Revelations -- Episode 18 - Episode 18 -- Rebels and Revelations - summary
The party backed Baron Illig's plot, and he killed King Gullop with a staged stumble and crowned himself King Illig the First. They freed the pilot Morgort, delivered the crate and Book of Bad Blood to Bavlorna, and bought back Clapperclaw's deer skull head from Agdon Longscarf. Bavlorna removed Abbigael's luckstone curse, restored Istyl's sense of direction and revealed where Cuckoo's parents, Hurly and the displacer cub are. In return the party must steal Skabitha's portrait within eight days. They reached fourth level and prepared to leave Hither by balloon.

chunks.title: Session 2025-09-18: Onward to Thither -- Episode 19 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-09-18: Onward to Thither -- Episode 19 - Episode 19 -- Onward to Thither! - summary
The party flew by balloon with Morgort and Clapperclaw from Hither into Thither and found wanted posters for Will of the Feywild. They calmed an angry sycamore dryad and received three seeds, danced with fairy ring mushrooms, and met the cursed Nib, who gave gifts and information on Granny Nightshade. At the Grandfather Tree they met the satyr Lirian, who may be Cuckoo's father, and killed three red caps disguised as goats before the pixies celebrated. They then found an owlbear-yoked chariot with huge draconic tracks as the owlbear began to approach.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-16: Owlbears & Unicorns & Blink Dogs Oh My -- Episode 20 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-16: Owlbears & Unicorns & Blink Dogs Oh My -- Episode 20 - Owlbears & Unicorns & Blink Dogs, Oh My! -- Episode 20 - summary
The party received magical gifts from Nib, then tamed an abandoned chariot's owlbear, Juniper, with food and her name. They met Winterbow, found Will, the children and Star at Little Oak, and borrowed the swimming horse costume to reach the Wayward Pool. There they lit the signal fire and learned from the unicorn Lamorna about Zybilna's imprisonment, the alicorn, Amidor in Yon and the Jabberwock. An orc assassin named Zarak attacked Lamorna and escaped into the border mists; the party then planned their Loomlurch mission from Will's map and rested by the lake.

chunks.title: Session 2025-10-30: Oh Shite! A Feckin' Dragon -- Episode 21 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-10-30: Oh Shite! A Feckin' Dragon -- Episode 21 - Oh Shite, 'Tis a Dragon! -- Episode 21 - summary
The party planned their heist for Bavlorna's painting and pressed Will, who revealed he was once a larger evil being who captured children for Granny Nightshade before being cursed. They scouted the Loomlurch goblin market, learned of Mishka's captivity from Chucklehead, and bought magical candy for the children at Little Oak. When Granny was seen flying away, the party used the Getaway Gang to trigger the scarecrows and entered the portrait gallery. They chose to rescue Mishka first and killed a green dragon wyrmling in the kitchen, which warned that the Emerald Whisperer will destroy them.

chunks.title: Session 2025-11-13: Well, We're in the Shite Now! -- Episode 22 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-11-13: Well, We're in the Shite Now! -- Episode 22 - summary
In Granny Nightshade's kitchen the party freed Mishka and the dwarf James Elkhorn, and took the shifting portraits, which now showed Cuckoo's family. They destroyed the clockwork tin soldiers and waddling drum in the toy room. In the workshop they met Nal, who had a key impression in soap, and Elkhorn stayed to forge a key. In the sewing room they killed an animated doll and carpet and freed Roff and Wendell, then heard the hag return.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-06: From Thither to Yon -- Episode 23 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-06: From Thither to Yon -- Episode 23 - summary
The party fled Loomlurch after Skabitha discovered the stolen portraits, escaping through the workshop door and the screaming scarecrow garden. They learned the portraits now show Cuckoo's family, rested at the Wayward Pool, and were cursed by Bavlorna before being cleansed in the pool. Lyrian identified Thistlebell, and Squirt guided the party to Yon, where they met Amidor and Gleam and heard prophecies from three goats. The session ended with the giant Mudlump confronting them.

chunks.title: Session 2025-12-11: His Excellency, Ambassador Cuckoo -- Episode 24 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2025-12-11: His Excellency, Ambassador Cuckoo -- Episode 24 - summary
In Yon the party fought and knocked out the beekeeper cyclops Mudlump after fire enraged him, then took hidden treasure from his home. At Lochbury Henge Abbigael won a Heaven and Hell game, meeting the Korreds, who gave her a lucky star sapphire and danced with Cuckoo and Istyl. A pageant wagon offered tickets to an audience with Endelyn Moongrave, and in the Brigganock mine the party met Molliver, Elkhorn's old Valor's Call companion. Cuckoo brokered peace between the Korreds and Brigganock, who pledged help in Motherhorn.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-08: Crossing Yon -- Episode 25 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-08: Crossing Yon -- Episode 25 - summary
Traveling north across Yon, Abbigael sat on Mazalkoth's throne, gained a fragment of his psyche and chose expertise in Insight. The party freed the goblin child Fina from a cursed kite with music, then helped Prince Allagarthus light the eight beacons by entertaining the winged actors. They received the alicorn, identified it, and rested at Fina's cave. They then chose the Brigganock secret passage into Motherhorn, fought three flaming skulls crossing Ribbon Wish Chasm, and met Obud.

chunks.title: Session 2026-01-22: Into the Motherhorn -- Episode 26 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-01-22: Into the Motherhorn -- Episode 26 - summary
After crossing the chasm, the party met Obud, rested in his grotto and learned of Creeping Lyn's deals and foresight before taking his secret tunnel for eight hours to Motherhorn. They freed the marionette Breakaleg, who shared secrets, then broke into the goblin workshop where Charmay (Skylla) animated props, was wounded by Istyl and teleported away. After destroying the props they freed the brigganock Golmo and restored his soul, receiving a map of Motherhorn and intel from the stagehands. They took the chain lift up and heard calls for a green dragon.

chunks.title: Session 2026-02-19: Evil Lynn Meets Her End -- Episode 27 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-02-19: Evil Lynn Meets Her End -- Episode 27 - Creeping Lyn Meets Her End--Episode 27 - summary
The party planned for Endelyn Moongrave, slipped into her library, and Cuckoo secretly took an invisible parchment about Iggwilv. They got past the talking door, freed Glister and reunited her with Gleam, then were ambushed by Endelyn at the orrery. After Cuckoo fell, Gleam and Glister cast an eclipse and Abbigael's thunder orb killed Endelyn. The party then freed Hurley and Finneas's parents, met a retired Skabitha, and Charm offered to take them toward the Palace of Heart's Desire.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-05: Looting the Motherhorn -- Episode 28 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-05: Looting the Motherhorn -- Episode 28 - Episode 28--Looting the Motherhorn - summary
GMAssistant's recap of Episode 28, "Looting the Motherhorn" (subtitled "Wherein Our Heroes Collect Their Due"), is very thin. It only records that several folks are waiting to speak with Zybilna, told to wait by someone claiming to be the butler while treats are provided. The waiting petitioners include a farmer with a pumpkin, a headless dwarf, a statue that wants to be a real boy, an awakened bear, an Eberron noble, and badger minstrels. A female orc and a halfling were also caught in the time freeze. No party actions or loot are recorded.

chunks.title: Session 2026-03-19: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Part One) -- Episode 29 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-03-19: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Part One) -- Episode 29 - Palace of Heart's Delight (part 1)-- Episode 29 - summary
In the Palace of Heart's Desire pavilion, the party received a Chime of Opening from Sir Talivar and met the guests waiting for the Fae Queen. They spoke with the iron guardian Envy, took the Woodcutter's Axe, and fled the Ettercaps of the Rose Garden after Abbigael's hypnotic pattern. Istyl took the silver crown from Maiden's Pond, the party solved the riddle WRATH, and after Cuckoo's berry gift Wrath was crowned, unlocking the main doors. They explored the starry corridor and turrets and rested for the night.

chunks.title: Session 2026-04-16: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Part Two) -- Episode 30 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-04-16: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Part Two) -- Episode 30 - Palace of Hearts Desire (part 2)--Episode 30 - summary
Exploring the Palace of Heart's Desire, the party found a crystal carriage and key, survived the rug in the Room of White Roses, and used magical hooks to turn invisible. They saw the Jabberwock coiled around the cauldron in the frozen ballroom with Zybilna and Mercion, and Cuckoo's naming attempts failed and woke the beast. They collected three gem coffers and found Thinnings, who revealed the League of Malevolence, Snickersnack's location and the gems' role as Zybilna's anchors. The session ended at a library where a ghostly Zybilna offered a meeting.

chunks.title: Session 2026-05-14: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Part Three) -- Episode 31 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-05-14: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Part Three) -- Episode 31 - The Palace of Heart's Desire (part 3)--Episode 31 - summary
The party woke from a brief astral trip to the Infinite Archive knowing how to free Zybilna. They returned the black, white and green memory gems to their coffers, then Abbigael freed Strongheart from midair with the alicorn and a rope. Flying Zybilna's crystal carriage to the central tower, they fought Keledek, Warduke and glass golems. Istyl took over the golems via the throne, Strongheart revivified Warduke, and the prisoners were bound. Cuckoo and Istyl claimed the League's magic items.

chunks.title: Session 2026-05-28: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Finale) -- Episode 32 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-05-28: The Palace of Heart's Desire (Finale) -- Episode 32 - The Palace of Heart's Desire (Finale)--Episode 32 - summary
The party found Snickersnack in a prismatic vault and Istyl attuned to it. In the grand ballroom, Abbigael used Misty Step and the unicorn horn to speak Zybilna's true name, freeing her; Zybilna dismissed the Jabberwock and restored time to the palace. Zybilna granted wishes, shared revelations about the Hourglass Coven, a name impersonator and Istyl's family, and became Istyl's patron. The party bound Zargash for Valor's Call, then restored the unicorn Eladon in Thither.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-11: Moving On -- Episode 33 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-11: Moving On -- Episode 33 - Moving On--Episode 33 - summary
In Loomlurch, Istyl's magical portraits revealed her mother Uzsumei Nyota has ascended to a celestial in the Court of Tyr. Zybilna rewarded the party at her palace, giving Abbigael a magical doorknob, Snarky a ring of evasion, and Istyl the Eyes of the Fey Queen. Back at the Witchlight Carnival they delivered news to Burley, learned from the carousel unicorns where the hags fled, and sent Abbigael's hellhound home with a letter. Matty gave them a chest of gear and favor letters, and a courier then delivered an urgent summons from the Saltmarsh council.

chunks.title: Session 2026-06-25: A New Threat -- Episode 34 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-06-25: A New Threat -- Episode 34 - A New Threat--Episode 34 - summary
The party returned to Saltmarsh and learned from Sella and Winnie that the lizardfolk are allied with the town against the Sahuagin and that Gellen Primewater was arrested. Cuckoo dreamed of Zybilna revealing Second Grin in the Vault of Valdush. At the council they accepted an exclusive 5,000 gold contract to scout the Sunken Isle and bought aquatic gear. Suspicious of Seaton, they traveled there and began gathering rumors at the Vulgar Kraken.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-09: A Short Walk Off the Long Jetty -- Episode 35 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-09: A Short Walk Off the Long Jetty -- Episode 35 - A Short Walk Off the Long Jetty--Episode 35 - summary
In Seaton the party split up at the Vulgar Kraken. Abbigael contracted the halfling Dendar Cobb for his soul, while Cuckoo and Istyl heard from Tuna about prisoners barged away from the long jetty. Snarky overheard Mother Finch's suspicions. At the Rusty Cutlass and the militia headquarters they learned of corrupt magistrates, and Captain Thrace secretly summoned Istyl to a midnight meeting. The party reached level seven.

chunks.title: Session 2026-07-23: Night Swimming -- Episode 36 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-07-23: Night Swimming -- Episode 36 - Night Swimming--Episode 36 - summary
The party learned at the Temple of Poseidon that High Priestess Myrva's teachings had shifted since she returned from the sea. Captain Thrace met them secretly, named corrupt officials, revealed his changeling spy and proposed infiltrating the Sunken Isle by barge. After consulting the Saltmarsh War Council and resupplying, Istyl's true sight exposed Myrva as a Kraken Priestess and Deep Scions throughout Seaton. The party slipped into the harbor and clung to the hull of the prison barge as it sped toward the Sunken Isle.

chunks.title: Session 2026-08-06: Sneakin! -- Episode 37 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-08-06: Sneakin! -- Episode 37 - Sneakin'!--Episode 37 - summary
The party clung to the underside of a prison barge to reach the Sunken Isle, then slipped to the sandbar after it left. Disguised as Sahuagin, with Istyl as a prisoner, they bluffed past a guardroom, explored the armory, storerooms and a grim meat locker, and fled the Sahuagin champion after Snarky was spotted. Abbigael dispelled a glyph on a secret door, and the party looted a vault holding mithral plate, a Cloak of the Manta Ray and a dozen potions of water breathing. They used Abbigael's doorknob to reach the Palace of Heart's Desire, turned invisible, and returned to sneak past the guards and descend into the flooded levels in search of Sekkerin.

chunks.title: Session 2026-08-20: Moar Sneakin! -- Episode 38 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-08-20: Moar Sneakin! -- Episode 38 - Moar Sneakin!!! (part 2)--Episode 38 - summary
The invisible party descended into the flooded levels of the Sunken Isle. Cuckoo's charm placed Second Grin deep below and to the east. They scouted barracks, an address hall with a wave shaper, a temple where hatchlings were sacrificed to a two-headed shark, and an arena. Snarky looted a coffer. They freed a telepathic lobster named Shern, who revealed a secret prison entrance, and returned to the Palace of Heart's Desire via the doorknob.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-03: Assault on the Sinking Spire -- Episode 39 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-03: Assault on the Sinking Spire -- Episode 39 - Assault on the Sinking Spire--Episode 39 - summary
The party returned from the Feywild to Saltmarsh by lighting the beacons in Yon, bringing Shern. They reported to the council, learned a young Kraken is behind the Deep Scions, and received 5,000 gold, citizenship, a manor and Keledek's loaned potions. Disguised as Sahuagin with Cuckoo as their prisoner, they bluffed through the Sunken Isle gate and then wiped out the gatehouse guards in under thirty seconds. The Saltmarsh militia poured in behind them, and the party turned to the levels below.

chunks.title: Session 2026-09-17: Decapitation Strike -- Episode 40 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-09-17: Decapitation Strike -- Episode 40 - Decapitation Strike--Episode 40 - summary
After opening the outer gate for Saltmarsh's forces, the party rested briefly and decided to assassinate the Sahuagin Baron. They used Gaseous Form potions and the palace wardrobe to become invisible, then followed Shern's directions to a huge feast hall. Abbigael banished the Baron to an extraplanar prison and the party slew most of his guards in a fierce fight that left Cuckoo severely wounded. The Baron's mate then entered, screaming for those who removed him.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-01: By the Skin of Their Teeth -- Episode 41 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-01: By the Skin of Their Teeth -- Episode 41 - By the Skin of Their Teeth--Episode 41 - summary
The party fought the enraged Sahuagin Baroness while a wave shaper's whirlpool threatened them. Abbigael opened the magical door to the red bedroom, and Cuckoo turned the Baroness's blow against her. Istyl killed her with a psychic explosion as she teleported through the door, and the party escaped and sealed it. The Saltmarsh council rewarded them with gold, magic items, free ship passage and the Primewater Estate.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Summary
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - The Grabber Eater and the Rock Lobsters - summary
Back in Primewater Manor in Saltmarsh, the party sorted out attunement slots, found that Seaton was too far for the silver raven to reach, and learned they now hold renown 3 in Saltmarsh. They took a fishing boat out, and Shern guided them to the sealed undersea entrance of the Vault of Valdush. A giant squid burst out of the vault and nearly killed Istyl before the party brought it down. Inside, Abbigael's light woke two rock-disguised lobstrosities, one of which Cuckoo killed. As the party reached a locked puzzle door with five star-shaped sockets, giant lightning eels drawn by Abbigael's lightning closed in.
Cliffhanger: The party is in a flooded chamber of the Vault of Valdush, beside a locked five-star puzzle door, as giant lightning eels slither in from several passages and the second lobstrosity is still alive.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Sorting Out Attunement
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 1: Sorting Out Attunement
- The party discussed who should attune to the Wand of Web and the Trident of Fish Command.
- Istyl took off her hat of disguise to attune to the Trident for the underwater trip.
- The Wand of Web stayed in the bag of holding, since attuning would take an hour regardless.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Rest in Primewater Manor
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 2: Rest in Primewater Manor
- Cuckoo told Shern the Baroness was dead, the Baron was still out there, and the Sahuagin were scattered.
- Kyle explained the stronghold was shattered and its leadership killed, so the stragglers were no longer an organized threat.
- The party worked out that Seaton was too far away for the silver raven's message.
- Kyle ruled that the party has renown 3 in Saltmarsh.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Shopping and Heading Out
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 3: Shopping and Heading Out
- Shern agreed to lead the party to the vault, though he might not be able to get in himself.
- Istyl bought a potion of greater healing.
- The party caught a fishing boat east and asked the captain to go a bit south.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - The Sealed Archway
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 4: The Sealed Archway
- Cuckoo carried Shern down in the sea and Shern spotted the vault entrance.
- A rune-marked stone archway was sealed by a 10-foot boulder covered in crater-like marks.
- They discovered a box of 12 water breathing potions in a secret room, so Cuckoo got back his 1,600 gold.
- Kyle ruled it was not a full-grown Kraken, though one may still be at work in the region.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - A Talkative Fish
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 5: A Talkative Fish
- Istyl charmed a local fish with the Trident, and it told her about the big grabber eater inside.
- The fish warned that the grabber eater was coming and fled.
- A jet of water blasted the boulder away and a giant squid shot out of the doorway.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Battle with the Giant Squid
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 6: Battle with the Giant Squid
- Istyl's dominate beast failed to take hold of the squid.
- The squid crushed Istyl for 18 and bit her for 36, and she escaped with Misty Step.
- Snarky spent a luck point to shoot it and hit for 23.
- Abbigael bound it in ice for 26 cold damage.
- Snarky shot it in the eye for 28 damage.
- Abbigael's lightning orb for 22 left it badly hurt, and it inked the area.
- Cuckoo's elemental burst killed the squid, and local fish began to eat it.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Short Rest
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 7: Short Rest
- The party took a ten-minute break and then a short rest back on the ship.
- Cuckoo fixed his staff of striking on his sheet.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Inside the Vault
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 8: Inside the Vault
- The little fish had rolled the stone back into place.
- The party swam through a lightly modified undersea cave running north.
- Abbigael's light on Cuckoo's staff revealed two rock formations that turned out to be lobstrosities.
- Cuckoo resisted a lobstrosity's grapple and paralytic tentacles.
- Abbigael's chromatic orb bounced between the lobstrosities.
- Snarky's shot bloodied one lobstrosity.
- Cuckoo killed that lobstrosity.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - The Locked Door and the Eels
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - scene 9: The Locked Door and the Eels
- The party found a flooded, ruined study and a stone door.
- Snarky found the door was a magical puzzle lock with five star-shaped sockets.
- Giant lightning eels arrived, signaling each other with flashes.
- Kyle said the eels respond specifically to lightning.

chunks.title: Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - Memorable Quotes
chunks.text:
Session 2026-10-29: What, No Calamari? -- Episode 42 - memorable quotes
- "You have me at free and awesome. Sold." - Abbigael (Sher)
- "I want a t shirt that says we kicked Sahuagin ass." - Snarky (Dave)
- "Hey, Winnie. Got any items of Kraken Slaying?" - Cuckoo (Mark)
- "Please don't eat me. I don't know what lies are. I'm a fish, so I believe you." - GM (Kyle)
- "a lot of red in the mist as you leave." - GM (Kyle)
- "That's the rock lobster." - Istyl (Steph)
- "follow me if you wanna live, and I'll swim over here." - Cuckoo (Mark)
- "I scream out friend and start beating on the door." - Snarky (Dave)

chunks.title: Edward

Location: Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: friendly

- (2024-10-10) Edward warned that the Dreadwood will kill you and then do something worse.

chunks.title: Gellen
chunks.text:
NPC: Gellen (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Gellen Primewater, Gellin
Role: former town councilman, smuggling ringleader
Location: Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: suspicious; seemed to be hiding something
Faction: Traditionalist
Status: alive, arrested awaiting trial
- (2024-10-10) Cuckoo sensed Gellen was putting on a show when greeting Edward.
- (2024-10-10) Abbigael noticed the price Gellen pays Edward is double the normal price for such goods and became suspicious.
- (2024-10-10) Gellen hired the party to watch the Reeking House for two weeks and keep the unwary from harm, wanting no one to go inside so as not to attract attention.
- (2024-10-10) Gellen offered 5 gp per day per person, an extraordinary amount, and paid a platinum piece up front for the first two days.
- (2024-10-10) Gellen said he liked Snarky after Snarky's joke about keeping secrets.
- (2024-10-10) Gellen suggested the weekly market for Holy Water and healing potions.
- (2024-10-24) Gellen hired Ned to help out on guard after Ned found him.
- (2024-11-22) Snarky followed the overladen jolly boat to Gellen Primewater's mansion and saw suspicious cargo being unloaded.
- (2024-11-22) Gellen discussed the potential smuggling operation near the Reeking House with the party and seemed to be concealing information.
- (2024-11-22) Gellen was eager for the party to depart.
- (2024-11-22) Gellen paid the party 125 gp, which they suspected was more of a bribe.
- (2024-11-22) Gellen is aware of the smuggling operation and offered a reward to shut it down.

chunks.title: Gellen (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Gellen (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-01-30) The party told Fireborn and Oweland they saw a jollyboat of contraband delivered to Gellen's house.
- (2025-02-27) Captain Snake Eyes of the Sea Ghost sent word that Gellen Primewater should send someone he knows next time, implying Gellen is connected to the smugglers.
- (2025-02-27) The party falsely claimed to the Sea Ghost crew that Gellen Primewater had sent them.
- (2026-06-25) Gellen Primewater was arrested as ringleader of the weapon smuggling ring and awaits trial, leaving the council with four members.

chunks.title: Winston
chunks.text:
NPC: Winston (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: halfling shopkeeper and fence in Saltmarsh
Location: Winnie's shop, Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2024-10-10) Snarky spotted Winnie exchanging information in Thieves Cant: "Six guards, twice usual." / "Then wait."
- (2024-10-10) Winnie claimed her shop is legitimate and that she buys as well as sells; Cuckoo knew this was an outright lie.
- (2024-10-10) Winnie offered information about the Hool Marshes from her adventuring days.
- (2024-10-10) Winnie doubts the silver mine is real and does not know what the soldiers are for.
- (2024-10-10) Winnie told Snarky in Cant that the Reeking House is a center of unsanctioned criminal activity and offered him discounted information.
- (2024-10-10) Cuckoo bought a vial of Holy Water from Winnie.
- (2024-10-24) Cuckoo wrote Winnie a note introducing Ned, since Ned's skills seemed to match her profession.
- (2025-01-30) Winnie is possibly allied with the smugglers and certainly knows Thieves' Cant sign language.
- (2025-02-23) Winnie told the party that weapons are being smuggled to the lizardfolk.
- (2025-02-23) Winnie discussed tensions between loyalists and traditionalists with the party.
- (2025-02-23) Winnie kept suspicious non-magical scrolls in the secure back room that were maps of the Hool Marshes from her adventuring days.
- (2025-02-23) The party sold gear to Winnie and discussed a possible philosopher's stone scam.

chunks.title: Winston (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Winston (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-03-14) Winnie passed Snarky a secret message in a sealed letter warning of a kender's reported arrival in Saltmarsh and Olin's release from prison.
- (2025-03-14) The party asked Winnie about water breathing potions and alter self scrolls, priced at 200 gold each, which was prohibitive.
- (2025-03-14) Snarky paid Winnie to watch for newcomers.
- (2025-03-14) Some party members bought healing potions from Winnie.
- (2026-06-25) Winnie told the party the Lizardfolk Queen visited the council, the weapon smuggling ring collapsed after Gellen Primewater's arrest, and lizardfolk can now buy weapons openly.
- (2026-06-25) Winnie said adventurers lured by a bounty to scout the Sunken Isle were buying water gear and not returning.
- (2026-06-25) Winnie exchanged Thieves' Guild hand signals with Snarky and signaled she had been collecting dead money from overconfident adventurers.
- (2026-06-25) Winnie bought the party's Quiver of Ehlonna for 400 gold.
- (2026-06-25) Winnie sold the party caps of water breathing and rings of swimming but could not source a cloak of the manta ray.
- (2026-07-23) Winnie provided hats of disguise and potions of water breathing on loan against the party's promised reward.
- (2026-07-23) Cuckoo traded the cap of water breathing back for potions.
- (2026-09-03) The party bought healing potions and a scroll of tongues for 300 gold from Winnie before the assault.

chunks.title: Keledek
chunks.text:
NPC: Keledek (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-10-29)
Role: wizard aiding the Saltmarsh council
Location: Saltmarsh council
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
Faction: League of Malevolence
- (2024-10-10) Abbigael expressed interest in visiting Keledek.
- (2024-10-10) A local suggested Keledek might not welcome such attention.
- (2025-02-23) Islinel waited at the gate of Keledek's tower and tried to discuss arcane knowledge with him.
- (2025-02-23) Keledek emerged angry, told Islinel to find him when he is off his premises, and replied "Unlikely!" to her hopes of learning from him.
- (2025-02-23) The encounter confirmed local rumors of Keledek's unfriendly nature.
- (2025-02-27) The party learned Keledek is an unpleasant wizard from the south rumored to magically hear whenever his name is spoken.
- (2025-12-06) Elkhorn named Keledek, a sorcerer, as a member of the League of Malevolence, accompanied by Warduke.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said Keledek, a mage of the League of Malevolence, was left in the palace by the hag coven to guard the cauldron.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the League is searching for a unicorn so Keledek can free the wizard Ringlerun and covet his staff of power.
- (2026-05-14) Keledek was found reclining on a gilded throne in the central tower, holding the leashes of three cockatrice-like creatures.
- (2026-05-14) Keledek recited 'Knights of Glass, protect my ass!' and the stained glass windows burst into glass golems.
- (2026-05-14) Keledek blasted Strongheart with arcane force, leaving him bloodied.

chunks.title: Keledek (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Keledek (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-10-29)
- (2026-05-14) Cuckoo knocked Keledek unconscious with a non-lethal blow.
- (2026-05-14) Keledek was captured and stripped of his Staff of Striking and Bracers of Defense.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart said Keledek has long coveted Ringlerun's staff of power.
- (2026-06-25) Keledek is reported to be brewing large quantities of potions for the eventual assault on the Sunken Isle, not yet available.
- (2026-09-03) Keledek loaned the party four potions of invisibility and four potions of gaseous form from a bag of holding, to be returned if unused.
- (2026-09-03) Keledek explained that the stone circle north of Saltmarsh only leads to the prevailing seasonal Fae court, not Prismere.
- (2026-09-17) The party used the potions of Gaseous Form provided by Keledek to bypass the fighting and reach the hidden closet.
- (2026-10-29) Keledek sold water breathing potions to the party at 200 gp each; the party found they had not used any and had 12 more from a secret room.

chunks.title: Islinel
chunks.text:
NPC: Islinel (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Islinell, Islenel
Role: wizard who wants to learn from Keledek
Status: alive
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2024-10-24) Islinel suggested the party had already blown the contract since someone was in the house.
- (2024-10-24) Islinel made the weasel den smell like roses for a while.
- (2024-10-24) Islinel freed the prisoner Ned in the house.
- (2024-10-24) Islinel suggested the remains around the well looked like those left by a large snake 10 feet or more long.
- (2024-10-24) Islinel suggested waiting until the snake left and checking its lair for treasure.
- (2024-11-02) Islinel investigated a pile of moldy books in the library and inadvertently triggered yellow mold that poisoned Snarky.
- (2024-11-02) Islinel retrieved valuable books by Nystul and Tenser from the library pile.
- (2024-11-02) Islinel found a secret compartment in the study desk holding a double-sized healing potion.
- (2024-11-02) Islinel used True Strike and landed a precise shot on the Bandit Scout.
- (2024-11-02) Islinel was knocked unconscious by the wizard's fire attacks and left injured but stable.
- (2024-11-22) Islinel entered an upstairs room without looking up and was instantly knocked unconscious by a spider swarm.
- (2024-11-22) The party stabilized Islinel.
- (2024-12-05) Islinel discovered a chest and broke a jar of green slime, letting it contact a fireburst mushroom.
- (2024-12-05) Islinel tied a rope to a bed in the Reeking House and climbed down to safety.

chunks.title: Islinel (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Islinel (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
- (2024-12-05) Islinel used True Strike and a long sword to chip the metallic coating off skeletons in the basement.
- (2024-12-05) Islinel's Healer's Kit helped revive Snarky.
- (2024-12-05) Islinel and Istyl investigated the corpse in plate mail and dislodged two piles of rot grubs, which were smashed before finding a host.
- (2025-02-23) Islinel tried to meet Keledek at his tower to seek instruction and was rudely dismissed, but remains determined to learn from him.
- (2025-03-14) Islinel approached the snake-infested well at the Reeking House ruins, spotted a young snake and jumped away.
- (2025-03-14) Islinel was bitten by a 12-foot venomous parent snake and fell unconscious while trying to escape down the well.
- (2025-03-14) The party stabilized Islinel after the snake attack.
- (2025-03-14) Islinel worked on woodcrafting during downtime.
- (2025-03-14) Islinel agreed to compliment everyone she meets as her deal with the carnival ticket taker.
- (2025-04-24) Islinel led the party back to the carnival by following the calliope music.
- (2025-04-24) Islinel chose a unicorn balloon animal.
- (2025-04-24) On arrival in Prismere, Islinel was transformed into a bullywug.

chunks.title: Ned
chunks.text:
NPC: Ned (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ned from Seaton
Role: traitor allied with the bandits
Location: Loomlurch workshop
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
Faction: bandits
- (2024-10-24) Ned was found gagged and bound to a bedframe in an upstairs room of the Reeking House, wearing only undergarments.
- (2024-10-24) Ned said he was from a nearby village called Seaton and warned the party the house was not safe.
- (2024-10-24) Ned had a lump on the back of his head.
- (2024-10-24) Ned said he was looking for work, possibly at the carnival, and claimed to be a capable scout.
- (2024-10-24) Cuckoo and Islinel gave Ned silver and a note of introduction to Winnie.
- (2024-10-24) Ned returned late on the second day with hand-me-down gear and a gift basket, saying Gellen had hired him to help guard.
- (2024-10-24) Ned had no further information about who attacked him when Istyl questioned him.
- (2024-11-02) Ned joined the party as an official guard, equipped with leather armor and a small blade.
- (2024-11-02) Ned suggested the rattling marble sounds might be skeletons.
- (2024-11-02) Ned revealed himself as a traitor and attacked the party with a hand crossbow, though ineffectively.
- (2024-11-02) The party landed several hits on Ned, including Hex, which reduced his Dexterity, and an Eldritch Blast.
- (2024-11-02) Ned escaped through a hidden door to the West, shouting warnings to his confederates that they had been 'blown'.
- (2024-11-22) Ned escaped through a secret door and sounded an alarm.

chunks.title: Ned (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Ned (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]

chunks.title: Captain Eliander Fireborn
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Eliander Fireborn (first seen 2024-11-22, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Captain Fireborn, Eleander Fireborn, Eliander Fireborne
Role: leads the militia assault on the Sunken Isle front door
Location: Sunken Isle gatehouse
Faction: Loyalist
Attitude to party: cooperative

- (2024-11-22) Captain Fireborn and Lady Oweland offered a reward for shutting down the smuggling operation.
- (2025-01-30) Fireborn and Lady Oweland came to the Snapping Line Inn while the crab was cooking and heard the party's findings.
- (2025-01-30) Fireborn and Oweland paid the party 500 gold for stopping the smugglers at the Reeking House.
- (2025-01-30) Fireborn and Oweland offered 500 gold for identifying the smuggling ship and 1000 gold for disabling or destroying it.
- (2025-01-30) Fireborn keeps a library of local history and lore in his mansion; it is not a magic or lending library.
- (2026-06-25) Eliander Fireborn attended the war council with the lizardfolk, merfolk and Lokathah.
- (2026-09-03) Eliander tasked the party with preventing the Sahuagin from dropping the portcullis before the militia arrived.
- (2026-09-03) Eliander arrived with the militia vanguard, saluted the party and ordered the army into the Sunken Isle.

chunks.title: Lady Eda Oweland
chunks.text:
NPC: Lady Eda Oweland (first seen 2024-11-22, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Eda Eda Oweland, Lady Oweland, Eda Oweland, Councilwoman Oweland
Role: town councilwoman
Faction: Traditionalist

- (2024-11-22) Cuckoo and Abbigael met with Lady Oweland to gather information about the smuggling operation.
- (2024-11-22) Cuckoo and Abbigael overheard discussions about smuggling and pricing issues in Saltmarsh.

- (2025-02-27) Eda Oweland shared concerns about weapons being smuggled to the lizardfolk in the Hool Marshes.
- (2025-02-27) Eda Oweland had not heard of the 'devil men from the sea' threatening the lizardfolk before the party reported it.
- (2025-02-27) Eda Oweland arranged the loan of a jollyboat from Well Done for approaching the Sea Ghost.
- (2026-06-25) Eda Oweland led the war council briefing on the Sahuagin threat and offered the party an exclusive contract to scout the Sunken Isle.

chunks.title: Spider swarm
chunks.text:
NPC: Spider swarm (first seen 2024-11-22, last seen 2024-11-22) [unconfirmed record]
Location: upper floor of the Reeking House
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2024-11-22) A spider swarm in an upstairs room of the Reeking House attacked the party.
- (2024-11-22) The party fought the swarm using Cuckoo's monk abilities, Abbigael's spells and Snarky's coat.

chunks.title: Skeletons
chunks.text:
NPC: Skeletons (first seen 2024-12-05, last seen 2024-12-05) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: metal-plated skeletons, reanimated skeletal warriors
Role: guardians behind the barred basement door
Location: Reeking House basement
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: destroyed or defeated
- (2024-12-05) A group of metal-plated skeletons attacked the party when Cuckoo opened the barred door in the basement.
- (2024-12-05) The metallic coating made them resistant to damage; Abbigael's Firebolt was not very effective.
- (2024-12-05) Cuckoo destroyed one skeleton with his shillelagh and Istyl destroyed another with Eldritch Blast.
- (2024-12-05) The skeletons attacked with swords and bows.

chunks.title: Skelalchemist
chunks.text:
NPC: Skelalchemist (first seen 2024-12-05, last seen 2024-12-05) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: skelachemist
Role: acid-throwing skeletal alchemist
Location: Reeking House basement
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2024-12-05) Snarky taunted the Skelalchemist, who then hit Snarky with a vial of acid and dropped him.
- (2024-12-05) The party looted a spellbook, a smooth stone pendant, alchemical equipment and a guidebook from the Skelalchemist.

chunks.title: Fireburst Mushroom
chunks.text:
NPC: Fireburst Mushroom (first seen 2024-12-05, last seen 2024-12-05) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: fire cap mushrooms
Role: volatile fungus hazard
Location: upper floor fireplace, Reeking House
- (2024-12-05) The party identified a glowing fungus in the upstairs fireplace as a potentially dangerous fireburst mushroom.
- (2024-12-05) It releases a powerful mix of chemical and magical fire when disturbed or at maturity.
- (2024-12-05) Contact with green slime from a broken jar set off the fire that burned the Reeking House.

chunks.title: Xolec of the Suellian Conquerors
chunks.text:
NPC: Xolec of the Suellian Conquerors (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Xolec
Role: ancient vampire, trapped in the abandoned house 60+ years ago
Faction: Suellian Conquerors
Location: coffin in hidden basement of the abandoned house at Crabber's Cove
Attitude to party: bargaining; offers information
Status: alive (undead)
- (2025-01-30) The party opened the coffin in the hidden basement and Xolec introduced himself.
- (2025-01-30) Xolec said he has used the house to feed on unwary travelers.
- (2025-01-30) Xolec said he has surveilled the Scarlet Brotherhood, who use the house as a secret meeting place.
- (2025-01-30) Xolec offered information about the town and its inhabitants in exchange for the party's silence about his presence.
- (2025-01-30) Xolec offered to reveal the Scarlet Brotherhood members in Saltmarsh only if the party carries his coffin out of the house to free him.
- (2025-01-30) The party decided to hold off on freeing him.

chunks.title: Scarlet Brotherhood
chunks.text:
NPC: Scarlet Brotherhood (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: clandestine group dedicated to sowing chaos in Keoland
Location: uses the abandoned house at Crabber's Cove as a meeting place
- (2025-01-30) Xolec said the Scarlet Brotherhood has a very high opinion of their ability and whispers their secrets over his coffin.
- (2025-01-30) The party discussed the Scarlet Brotherhood's interest in Saltmarsh and the region.

chunks.title: Ingo the Drover
chunks.text:
NPC: Ingo the Drover (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: burly man who helped carry the giant crab to the inn
Faction: Loyalist
Location: Saltmarsh
- (2025-01-30) Ingo helped the party transport the giant crab to the Snapping Line Inn.

chunks.title: Anders Solmar
chunks.text:
NPC: Anders Solmar (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Anders Solmor, Anders
Role: young council member and swing vote; owns a substantial fleet of ships
Faction: swing vote between traditionalists and loyalists
Location: Saltmarsh
- (2025-01-30) Anders recently joined the council after his parents died.
- (2025-01-30) Anders holds the swing vote between the traditionalists and loyalists.
- (2025-01-30) Anders is willing to pay for information about or disruption of lizardfolk plans.
- (2025-01-30) Anders is rumored to be biased against lizardfolk, whom he blames for his parents' deaths.

chunks.title: Monestrad Copperlocks
chunks.text:
NPC: Monestrad Copperlocks (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: dwarf miner and Saltmarsh council member
Faction: Loyalist
Location: Saltmarsh

chunks.title: Giant crab
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant crab (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: 6-foot wide aggressive crab living in a pool under the abandoned house
Location: brought to the Snapping Line Inn to be cooked
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-01-30) The crab attacked Abbigael and missed, after all of the party's attacks on it also missed.
- (2025-01-30) Snarky killed the crab with one well-placed shot.
- (2025-01-30) The party brought the crab to the Snapping Line Inn to be cooked.

chunks.title: Sella
chunks.text:
NPC: Sella (first seen 2025-02-23, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: lizardfolk merchant selling smoked meats and jerky
Location: Green Market, Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: warm
Status: alive
- (2025-02-23) Sella told the party that shark-like, fiendish creatures in the Hool Marshes threaten her people and want to destroy all surface folk.
- (2025-02-27) Sella's report of 'devil men from the sea' threatening the lizardfolk was news to Eda Oweland.
- (2025-03-14) Sella sold jerky to Istyl and Cuckoo.
- (2025-03-14) Sella explained her people need weapons to fight sea devils.
- (2025-03-14) Sella revealed the tribe is led by Queen Otho Kent, with sub-chief Irtos and wise man Sauriv.
- (2025-03-14) Sella suggested the party could let weapon shipments through while still dealing with the smugglers.
- (2025-03-14) Sella warned that her people will fight to protect the weapon shipments.
- (2026-06-25) Sella now works her stall with two other lizardfolk after restrictions on lizardfolk gatherings were relaxed.
- (2026-06-25) Sella told the party the Lizardfolk Queen came to Saltmarsh and reached an understanding with the town council that the lizardfolk would stand alongside the town against a threat from the sea.
- (2026-06-25) Sella explained that her people once lived on the coast and fished beside Saltmarsh folk until the Sahuagin drove them into the swamps.
- (2026-06-25) Sella gently explained to Istyl that tight grasping means hunting to lizardfolk, after Istyl tried to hug her; Istyl apologized and Sella accepted.

chunks.title: Jade
chunks.text:
NPC: Jade (first seen 2025-02-23, last seen 2025-02-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elven merchant claiming to be from Verda, buying large quantities of smoked fish
Location: Weekly Market, Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: suspicious
- (2025-02-23) Jade claimed she was buying fish to ease a drought in Verda, which Cuckoo knows is not occurring.
- (2025-02-23) GMAssistant noted that Jade may have hidden motives and coordinates both land and sea shipments.

chunks.title: Granny Nightshade
chunks.text:
NPC: Granny Nightshade (first seen 2025-02-23, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Skabitha Nightshade, Skabitha "Granny" Nightshade
Role: hag sister, ruler of the Dreadwood
Location: Dreadwood, Prime Material Plane
Faction: Hourglass Coven
Status: alive
Attitude to party: enraged
- (2025-02-23) Rumors say Granny Nightshade owes fealty to some darker lord.
- (2025-03-27) The unicorns named Skabitha "Granny" Nightshade as a leader of the Hourglass Coven.
- (2025-03-27) The party learned the blights attacking Matty's farm were likely sent by Granny Nightshade, who had been harassing him.
- (2025-03-27) Granny Nightshade has Oni under her command.
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar named Granny Nightshade as one of the three hag sisters who overthrew Zybilna.
- (2025-07-17) Clapperclaw said Granny Nightshade created him.
- (2025-07-24) The party considered lying that they found the Book of Bad Blood in Granny Nightshade's territory in the Dreadwood, to exploit jealousy between the sisters.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna's book says Granny Nightshade made a deal with the Emerald Whisperer that granted her the Dreadwood, making Bavlorna jealous.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna said Skabitha holds Cuckoo's parents and is weaker in Thither than in the Dreadwood.
- (2025-09-18) Wanted posters signed by Granny Nightshade offer protection from swords, or a curse on a creature of the bearer's choice, in exchange for Will of the Feywild delivered alive and unharmed.
- (2025-09-18) The posters showed Granny Nightshade can be stolen from and prefers that name to Skabitha.

chunks.title: Granny Nightshade (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Granny Nightshade (first seen 2025-02-23, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-09-18) The dryad said Granny Nightshade cut down her sycamore to make cursed wooden toys.
- (2025-09-18) Nib said Granny Nightshade cursed him to spin gold into gifts as penance.
- (2025-09-18) Nib said she has a wind-up key in her back showing her mood: fast means happy, slow means angry, stopped means terrible danger.
- (2025-09-18) Nib said she makes twisted toys to give children nightmares and delivers them on a flying rocking horse.
- (2025-09-18) The pixies said red caps are grown in her garden at Loomlurch and sent out to cause trouble.
- (2025-09-18) The pixies said the Grandfather Tree became sick when she took over.
- (2025-09-18) Lirian said Granny Nightshade took his memories.
- (2025-10-16) The party learned she is more powerful on the prime material plane due to her deal.
- (2025-10-16) Her parlor and study are the likeliest places to find her in Loomlurch.
- (2025-10-30) The party saw a hunched figure riding a motionless horse, cackling, flying west to east away from Loomlurch, and speculated it was Granny Nightshade leaving.
- (2025-10-30) The party learned Granny keeps magical keys that lock all the outside doors of Loomlurch and has tin soldiers as guards.
- (2025-10-30) Goblin merchants at the market work under an exclusive deal with Granny.
- (2025-10-30) Chucklehead said Granny spends a lot of time in her kitchen, especially when baking.

chunks.title: Granny Nightshade (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Granny Nightshade (first seen 2025-02-23, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-11-13) At the end of the session a voice outside called out 'What start of guests are these?', showing the hag had returned.
- (2025-12-06) Skabitha let out a piercing cry of rage when she discovered her portraits had been stolen, and a second cry followed as the party fled.
- (2025-12-06) Will reported that Skabitha was in a defensive posture, with eight Red Caps patrolling and the goblins making toys to replace the destroyed tin soldiers.
- (2025-12-06) Elkhorn said Granny Nightshade captured and interrogated him and suspected his honesty.
- (2026-02-19) Skabitha was found at Motherhorn pursuing an acting career and showed no ill will toward the party.
- (2026-02-19) Skabitha offered to help if the party meets her former associates in the Palace of Heart's Desire.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna confirmed Granny Nightshade is on the Prime Material Plane, allied with a powerful green dragon.
- (2026-05-28) Lirian's memory loss and Diana's transformation were binding bargains made with her, undone only by her death or a wish of equal power.
- (2026-06-11) The carousel unicorns said Granny Nightshade fled to the Dreadwood on the Prime Material Plane.
- (2026-06-11) The carousel unicorns said she cannot remember or perceive the first creature she sees upon waking each day.
- (2026-06-11) Loomlurch became a cheerful goblin-run daycare after she left.
- (2026-07-09) Istyl told Captain Thrace that Granny Nightshade's coven is weakened and she is allied with an ancient green dragon.

chunks.title: Snake Eyes
chunks.text:
NPC: Snake Eyes (first seen 2025-02-27, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Captain Snake Eyes
Role: captain of the smuggling ship Sea Ghost
Location: Sea Ghost, anchored off Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2025-02-27) Snake Eyes is better dressed than his crew and armed with a longsword and hand crossbow.
- (2025-02-27) Snake Eyes grew suspicious of the party's signal and credentials and ordered them to leave.
- (2025-02-27) Snake Eyes appears to know Gellen Primewater and expects to deal with people he knows.
- (2025-02-27) Snake Eyes sent a message that Gellen should send someone he knows next time.

chunks.title: Bloody Berta
chunks.text:
NPC: Bloody Berta (first seen 2025-02-27, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
Role: muscle of the Sea Ghost crew
Location: Sea Ghost
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-02-27) Bloody Berta fought the party with two fighting knives with brass-knuckled hilts.

chunks.title: Pucketta
chunks.text:
NPC: Pucketta (first seen 2025-02-27, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Punketa
Role: one-legged spellcaster of the Sea Ghost crew
Location: Sea Ghost
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-02-27) Pucketta hit Snarky with a crackling beam of electrical energy.
- (2025-02-27) Pucketta uses a quarterstaff and carries many pouches and bags.
- (2025-02-27) Snarky's attempt to grapple Pucketta with the rope and hook failed to get through her magical defenses.

chunks.title: Jerk
chunks.text:
NPC: Jerk (first seen 2025-02-27, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Jehrk
Role: crossbowman of the Sea Ghost crew
Location: Sea Ghost
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-02-27) Jerk shot Abbigael with a crossbow bolt that dropped her unconscious.

chunks.title: Fidget
chunks.text:
NPC: Fidget (first seen 2025-02-27, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
Role: wick boy on the Sea Ghost
Location: Sea Ghost
- (2025-02-27) Fidget is a crew member of the Sea Ghost.

chunks.title: Olin
chunks.text:
NPC: Olin (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: headmaster of the Gray Orphanage, a school training orphans as spies and assassins
Location: unknown
Status: alive
- (2025-03-14) A message passed to Snarky reported that Olin is out of prison.

chunks.title: Otho Kent
chunks.text:
NPC: Otho Kent (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: queen of the lizardfolk tribe
Location: Hool Marshes
- (2025-03-14) Sella named Otho Kent as the leader of her tribe.

chunks.title: Irtos
chunks.text:
NPC: Irtos (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: sub-chief of the lizardfolk tribe
Location: Hool Marshes
- (2025-03-14) Sella named Irtos as sub-chief under Queen Otho Kent.

chunks.title: Sauriv
chunks.text:
NPC: Sauriv (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: wise man of the lizardfolk tribe
Location: Hool Marshes
- (2025-03-14) Sella named Sauriv as the tribe's wise man.

chunks.title: Elderly Goblin Ticket Taker
chunks.text:
NPC: Elderly Goblin Ticket Taker (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: ticket taker at the Witchlight Carnival entrance
Location: Witchlight Carnival
- (2025-03-14) He offered the party entry deals or a price of 8 silver.
- (2025-03-14) Istyl agreed to greet every tree with reverence.
- (2025-03-14) Abbigael accepted the task of carrying a precious pumpkin.
- (2025-03-14) Cuckoo paid 8 silver.
- (2025-03-14) Snarky turned out not to need a ticket.
- (2025-03-14) Everyone received decorative butterfly wings.

chunks.title: Dirlagraun
chunks.text:
NPC: Dirlagraun (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Dirlagron, Dirge Lagron
Role: manager of the Lost Property booth
Location: Lost Property booth, Witchlight Carnival
Attitude to party: grateful
Status: alive
- (2025-03-14) The party met Dirlagraun, a midnight-blue furred displacer beast wearing butterfly wings, guarding the Lost Property wagon.
- (2025-03-27) Cuckoo returned a lost child to the Lost Property booth and Dirlagraun gave him Star's mirrored ball as a token of friendship.
- (2025-03-27) Dirlagraun revealed his daughter Star is missing.
- (2026-06-11) Dirlagraun wears butterfly wings tied to his tentacles as part of his mandatory uniform.
- (2026-06-11) Dirlagraun gave each party member a Charm of Finding in gratitude.

chunks.title: Vero
chunks.text:
NPC: Vero (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: young boy
Location: Witchlight Carnival
- (2025-03-14) Vero took a mirrored ball from the Lost Property wagon and ran into the crowd.

chunks.title: Ladybug Goblin
chunks.text:
NPC: Ladybug Goblin (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: goblin collecting button donations for the calliope monkey
Location: Witchlight Carnival
- (2025-03-14) The party met the button-collecting ladybug goblin; some donated buttons or coins.

chunks.title: Calliope Monkey
chunks.text:
NPC: Calliope Monkey (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: intelligent monkey operating the carnival calliope
Location: Witchlight Carnival
- (2025-03-14) The monkey wears a cape covered in donated buttons.
- (2025-04-24) The monkey wears a cape sewn with collected buttons and collects button donations alongside the calliope player.

chunks.title: LarryCurlyMoe
chunks.text:
NPC: LarryCurlyMoe (first seen 2025-03-14, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: LarryCurlyMo, Larry, Curly, and Moe
Role: Abbigael's three-headed hellhound
Status: alive, sent home with Abbigael's message
Location: the Hells
- (2025-03-14) Abbigael revealed that her three-headed dog LarryCurlyMoe follows her.
- (2025-03-14) Istyl recognized the description as matching a hellhound.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna scried the hound eating fish scraps in a coastal village.
- (2026-05-28) The hound detected the scrying and looked directly at the point of observation.
- (2026-06-11) The hound was found eating fish guts near the Shark Fin Bridge in Saltmarsh and reunited joyfully with Abbigael.
- (2026-06-11) Abbigael attached a bag with a soul contract and a letter to its collar and gave the command 'Go Tell'.
- (2026-06-11) All three heads breathed fire to open a portal to the Hells and leaped through.

chunks.title: Pifflewiff
chunks.text:
NPC: Pifflewiff (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2025-03-27) [unconfirmed record]
Role: fairy dragon guide with butterfly wings who speaks Sylvan
Location: Witchlight Carnival
Attitude to party: friendly, helpful
Status: alive
- (2025-03-27) Pifflewiff met the party at the pumpkin contest notice and told them about a previous contest winner who was no longer allowed to participate.
- (2025-03-27) Pifflewiff led the party to Matty's pumpkin farm outside town.
- (2025-03-27) Pifflewiff is connected to a warlock whose patron is the Fae Queen of Prismere.

chunks.title: Diana
chunks.text:
NPC: Diana (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: centaur merged with her horse
Location: Carousel, Witchlight Carnival
Status: alive, still bound by the hag's deal
- (2025-03-27) Diana revealed she made a deal with a hag to be reunited with her horse and was turned into a centaur.
- (2025-03-27) Diana appears unhappy with her transformed state.
- (2025-08-21) GMAssistant notes Diana the centaur was cursed by Skabitha and sought Bavlorna's help but disliked the price.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna said Diana's transformation was a binding bargain with Granny Nightshade, harder to undo than a purely magical change.
- (2026-06-11) Cuckoo told Diana that one Hourglass Coven member was destroyed and the party was pursuing the others.
- (2026-06-11) Diana said her wish was to bring back her beloved horse, who is with her only because of the pact; undoing the deal would lose the horse.
- (2026-06-11) Diana said she would not hold it against the party either way and felt hope for the first time in a long while.

chunks.title: Bold, Moss, Pride and Nine
chunks.text:
NPC: Bold, Moss, Pride and Nine (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: carousel unicorns
Role: living unicorns of the carnival carousel
Location: Carousel, Witchlight Carnival
Attitude to party: grateful, helpful
- (2025-03-27) Istyl restored the names of the four unicorns: Bold, Moss, Pride and Nine.
- (2025-03-27) As each name was restored, the unicorns shared information about the Hourglass Coven and Prismere.
- (2025-03-27) Restoring the names lightened the carnival's mood and made colors brighter.
- (2026-06-11) The carousel unicorns shared the whereabouts of Granny Nightshade, Bavlorna and Endelyn with the party.
- (2026-06-11) The unicorns said Prismere is no longer frozen in time or split into three domains.

chunks.title: Zybilna
chunks.text:
NPC: Zybilna (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Fae Queen of Prismere, fairie queen Zybilna, Queen Zybilna, Zybina
Role: Fae Queen of Prismere, now Istyl's Archfey patron
Location: Palace of Heart's Desire
Status: alive
Attitude to party: helpful
- (2025-03-27) Zybilna has long silvery white hair and a chicken foot tattoo under her left eye.
- (2025-03-27) Each party member recalled a past encounter in which Zybilna helped them.
- (2025-03-27) The Hourglass Coven and Nightshade have displaced Zybilna and taken over Prismere.
- (2025-03-27) Matty offered a reward for proof of Zybilna's wellbeing.
- (2025-04-10) Kettlesteam revealed that Zybilna is her patron.
- (2025-04-24) Mr. Witch and Mr. Light said the carnival is under new management since Queen Zybilna's disappearance.
- (2025-04-24) The party must find the alicorn to free the dormant queen.
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar said the hags froze time in Zybilna's palace with Iggwilv's Cauldron, trapping and protecting her.
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna said the hag sisters used Elidon's horn to imprison Zybilna in the Palace of Heart's Desire.
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna described Zybilna as vain and at times deceitful, though her magic kept Prismere safe.
- (2026-03-05) Several people are waiting to speak with Zybilna and were told to wait by someone claiming to be the butler, who provides treats.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) Guests at the pavilion wait for an audience with the Fae Queen, called Zybina in this session's recap.

chunks.title: Zybilna (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Zybilna (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-04-16) The party saw Zybilna frozen as an older woman with long white hair and white robes, reaching desperately toward the cauldron.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the crystals in the coffers are spiritual anchors representing aspects of Zybilna's personality she feared losing.
- (2026-04-16) A ghostly figure that appears to be Zybilna offered the party a meeting in the library at the end of the session.
- (2026-05-28) Abbigael touched Zybilna with the unicorn horn and spoke her true name, Natasha, breaking her stasis.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna ordered the Jabberwock out of the ballroom and it slunk away.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna stirred the unicorn horn in her cauldron and recited an incantation about cats, lizards, toads, snakes and bats, restoring the flow of time to the palace.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna offered each party member a wish as a reward.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna scried that Bavlorna fled to a secret tower in Gehenna and Granny Nightshade is on the Prime Material Plane allied with a green dragon.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna warned that someone impersonated her in the astral library to trick the party into learning her true name, and told them to keep it secret.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna said she visited each party member in their youth, helping Istyl find her voice and pulling Abbigael from boiling mud.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna told Istyl her family name is Storm Cleaver and to seek them in Stillwater in Verda.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna offered to become Istyl's patron and Istyl accepted.

chunks.title: Zybilna (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Zybilna (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna's appearance briefly turned darker and more menacing while she discussed her past.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna froze Zargash in the western tower with her cauldron and the unicorn horn.
- (2026-06-11) Zybilna accurately scritched Star despite the kitten's displacement effect.
- (2026-06-11) Zybilna offered each party member a boon in reward for restoring her.
- (2026-06-11) Zybilna gave Abbigael a magical doorknob opening to the Red Room in the palace guest wing.
- (2026-06-11) Zybilna lent Istyl her true sight as the Eyes of the Fey Queen, and told her Zybilna herself temporarily lacks it while Istyl borrows it.
- (2026-06-11) Zybilna gave Istyl permission to borrow Snickersnack's regalia for the Big Top show.
- (2026-06-25) Zybilna appeared in Cuckoo's dream and told him of the scimitar Second Grin in the Vault of Valdush, guarded by a bound elemental prince and magical defenses.
- (2026-06-25) When Istyl invoked the Eyes of the Fey Queen, she briefly glimpsed Zybilna's view of a garden pavilion with Fae folk laughing and eating cakes.

chunks.title: Madryck "Matty" Roslof
chunks.text:
NPC: Madryck "Matty" Roslof (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Matty, Madryck
Role: retired adventurer and pumpkin farmer, champion of Zybilna
Location: Matty's Pumpkin Farm
Attitude to party: generous
Status: alive
- (2025-03-27) Matty arrived during the blight fight and helped defeat the blights with radiant energy.
- (2025-03-27) Matty revealed he is a warlock whose patron Zybilna has gone missing.
- (2025-03-27) Matty gave the party a magical wand and a pumpkin for the contest.
- (2025-03-27) Matty told the party that Mr. Witch and Mr. Light are shadow elves from the Shadowfell (shadar-kai).
- (2025-03-27) Matty suspects Granny Nightshade is a front for something more powerful, like a devil.
- (2026-06-11) Matty said he could feel Zybilna's presence again and sense Istyl's connection to her.
- (2026-06-11) Matty dug up a buried chest of his old adventuring gear and gave it to the party.
- (2026-06-11) Matty gave the party three letters of favor.
- (2026-06-11) Cuckoo warned Matty that Granny Nightshade and Bavlorna are still at large; Matty thought he was likely of little interest to them now.
- (2026-06-11) Matty said he did not mind being on a different wheel, reflecting on nearing the end of his road.

chunks.title: Bavlorna Blightstraw
chunks.text:
NPC: Bavlorna Blightstraw (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Bavlorna Lightstraw
Role: toad-like hag, mistress of Hither
Faction: Hourglass Coven
Location: the Hells
Attitude to party: transactional, deal struck
Status: alive
- (2025-03-27) The unicorns named Bavlorna Blightstraw as a member of the Hourglass Coven.
- (2025-03-27) She is known to be allergic to people running counterclockwise.
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar said Bavlorna lives in Downfall among bullywugs who value courtesy and etiquette.
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar said Bavlorna is one of three hag sisters who overthrew Zybilna and despises Granny Nightshade.
- (2025-06-26) Visions in a stream showed Bavlorna, a toad-featured hag, bathing while miniature versions of herself attended her (seen by Snarky).
- (2025-06-26) Agdon said Bavlorna uses cages to imprison people and collects unusual items such as memories in jars.
- (2025-06-26) Bavlorna's miniature servants can reportedly be eaten to gain their memories.
- (2025-07-17) The party entered Bavlorna's cottage after getting no answer, and she was not present when the session ended.
- (2025-07-24) The party met Bavlorna in her study, where she was having tea with Charm.
- (2025-07-24) Bavlorna said she would not negotiate until the party fixed her pool, retrieved her Book of Bad Blood from somewhere in Hither, and brought her a crate of blue items a hunter failed to deliver.
- (2025-07-24) Bavlorna confirmed she has Istyl's sense of direction and said she acquired it legitimately with no debt attached.

chunks.title: Bavlorna Blightstraw (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Bavlorna Blightstraw (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
