- (2025-07-24) Bavlorna collects personal items from her deals with victims as trophies.
- (2025-08-07) Bavlorna rotated her head completely around while her body stayed still, showing frog-like blinking eyes, when Istyl returned to the study with questions.
- (2025-08-07) Bavlorna hinted that Istyl may have violated laws of hospitality by going somewhere without a ticket.
- (2025-08-07) Bavlorna said her little friends keep the cottage the way she likes it.
- (2025-08-07) Bavlorna was pleased when Istyl reported the plumbing fixed and said she looked forward to a soak.
- (2025-08-07) Bavlorna appeared unaware of Charm's theft from her third floor.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna was found lounging on a magical lily pad in her preservation pool, looking healthier with slimy skin.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna accepted the crate of carcasses and the Book of Bad Blood, which her lornlings carried away.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna removed the curse from Abbigael's luckstone, kept the stone, and restored Istyl's sense of direction enhanced.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna told the party Cuckoo's parents are held by Granny Nightshade at the Grandfather Tree in Thither, Hurly is at Motherhorn in Yon, and the displacer cub is with children at Little Oak in Thither.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna demanded the party steal Skabitha's portrait within eight days or be cursed, and sealed the deal with a handshake.

chunks.title: Bavlorna Blightstraw (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Bavlorna Blightstraw (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna offered potions of diminution, growth and invisibility, enhanced identify scrolls, and mentioned a dangerous wish-granting bronze frog.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna said she wants the portrait simply to annoy her sister and became evasive about a fourth sister, Tasha.
- (2025-10-30) The party recalled they have seven days to steal the painting for Bavlorna or be cursed.
- (2025-10-30) Cuckoo proposed stealing the painting while framing Bavlorna for the theft to provoke conflict among the hag sisters.
- (2025-10-30) The party saw Bavlorna's animated portrait among thorny brambles in Loomlurch's portrait gallery.
- (2025-12-06) Bavlorna's curses manifested on the party at dusk after the portrait bargain could not be fulfilled.
- (2025-12-06) Abbigael made an illusion of Bavlorna in the garden to distract Skabitha.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna's scrying showed Bavlorna fled to a secret tower in Gehenna, beyond her ability to scry.
- (2026-06-11) The carousel unicorns said Bavlorna has gone to the Hells.
- (2026-06-11) The unicorns said anyone running counterclockwise (widdershins) around her can throw her into disarray.

chunks.title: Mr. Witch and Mr. Light
chunks.text:
NPC: Mr. Witch and Mr. Light (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Mr. Witch, Mr. Light, Mssrs. Witch and Light
Role: carnival masters; formerly gloomy shadowfell elves who found joy running the carnival
Faction: shadar-kai
Location: ornate wagon in the Staff Area
Attitude to party: cooperative
- (2025-03-27) Matty revealed the owners are shadow elves from the Shadowfell and may not be legally allowed so far from their realm.
- (2025-04-10) Mr. Witch accepted all pumpkin contest entries without concern.
- (2025-04-10) Mr. Light hosted the extravaganza in a diamond-paned mirror suit with functional butterfly wings.
- (2025-04-10) Snarky pilfered Mr. Witch's pocket watch, a device necessary for running the carnival, and Mr. Witch discovered it missing.
- (2025-04-10) Kettlesteam said Mr. Witch and Mr. Light have made some sort of bargain.
- (2025-04-24) Cuckoo implied the party had Mr. Witch's missing watch to gain their cooperation.
- (2025-04-24) Mr. Witch and Mr. Light explained the three rules of Prismere: ownership, hospitality and reciprocity.
- (2025-04-24) They revealed the carnival is part of Prismere and subject to its ruler, now under new management since Queen Zybilna's disappearance.
- (2025-04-24) Snarky secretly returned the stolen watch to Mr. Witch.
- (2025-04-24) Mr. Light gave the party magical balloon animals as gifts and conducted the monarch crowning ceremony with golden light.
- (2025-04-24) The Hall of Illusions mirrors revealed their past as shadowfell elves.

chunks.title: Mr. Witch and Mr. Light (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Mr. Witch and Mr. Light (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-04-24) Mr. Witch said 'Mind the Rule of Three: future, present, past.' and Mr. Light said 'Find the alicorn and free the dormant queen at last.'
- (2026-06-11) Mr. Witch and Mr. Light were delighted to hear of Zybilna's return.
- (2026-06-11) Mr. Light repeatedly spotlighted Istyl during the Big Top show.
- (2026-06-11) Mr. Light announced the current monarch's reign will end in a few days when a new monarch is crowned.

chunks.title: Hourglass Coven
chunks.text:
NPC: Hourglass Coven (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2025-03-27) [unconfirmed record]
Role: coven of hags
Location: Prismere
- (2025-03-27) The Coven has displaced Zybilna and taken over Prismere.

chunks.title: Vine Blight and Twig Blight
chunks.text:
NPC: Vine Blight and Twig Blight (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2025-03-27) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: blights
Role: invasive thorny plant creatures
Location: Matty's Pumpkin Farm
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2025-03-27) The blights attacked Matty's farm and the party fought them.
- (2025-03-27) Snarky was grappled by a vine blight.
- (2025-03-27) The party discovered the blights are vulnerable to fire.
- (2025-03-27) Matty helped defeat the blights with radiant energy.

chunks.title: Star
chunks.text:
NPC: Star (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: displacer beast kitten, Istyl's companion
Status: alive
Location: with Istyl
- (2025-03-27) Dirlagraun is searching for Star, who is missing at the carnival.
- (2025-10-16) The party recognized Will's displacer beast kitten as Star when she played eagerly with the mirror ball from Charm.
- (2025-10-16) Will offered to trade Star for the party's help freeing more children.
- (2025-12-06) Will agreed to let the party take Star if they free all the children from Loomlurch.
- (2026-06-11) Istyl introduced Star to Zybilna at the palace.
- (2026-06-11) Star chased butterflies around Dirlagraun's tentacles at the Lost Property booth.

chunks.title: Featherine
chunks.text:
NPC: Featherine (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: philosophical swan who pulls gondolas around Silver Song Lake
Location: Silver Song Lake
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-04-10) Featherine took the party on a gondola ride around Silver Song Lake and posed deep questions about existence.

chunks.title: Palasha
chunks.text:
NPC: Palasha (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: mermaid performer who sings magical songs creating water sculptures
Location: Silver Song Lake
Status: alive
- (2025-04-10) Palasha performed with song and magic involving fountains after the swan ride.
- (2025-04-10) Abbigael and Istyl arranged a reunion of Palasha and Candlefoot, leading to a proposal.

chunks.title: Candlefoot
chunks.text:
NPC: Candlefoot (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: mime
Location: Hall of Illusions
Attitude to party: grateful
Status: alive
- (2025-04-10) Candlefoot lost his voice while proposing to Palasha.
- (2025-04-10) The party restored Candlefoot's voice at the Hall of Illusions using the charm Kettlesteam offered.
- (2025-04-10) Candlefoot and Palasha were reunited and he proposed to her, lifting the carnival's spirits.
- (2025-04-24) Candlefoot presented the crown of golden butterflies at Istyl's crowning ceremony, pulling it from an invisible box.

chunks.title: Kettlesteam
chunks.text:
NPC: Kettlesteam (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: kenku warlock serving Zybilna, disguised as an old woman
Faction: Zybilna's patronage
Attitude to party: cooperative after capture
Status: alive
- (2025-04-10) Kettlesteam disrupted Palasha's performance and the party captured her.
- (2025-04-10) Kettlesteam revealed through mimicry that Mr. Witch and Mr. Light made some sort of bargain and she means to learn how it affects her patron.
- (2025-04-10) Kettlesteam offered the charm holding Candlefoot's voice and to spy on anyone the party wants.
- (2025-04-10) Cuckoo engaged Kettlesteam to search for Star.
- (2025-04-10) The party spotted a kenku near the dragonfly rides, and the scene details say she fled after causing the incident.

chunks.title: Burley
chunks.text:
NPC: Burley (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Burly
Role: carnival staff, brother of Hurley
Location: staff camp, Witchlight Carnival
Attitude to party: grateful
Status: alive
- (2025-04-10) Burley's brother Hurley is missing.
- (2025-04-10) Burley told the party that Mr. Witch and Mr. Light have secrets and that the party would need leverage to make them reveal them.
- (2025-04-10) Burley performed in the extravaganza.
- (2026-06-11) Cuckoo told Burley that Hurley was found performing in a Feywild theater, freed from a bad contract under Zybilna's restored rule.
- (2026-06-11) Burley responded with relief and sibling rivalry.
- (2026-06-11) Istyl's true sight confirmed Burley's pumpkin helmet is entirely real.

chunks.title: Hurley
chunks.text:
NPC: Hurley (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Hurly
Role: Burley's brother
Status: alive, freed
Location: Motherhorn actors' area
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-04-10) Burley's brother Hurley is missing.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna told the party Hurly can be found at Motherhorn citadel in Yon.
- (2025-12-06) Amidor and Gleam said Hurley the bugbear is forced to perform in Endelyn's shows and is among those the party could help.
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands said Hurly performs regularly on the Motherhorn stage and can be found in the actors' area.
- (2026-02-19) Hurley, in a green dragon costume, mistook the party for villagers to be killed in his scene and was sent to the stage by their deception.
- (2026-02-19) Hurley mentioned his brother Burley.
- (2026-02-19) After Endelyn died, the party freed Hurley and his bargain was broken; he wants to return to the Witchlight Carnival.

chunks.title: Punkin
chunks.text:
NPC: Punkin (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Pumpkin
Role: ogre entered as a pumpkin in the contest by Kuggo
Location: Big Top
- (2025-04-10) The party discovered Kuggo's pumpkin was actually the ogre Punkin hiding under a tarp.
- (2025-04-10) Punkin performed poorly at smashing regular pumpkins in the final judging.

chunks.title: Kuggo
chunks.text:
NPC: Kuggo (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: orc contestant in the pumpkin contest
Location: Big Top
- (2025-04-10) Kuggo entered the ogre Punkin as his pumpkin.

chunks.title: Sir Flancelot
chunks.text:
NPC: Sir Flancelot (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: noble frog in damp robes, pumpkin contest contestant
Location: Big Top
- (2025-04-10) Sir Flancelot was a contestant in the pumpkin contest.

chunks.title: Reuben
chunks.text:
NPC: Reuben (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: heartbroken halfling
Location: Hall of Illusions
Status: alive
- (2025-04-10) Reuben fled into the Hall of Illusions after his girlfriend laughed uncontrollably due to Tasha's magical booth.
- (2025-04-10) Cuckoo reunited Reuben with Wean, leading to an engagement.
- (2025-04-10) Cuckoo saw a mysterious girl in a pig mask whispering to Reuben's reflection.

chunks.title: Wean
chunks.text:
NPC: Wean (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Reuben's girlfriend
- (2025-04-10) Wean was reunited with Reuben and they became engaged.

chunks.title: Girl in a pig mask
chunks.text:
NPC: Girl in a pig mask (first seen 2025-04-10, last seen 2025-04-10) [unconfirmed record]
Role: mysterious girl seen in mirror reflections
Location: Hall of Illusions
- (2025-04-10) Cuckoo spotted her whispering to Reuben's reflection in the mirrors.

chunks.title: Thako
chunks.text:
NPC: Thako (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: gloomy clown who makes floating balloon animals
Location: Witchlight Carnival
- (2025-04-24) Thako created balloon animals for each party member.

chunks.title: Jeremy Plum
chunks.text:
NPC: Jeremy Plum (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: pixie who welcomes visitors to the Pixie Kingdom and provides pixie dust and shrinking potions
Location: Pixie Kingdom

chunks.title: Biscuit
chunks.text:
NPC: Biscuit (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: intelligent hamster operating the Pixie Kingdom ferris wheel; possibly a reduced-size giant space hamster with lost memories of being a space pirate
Location: Pixie Kingdom

chunks.title: Pinecone
chunks.text:
NPC: Pinecone (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: pug ridden by the party in the Pixie Kingdom
Location: Pixie Kingdom

chunks.title: Beatrice
chunks.text:
NPC: Beatrice (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: talkative heron who complains about the perpetually sunny weather
Location: Pixie Kingdom

chunks.title: Bullywugs
chunks.text:
NPC: Bullywugs (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-04-24) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: bullywug warriors, giant toad
Role: two warriors with venomous rapiers, plus a giant toad, ambushed the party in a misty swamp
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-04-24) The party defeated the bullywugs and giant toad; Abbigael critically hit a bullywug with a firebolt.
- (2025-04-24) The party looted coins, a dust packet, a candle and a bronze pentacle with a rat's head from the bodies.

chunks.title: Bipedal rabbits and giant snail
chunks.text:
NPC: Bipedal rabbits and giant snail (first seen 2025-04-24, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: menacing creatures encountered on arrival in Prismere
Location: Broken Causeway, Prismere
Attitude to party: hostile, retreated
Status: alive
- (2025-04-24) The party encountered them right after arriving in Prismere; the session ended before the outcome.
- (2025-06-19) The rabbits were harengon brigands who tried to extort the party's memories and retreated on their giant snail after Istyl intimidated them.

chunks.title: Harengon Brigands
chunks.text:
NPC: Harengon Brigands (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Herengon brigands, bipedal rabbit brigands, Harengon Brigand Leader
Role: six bipedal rabbit brigands who demand victims' memories of the best gift ever received; one plays bagpipes
Faction: Agdon Longscarf's brigands
Location: Prismere swamp; base atop a giant tree stump
Attitude to party: cowed, cooperative
Status: alive
- (2025-06-19) Six harengon brigands emerged from the fog on the causeway singing about Agdon Longscarf.
- (2025-06-19) Their leader demanded the party surrender their feelings of delight from the best gift ever received, and held a stoppered gourd to collect them.
- (2025-06-19) The party refused; Istyl used a gangster voice to say they liked 'black and blue', and the intimidation succeeded.
- (2025-06-19) The brigands retreated on their giant snail, singing a second verse about Agdon Longscarf.
- (2025-06-19) Jingle Jangle said the brigands recently stole her truffles and attacked her.
- (2025-06-26) The brigands became confused when Agdon showed fear and did not fight.
- (2025-06-26) The brigands departed with sad bagpipe music, their confidence shaken.
- (2025-06-26) The bagpiper said Bavlorna's living, legged cauldron is in the Soggy Court, not her cottage.
- (2025-06-26) The bagpiper's pipes grant temporary hit points to allies and disadvantage to enemies.

chunks.title: Agdon Longscarf
chunks.text:
NPC: Agdon Longscarf (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: harengon brigand leader, now working for Bavlorna
Faction: Harengon brigands
Location: the Great Stump
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-06-19) Agdon Longscarf was only mentioned in the brigands' songs and Jingle Jangle's information; he did not appear in person.
- (2025-06-26) Agdon appeared in person, disguised among the party, and demanded their valuables.
- (2025-06-26) Agdon branded Cuckoo with a hot magical branding iron showing three rabbits chasing each other, and became invisible to Cuckoo.
- (2025-06-26) Agdon stole Snarky's thieves' tools with sleight of hand.
- (2025-06-26) Istyl's Celestial Revelation frightened Agdon into surrendering.
- (2025-06-26) Agdon returned Snarky's tools and agreed to return stolen truffles and not report the encounter to Bavlorna.
- (2025-06-26) Agdon said Bavlorna freed him from Zybilna's curse by cutting down the tree he was bound to, and that he now steals from travelers in exchange for her protection.
- (2025-06-26) Cuckoo paid Agdon 20 gold to hunt Bavlorna's spy creatures, and Snarky paid 10 gold more for the truffles.
- (2025-06-26) His blue scarf is cursed by Zybilna so he can never remove it.
- (2025-08-21) Cuckoo persuaded Agdon to hand over Clapperclaw's deer skull head for bullywug trinkets and 20 gold.
- (2025-08-21) Agdon admitted he regretted taking the creepy skull and hinted their arrangement about Bavlorna's spy creatures might continue.

chunks.title: Sir Talavar
chunks.text:
NPC: Sir Talavar (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Sir Talivar
Role: purple fairy dragon knight errant of the Summer Court with a curly handlebar mustache
Faction: Summer Court
Location: returned to the Summer Court
Attitude to party: friendly, grateful
Status: alive
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar was escaping Bavlorna Blightstraw when his balloon crashed into the leaning tower.
- (2025-06-19) He was trapped in a magically locked silver cage and warned the party of two sleeping serpents below.
- (2025-06-19) The party rescued him; Jingle Jangle's silver key opened the cage.
- (2025-06-19) He told the party three hag sisters overthrew Queen Zybilna using Iggwilv's Cauldron to freeze time in her palace.
- (2025-06-19) He gave the party a map of Hither and his +1 dagger, and promised to praise them to the Summer Queen.
- (2025-06-19) He had no knowledge of alicorns when asked.
- (2025-07-17) The party recognized the damaged balloon at the Downfall docks as similar to the one that helped Sir Talavar escape the hag.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort called Sir Talavar a valiant knight worthy of honor and said he has gone home.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) Sir Talivar sent the party a gift wrapped by fairy dragons, with a note in Draconic thanking them and offering a Chime of Opening.

chunks.title: Wiggle Wogt
chunks.text:
NPC: Wiggle Wogt (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: bullywug balloon pilot for Sir Talavar
Status: dead
- (2025-06-19) Wiggle Wogt died in the balloon crash and the party recovered his body.

chunks.title: Giant constrictor snakes
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant constrictor snakes (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: two serpents
Role: two enormous constrictors sleeping in the brambles at the leaning tower
Location: Leaning Tower
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-06-19) Snarky shot one sleeping snake with a critical crossbow hit for 28 damage, waking it.
- (2025-06-19) The snake bit Abbigael and grappled Istyl; Istyl broke free with booming blade and killed it.
- (2025-06-19) The second snake grappled and bit Istyl repeatedly; Cuckoo killed it with wind-based strikes from range.

chunks.title: Jingle Jangle
chunks.text:
NPC: Jingle Jangle (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Jinglejangle
Role: goblin key collector, hermit on Telami Hill
Location: keyhole-shaped cave atop Telami Hill
Attitude to party: friendly, hospitable
Status: alive
- (2025-06-19) Jingle Jangle wears a coat of hundreds of keys and keeps about 10,000 keys on a cave wall.
- (2025-06-19) She traded a silver key to the party for Cuckoo's iron key from the Reeking House, identifying it as a key to secrets and lies from the door where Ned was tied up.
- (2025-06-19) She hosted the party's long rest under the rules of hospitality.
- (2025-06-19) She explained the oh wells, said the area was not originally a swamp, and named Clapperclaw as the best guide.

chunks.title: Clapperclaw
chunks.text:
NPC: Clapperclaw (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: balloon pilot
Location: Bridge of Chattering Heads, Downfall
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar and Jingle Jangle named Clapperclaw as the best guide through the mists; he knows the way to Thither.
- (2025-07-17) The party found Clapperclaw sitting on the bridge of chattering heads, talking to the severed heads.
- (2025-07-17) Clapperclaw said he was created by Granny Nightshade but ran away from her, and he fears being forced back.
- (2025-07-17) Clapperclaw said brigands led by 'the one with the scarf' stole his original stag skull head.
- (2025-07-17) Cuckoo carefully cut eye holes in Clapperclaw's gourd head with a dagger, giving him limited vision and a dim inner glow.
- (2025-07-17) Clapperclaw offered to guide the party through the mists between regions of Prismere if they help recover his stolen head.
- (2025-07-24) Vansel said he followed Clapperclaw from Thither into the mists and ended up captured by Bavlorna.
- (2025-08-07) Clapperclaw advised the party to look for bullywug huts on the south side of the lake for the hunter's crate.
- (2025-08-07) Clapperclaw tried to push eye holes into his gourd replacement head.
- (2025-08-21) Clapperclaw swapped his gourd head for the restored deer skull head and reported improved vision.
- (2025-08-21) Clapperclaw confirmed he can guide the party through the mists between Hither, Thither and Yon, though they need a balloon.

chunks.title: Clapperclaw (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Clapperclaw (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-09-18) Clapperclaw guided the balloon through the mists between Hither and Thither.
- (2025-09-18) Clapperclaw offered to take the party to Nib but does not want to venture far into Thither.
- (2025-09-18) Clapperclaw warned that fairy rings which are not singing and dancing can be dangerous.
- (2025-12-06) Clapperclaw is cheerful and considers the party friends after they returned his head.

chunks.title: Animated Willow Trees
chunks.text:
NPC: Animated Willow Trees (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Telami Hill trees
Role: sentient guardian trees of Telami Hill
Location: Telami Hill
Attitude to party: initially challenging, then allowed passage
- (2025-06-19) A willow tree questioned the party; Istyl's reverent manners earned safe passage and inspiration.
- (2025-06-19) The tree let them pass after learning they sought to restore Zybilna.

chunks.title: Modron Monodrone
chunks.text:
NPC: Modron Monodrone (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: mechanical creature from Mechanis summoned by Abbigael's wild magic
Status: gone after one minute
- (2025-06-19) A modron monodrone appeared during Abbigael's wild magic surges and vanished after a minute.

chunks.title: Elderly Inn Woman
names: Innkeeper of the Inn at the End of the Road
chunks.text:
NPC: Elderly Inn Woman (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Innkeeper of the Inn at the End of the Road
Role: proprietor of the walking Inn at the End of the Road
Location: Inn at the End of the Road
Attitude to party: welcoming
- (2025-06-19) She cleaned the inn's sign, noticed the party and waved a cheerful welcome.
- (2025-06-26) She is named Sue Harbacks.

chunks.title: Sue Harbacks
chunks.text:
NPC: Sue Harbacks (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elderly human innkeeper and live-in operator of the Inn at the End of the Road
Location: Inn at the End of the Road, Hither
Attitude to party: hospitable, friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-06-26) Sue Harbacks welcomed the party inside and offered fresh plum pie under the rules of hospitality.
- (2025-06-26) Sue explained she is trapped in Hither because magical mists block travel between regions of Prismere.
- (2025-06-26) Sue described new floods and the rise of Bavlorna since Zybilna's disappearance.
- (2025-06-26) Sue gave directions to Bavlorna's cottage in Downfall and explained how to see visions of Bavlorna in connected streams.
- (2025-06-26) Sue offered the party permanent lodging if they defeat Bavlorna.
- (2025-06-26) The party asked Sue to watch for the displacer cub Star.
- (2025-06-26) Sue said Bavlorna has many servants who look exactly like her.
- (2025-06-26) Sue fed squirrels on the windowsill and briefly communicated with them.
- (2025-06-26) GMAssistant labeled her 'totally not a Hag'; this is not established.

chunks.title: Hooded Stilt Figures
chunks.text:
NPC: Hooded Stilt Figures (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: six hooded figures on stilts collecting oblong objects from the marsh mud into wire cages
Location: Hither marsh
Attitude to party: acknowledged the party but stayed on task
- (2025-06-26) The party saw six hooded, face-covered figures on stilts collecting oblong objects from the mud while traveling west.

chunks.title: Animated Elven Armor
chunks.text:
NPC: Animated Elven Armor (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
Role: two animated suits of elven armor with owl-head helmets that mimic movements
Location: Ancient Battlefield
Status: one collapsed into loose pieces
- (2025-06-26) Two empty armor suits rose from the water and mimicked Snarky's movements exactly.
- (2025-06-26) Snarky maneuvered around them and got one suit into the boat, naming it 'Narky'.
- (2025-06-26) The suit collapsed into loose pieces when moved from its original location.

chunks.title: Bullywug Guards
chunks.text:
NPC: Bullywug Guards (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Bullywug Escorts
Role: four bullywug sentries in two rowboats at the entrance to Downfall
Faction: Bavlorna's bullywugs
Location: Downfall
Attitude to party: welcoming, admiring
- (2025-06-26) Two rowboats of two bullywugs each emerged from the fog and greeted the party in Sylvan: 'Welcome to Downfall, travelers.'
- (2025-07-17) Four bullywugs in colorful patchwork clothing carrying parasols greeted the party at Downfall and offered to escort them to King Gullop XIX.
- (2025-07-17) The bullywugs were impressed by the party's superior boat; Snarky noticed they were not jealous.
- (2025-07-17) The bullywugs said the route to the king's gazebo crosses stepping stones, the balloon factory and the bridge of chattering heads.

chunks.title: King Gullop XIX
chunks.text:
NPC: King Gullop XIX (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: flabby bullywug king of Downfall, wears a crown of woven lily flowers
Faction: Soggy Court
Location: King Gullop's Gazebo Court, Downfall
Attitude to party: suspicious
Status: dead
- (2025-07-17) King Gullop said only members of the Soggy Court can speak with Bavlorna.
- (2025-07-17) He offered to make the party court members if they return 'The Big Book of Bad Blood' to Bavlorna, and the party accepted.
- (2025-07-17) He said he got the book from a passing merchant and fears being listed in it.
- (2025-07-17) Cuckoo awkwardly asked about purchasing prisoners, which raised the king's suspicion.
- (2025-07-17) The king explained his philosophy on justice and why prisoners should not be sold.
- (2025-08-07) The king grew suspicious when the party said they had not yet returned the book to Bavlorna, and his knights loosened their weapons threateningly.
- (2025-08-07) The king assigned two bullywug knights to follow the party and ensure the book was returned immediately.
- (2025-08-21) Illig assassinated King Gullop by stabbing him in the eye during a staged accidental stumble.
- (2025-08-21) The knights dragged the old king's body away and beheaded it, and the head was put on a pike and began showing signs of animation.

chunks.title: Merrows
chunks.text:
NPC: Merrows (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: two enormous aquatic troll-like creatures with demonic heritage
Location: Stepping stones, Downfall
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-07-17) Two Merrows leapt from the water to attack the party on the stepping stones and shouted exclamations in Abyssal.
- (2025-07-17) One Merrow bit Abbigael with poisonous fangs, poisoning her.
- (2025-07-17) Snarky killed one Merrow with a critical hit.
- (2025-07-17) Istyl finished the other Merrow with booming blade.

chunks.title: Grompi
chunks.text:
NPC: Grompi (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: talking rock that animates
Location: Stepping stones, Downfall
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-07-17) Grompi complained when Cuckoo landed on him, then introduced himself.
- (2025-07-17) Grompi emerged from the water and pummeled a Merrow in the fight.

chunks.title: Concerned Bullywug Citizens
chunks.text:
NPC: Concerned Bullywug Citizens (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Faction: Soggy Court
Location: Downfall
Attitude to party: apologetic, helpful
- (2025-07-17) Armed bullywug citizens arrived after the Merrow fight and apologized for not knowing the creatures were in their waters.
- (2025-07-17) Bullywugs in leather smocks fought fires in the balloon factory and helped by throwing buckets of water at the coals.

chunks.title: Animated Coals
chunks.text:
NPC: Animated Coals (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: six agile magical coals that start fires
Location: Balloon Factory, Downfall
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: extinguished and collected in a metal bucket
- (2025-07-17) Six animated coals hopped around the balloon factory starting fires and dodging water and attacks.
- (2025-07-17) Cuckoo extinguished one with a cold-damage unarmed strike, Snarky used water-dipped arrows, and Istyl snuffed some with eldritch blast.
- (2025-07-17) All six coals were put out and collected in a metal bucket.

chunks.title: The Duke
chunks.text:
NPC: The Duke (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: finely dressed bullywug overseeing the balloon factory
Faction: Soggy Court
Location: Balloon Factory, Downfall
Attitude to party: grateful
- (2025-07-17) The Duke awarded the party brass pilot wings as heroes of the fleet after the coals were extinguished.

chunks.title: Chattering Heads
names: severed heads of former bullywug monarchs
chunks.text:
NPC: Chattering Heads (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: severed heads of former bullywug monarchs
Role: severed heads of former bullywug kings on spikes, gossiping about court politics
Location: Bridge of Chattering Heads
- (2025-07-17) The heads told the party that Sir Talavar escaped Bavlorna with help from bullywugs of the Soggy Court and that an accomplice is imprisoned awaiting trial.
- (2025-07-17) The heads said Bavlorna is a distrustful shut-in who loathes her sisters, especially Granny Nightshade, and spends much of her time at a bathing pool in her cottage.
- (2025-08-07) The heads gossiped about Illig and Muckstump and suspected Muckstump is not a real place.
- (2025-08-07) The heads showed little interest in the taxidermy supplies quest.

chunks.title: Bullywug Tailor
chunks.text:
NPC: Bullywug Tailor (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: court tailor secretly in the revolution
Location: Palace, Downfall
Attitude to party: secretly friendly
- (2025-07-17) The tailor fitted the party with Soggy Court noble attire and hid a secret note in Istyl's sleeve.

chunks.title: Morgott
chunks.text:
NPC: Morgott (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-09-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Morgort, Mortgort
Role: bullywug knight and balloon pilot
Location: edge of Thither, with the balloon
Status: alive
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-07-17) The party saw Morgott, a figure in rags, held in a cell in the palace prison.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort was a female bullywug prisoner in the Soggy Court holding cells, released at the party's request and given back her glaive and armor.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort said she is 'something of an enemy' to Bavlorna and asked to speak privately.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort agreed to serve as the party's balloon pilot and said she and Wigglewog are skilled pilots.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort confirmed Sir Talavar was a valiant knight and said she wants Queen Zybilna restored.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort told the party Iggwilv is connected to Baba Yaga.
- (2025-08-21) Morgort stayed with the skiff when the party went to the Great Stump.
- (2025-09-18) Morgort piloted the balloon from Hither to Thither through the mists.
- (2025-09-18) Morgort said that as a denizen of Hither she could be in danger in Thither because of the hag sisters' conflict, so she landed at the edge of Thither and hid the balloon.
- (2025-09-18) Morgort offered to transport the party back if needed.

chunks.title: Darkling Merchants
chunks.text:
NPC: Darkling Merchants (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: two cursed fae merchants who absorb light and age rapidly
Location: Floating merchant balloon, Downfall
Attitude to party: businesslike
Status: alive
- (2025-07-17) The Darklings said their house betrayed the Summer Queen and was cursed to absorb light.
- (2025-07-17) They said they previously sold an alicorn to someone in Yon.
- (2025-07-17) They can travel over the mists in their storm cloud balloon but refused to take passengers.
- (2025-07-17) Istyl asked about trading for a sense of direction but made no deal.

chunks.title: Bullywug Balloon Workers
chunks.text:
NPC: Bullywug Balloon Workers (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-07-17) [unconfirmed record]
Role: repair the damaged balloon at the docks with silver needle and catgut
Location: Downfall Docks
- (2025-07-17) Two bullywugs repaired the damaged balloon, one sewing from a ladder and one steadying it.

chunks.title: Illig, Baron of Muckstump
chunks.text:
NPC: Illig, Baron of Muckstump (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Baron Illig, King Illig the First
Role: King of the Soggy Court
Faction: Soggy Court
Location: hut south of Downfall
Attitude to party: grateful, generous
Status: alive
- (2025-07-17) A secret note told Istyl to find Illig, the Baron of Muckstump, at once and said the revolution lives.
- (2025-08-07) The talking heads told Istyl that Illig claims to be Baron of Muckstump, possibly a nonexistent place, to claim the throne.
- (2025-08-07) The party found Illig in a southern hut after Abbigael's persuasion check opened the door.
- (2025-08-07) Illig believed the party were co-conspirators sent by his operatives and said his plans were working.
- (2025-08-07) Illig stood atop the crate of hunting and taxidermy gear and proclaimed himself the future seventeenth king of the Soggy Court.
- (2025-08-07) Several armed bullywugs in the hut seemed nervous about Illig's scheme.
- (2025-08-21) Illig showed the party a crude drawing of King Gullop with a dagger in his eye and explained his plan to feign a stumble while bowing.
- (2025-08-21) Illig planned to call for a formal duel as a backup if the assassination failed.
- (2025-08-21) Illig practiced the stab on a target dummy and was terrible at it, and recounted over twenty ways past kings had died, none by accidental stabbing.
- (2025-08-21) Illig bowed, concealed a dagger along his forearm, 'stumbled' and killed King Gullop by stabbing him in the eye.

chunks.title: Illig, Baron of Muckstump (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Illig, Baron of Muckstump (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-08-21) Illig declared the killing a tragic accident and crowned himself King Illig the First.
- (2025-08-21) King Illig freed the prisoner the party requested and agreed to lend the court's balloon on the condition that the pilot return it.

chunks.title: Charm
chunks.text:
NPC: Charm (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: darkling guest of Bavlorna, playing her own game
Location: Bavlorna's Cottage, study
Attitude to party: polite, cryptic
Status: alive
- (2025-07-24) Charm is a tall, lean, gray-skinned woman in black who casts no shadow.
- (2025-07-24) Istyl and Cuckoo overheard Charm flattering Bavlorna while criticizing Granny Nightshade and Endelyn Moongrave.
- (2025-07-24) As the party left the study, Istyl noticed Charm glancing meaningfully toward the upstairs of the cottage.
- (2025-07-24) GMAssistant noted Charm seems to be the figure from the party's earlier visions.
- (2025-08-07) Charm said polite goodbyes to Bavlorna and called the party powerful adventurers.
- (2025-08-07) Abbigael saw Charm's shadow slip down the stairs from the third floor and reattach to her feet.
- (2025-08-07) Abbigael's insight check showed Charm seemed pleased, as if something she anticipated had happened.
- (2025-08-07) The hat from the doll stand flew onto Charm's head; when Abbigael asked, Charm said we've all got pets and made a pointed comment about shadows.
- (2025-08-07) Charm left through the hatch like a getaway driver, and her airship was still docked nearby.
- (2025-08-07) The party theorized Charm used her shadow to steal a small dark item while distracting Bavlorna, and that she knows all three hag sisters and may work for one against another.
- (2026-02-19) Charm agreed to carry Gleam, Glister and Hurley to the Fey Beacons and offered to take the party to the Palace of Heart's Desire.

chunks.title: Endelyn Moongrave
chunks.text:
NPC: Endelyn Moongrave (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Dame of Unhappy Endings
Role: third hag sister, ruler of Motherhorn
Faction: Hourglass Coven
Location: Motherhorn
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-07-24) Charm mockingly questioned whether Endelyn Moongrave has pulled off any unhappy endings recently.
- (2025-08-21) Endelyn rules Yon and her home is the Motherhorn citadel, where Hurly can be found.
- (2025-10-30) The party learned the three hag sisters need each other for their magical bond.
- (2025-10-30) Endelyn's animated portrait is among the five in Loomlurch's portrait gallery.
- (2025-12-06) Endelyn is obsessed with a prophecy of her own demise during an eclipse and dramatizes it in her theatrical productions.
- (2025-12-06) There is no moon in Yon, so a literal eclipse is impossible.
- (2025-12-11) Endelyn used Brigganock-built contraptions and stolen Korred hair for her marionettes and stagecraft.
- (2025-12-11) Endelyn manipulated both the Korreds and the Brigganock against each other.
- (2025-12-11) A pageant wagon sent by Endelyn reenacted the party's recent actions and offered tickets to a private audience with her.
- (2026-01-08) Fina identified Creeping Lynn as the one who cursed her and said her dress holds a sad puppet show about the future.
- (2026-01-08) Creeping Lynn is named as the one who transformed the actors and bargained with Prince Allagarthus.
- (2026-01-22) Obud said Creeping Lyn can see the future accurately but her deals never end well for those who make them.

chunks.title: Endelyn Moongrave (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Endelyn Moongrave (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-01-22) Breakaleg said she is terrified of eclipses.
- (2026-01-22) Golmo's soul had been pulled out and kept near him by Creeping Lyn.
- (2026-02-19) Endelyn attacked the party in the orrery room, using psychic strands to yank Istyl off the balcony and hurl Cuckoo into the orrery, knocking him unconscious.
- (2026-02-19) Endelyn was defeated after Gleam and Glister cast an eclipse and Abbigael hit her with a Chromatic Orb; she aged and shriveled within her shattered contraption.
- (2026-02-19) Endelyn said her books are filed by when she had the visions and she had told her staff that morning that guests would come.
- (2026-02-19) Cuckoo stomped on her body to ensure she was dead.
- (2026-02-19) Endelyn was killed by the party in the orrery at Motherhorn after an eclipse was cast.
- (2026-06-11) The carousel unicorns confirmed Endelyn Moongrave is no more.

chunks.title: Lornlings
chunks.text:
NPC: Lornlings (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-07-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: tiny Bavlorna-like spies and servants
Faction: Bavlorna
Location: Bavlorna's Cottage
Status: alive
- (2025-07-24) Lornlings hide in the mouths of the mounted goblin heads to spy on visitors.
- (2025-07-24) Cuckoo captured two Lornlings, who traded information for freedom.
- (2025-07-24) The Lornlings said the pool room mirror leads to the Witchlight Carnival with the password 'Bandersnatch', after giving several variations of the word.
- (2025-07-24) Cuckoo threw both Lornlings out into the swamp as agreed.
- (2025-07-24) Lornlings serve tea in the study and open doors for guests.

chunks.title: Cooky
chunks.text:
NPC: Cooky (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Cookie
Role: cursed chef in Bavlorna's kitchen
Faction: Bavlorna's household
Location: Bavlorna's Kitchen
Attitude to party: friendly, transactional
Status: alive
- (2025-07-24) Cooky was chasing vultures with a bloody cleaver when Cuckoo opened the kitchen door.
- (2025-07-24) Cuckoo and Snarky helped Cooky kill the vultures.
- (2025-07-24) Cooky freed the satyr prisoner Vansel in return, honoring reciprocity.
- (2025-07-24) Cooky said she dislikes Bavlorna and wished the party luck if they plan to kill her.
- (2025-08-07) Cookie said she is bound by a curse and cannot leave the cottage, and that only a dead hag could free her.
- (2025-08-07) Cookie warned that guests are protected but thieves and rule-breakers would be killed or cursed to work with her.
- (2025-08-07) Cookie said she did not get the job by being smart.
- (2025-08-07) Cookie traded a meat hook and a vulture carcass to the party for the remains of whatever they killed, sealing the deal with a spit-and-handshake with Snarky.
- (2025-08-07) Cookie helped the party scoop up the gelatinous cube remains in pots for her monster desserts such as face melter pudding and I can't feel my feet jello.
- (2025-08-07) Cookie said the floor above is hag stuff and a bad idea to intrude on.

chunks.title: Vansel
chunks.text:
NPC: Vansel (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-07-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: satyr prisoner freed by the party
Location: Witchlight Carnival
Attitude to party: grateful
Status: alive
- (2025-07-24) Vansel is a starved satyr from Thither who was captured after following Clapperclaw into the mists.
- (2025-07-24) Cuckoo took Vansel to the pool room mirror and gave him his carnival ticket, and Vansel escaped to the Witchlight Carnival.
- (2025-07-24) Vansel said Cuckoo resembles an older satyr near the grandfather tree in Thither.

chunks.title: Liorien
chunks.text:
NPC: Liorien (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-07-24) [unconfirmed record]
Role: older satyr near the grandfather tree in Thither
Location: Thither
- (2025-07-24) Vansel said Cuckoo bears a resemblance to Liorien, whose wife left him.

chunks.title: Bullywug Knights
chunks.text:
NPC: Bullywug Knights (first seen 2025-08-07, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Role: escorts assigned by the king
Faction: Soggy Court
Attitude to party: deceived
Status: alive
- (2025-08-07) Two bullywug knights followed the party but were too afraid to enter Bavlorna's cottage.
- (2025-08-07) Snarky, helped by Abbigael, rolled a critical success on deception and convinced the knights the job was done; they hopped away to report to the king.

chunks.title: Illig's Armed Bullywugs
chunks.text:
NPC: Illig's Armed Bullywugs (first seen 2025-08-07, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Role: followers of Illig
Location: Illig's hut
- (2025-08-07) Several armored, armed bullywugs were in Illig's hut, some nervous and jittery.

chunks.title: Gelatinous Cube
chunks.text:
NPC: Gelatinous Cube (first seen 2025-08-07, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Role: ooze clogging Bavlorna's well
Status: dead
- (2025-08-07) Cuckoo identified the well blockage as likely a gelatinous cube with a nature check.
- (2025-08-07) The cube was lured up with vulture meat, pushed away from the well by Istyl, and destroyed by Abbigael's chromatic orb before it acted.

chunks.title: Flying Hat
chunks.text:
NPC: Flying Hat (first seen 2025-08-07, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Charm's hat
Role: Charm's pet
Faction: Charm
- (2025-08-07) The hat flew from a doll stand onto Charm's head; Charm called it a pet, and Abbigael noted it was non-magical.

chunks.title: Emerald Whisperer
chunks.text:
NPC: Emerald Whisperer (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2025-10-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: the green one
Role: entity with whom Granny Nightshade made a pact for power in the Dreadwood
- (2025-08-21) The Book of Bad Blood records that the Emerald Whisperer's deal gave Granny Nightshade a kingdom, the Dreadwood, on the material plane.
- (2025-10-30) The dying green dragon wyrmling warned the party that the Emerald Whisperer will destroy them.

chunks.title: Tasha
chunks.text:
NPC: Tasha (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2025-10-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: fourth hag sister
Status: unknown, 'not around anymore'
- (2025-08-21) Her portrait hangs alongside the three hag sisters' in Skabitha's tree.
- (2025-08-21) Bavlorna was evasive about Tasha, called her especially ugly and said she is not around anymore.
- (2025-10-30) The party discussed Tasha as the fourth sister who may be connected to Iggwilv, whose cauldron froze time and imprisoned Zybilna.
- (2025-10-30) Tasha's animated portrait is among the five in Loomlurch's portrait gallery.

chunks.title: Vulp
chunks.text:
NPC: Vulp (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: bullywug conspirator
Faction: Illig's conspirators
- (2025-08-21) Vulp took position on the lily pads during the assassination.

chunks.title: Gillibeck
chunks.text:
NPC: Gillibeck (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: bullywug conspirator
Faction: Illig's conspirators
- (2025-08-21) Named as a conspirator working with Illig against King Gullop.

chunks.title: Glorig
chunks.text:
NPC: Glorig (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: bullywug conspirator
Faction: Illig's conspirators
- (2025-08-21) Named as a conspirator working with Illig against King Gullop.

chunks.title: Grundelkrantz
chunks.text:
NPC: Grundelkrantz (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]
Role: bullywug conspirator
Faction: Illig's conspirators
- (2025-08-21) Named as a conspirator working with Illig against King Gullop.

chunks.title: Will of the Feywild
chunks.text:
NPC: Will of the Feywild (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Will
Role: leader of the Getaway Gang of rescued children
Faction: children of Little Oak
Location: Little Oak
Status: alive, cursed
Attitude to party: cooperative
- (2025-09-18) Will is a boy with large curly hair, wanted by Granny Nightshade.
- (2025-09-18) The party noted that Will resembles Istyl.
- (2025-09-18) Nib described Will as a tricky child who can vanish and has freed other children from Granny Nightshade.
- (2025-09-18) Nib said Will lives at Little Oak under a treant's protection.
- (2025-10-16) Will came out with his displacer beast kitten after Abbigael offered goblin candy.
- (2025-10-16) Will lent the party the swimming horse costume in exchange for help rescuing more children, keeping Cuckoo as collateral.
- (2025-10-16) Will explained to Cuckoo a three-part plan to rescue children from Loomlurch using a twig-and-stone map.
- (2025-10-16) Istyl's insight check suggested Will might not actually be a child.
- (2025-10-16) Will has rescued three children from Granny Nightshade so far.
- (2025-10-30) Will said the supply of children to Granny Nightshade has recently dried up but was reticent to say more.
- (2025-10-30) Istyl and Abbigael used good cop/bad cop tactics to press Will; Istyl grabbed him and Abbigael played good cop.
- (2025-10-30) Will admitted he once worked for Granny Nightshade and captured children for her.
- (2025-10-30) Will said he used to look different, bigger and meaner, and was cursed into his current child-like form.

chunks.title: Will of the Feywild (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Will of the Feywild (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-10-30) Will fears that if anyone learns how his transformation happened, the curse could be broken and he would return to his evil self.
- (2025-10-30) The party deduced Will was Granny's source of children, which explains why her supply dried up.
- (2025-10-30) Will refused the magical candy.
- (2025-10-30) Will's gang, called the Getaway Gang, set off the screaming scarecrows as planned.
- (2025-12-06) Will agreed to take the rescued children to Little Oak while the party made false trails.
- (2025-12-06) Will scouted Loomlurch and reported on Skabitha's defensive posture.

chunks.title: Sycamore Dryad
chunks.text:
NPC: Sycamore Dryad (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-09-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: dryad of a felled sycamore
Location: the Dryad's Clearing, in the tree stump
Attitude to party: calmed after hostility
Status: dying
- (2025-09-18) The dryad rose from the stump and commanded awakened shrubs to attack the party as villains.
- (2025-09-18) Cuckoo grappled the dryad on the stump.
- (2025-09-18) Istyl persuaded the dryad that the party was not responsible and wanted to heal Prismere and restore Zybilna.
- (2025-09-18) The dryad said she will wither and die without her tree.
- (2025-09-18) The dryad gave the party three sycamore seeds before sinking back into the stump.

chunks.title: Dancing Mushrooms
chunks.text:
NPC: Dancing Mushrooms (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-09-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: fairy ring mushrooms
Role: dancing and singing toadstools
Location: Fairy Ring
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-09-18) The mushrooms mimicked Istyl's dancing, which granted her true sight.
- (2025-09-18) Cuckoo taught the mushrooms 'The Wind That Shakes the Barley' and they combined it with Istyl's dance.
- (2025-09-18) The performance restored heroic inspiration to Cuckoo and Istyl and gave Cuckoo a charm of heroism.

chunks.title: Nib
chunks.text:
NPC: Nib (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-10-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: cursed blindfolded old man who spins gold into magical gifts
Faction: cursed by Granny Nightshade
Location: Nib's Cave
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive, cursed
- (2025-09-18) Nib said he was a cruel landlord who exploited tenants and was cursed to spin his ill-gotten coins into gifts for visitors.
- (2025-09-18) Nib has 27,213 coins left to spin before his curse ends.
- (2025-09-18) Nib gave Snarky gloves of thievery, Istyl a cloak of protection and Cuckoo an air elemental hourglass.
- (2025-09-18) Istyl saw the spirits of those Nib wronged haunting him, which is why he wears a blindfold.
- (2025-09-18) Nib explained the geography of Loomlurch, the Grandfather Tree and Little Oak.
- (2025-09-18) Nib offered his cave as a safe haven.
- (2025-10-16) Nib explained that he must give away all his gold as gifts to break his curse.
- (2025-10-16) He made Abbigael a gold sunflower-like amulet that makes it harder for hags and family to find her.

chunks.title: Singing Mushroom
chunks.text:
NPC: Singing Mushroom (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-09-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: mushroom bathing in melted butter
Location: Goblin Campfire
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-09-18) The singing mushroom said it was preparing for a bath, not to be cooked.

chunks.title: Goblin Woodcutter
chunks.text:
NPC: Goblin Woodcutter (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-09-18) [unconfirmed record]
Role: forest goblin, friend of the singing mushroom
Location: Goblin Campfire
Attitude to party: fearful but friendly
- (2025-09-18) Cuckoo used insight and judged the goblin terrified but harmless.
- (2025-09-18) The goblin gave the party candy sticks per fae reciprocity and the party gave lizard jerky from Saltmarsh.
- (2025-09-18) The goblin recommended the goblin market for amazing candy.

chunks.title: Lirian
chunks.text:
NPC: Lirian (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: satyr, father of Cuckoo
Location: Grandfather Tree
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive, memories taken
- (2025-09-18) Lirian is a twenty-year-old satyr who speaks in a calm, soothing voice.
- (2025-09-18) Lirian said Granny Nightshade took his memories and believes he might be Cuckoo's father.
- (2025-09-18) Lirian mentioned a unicorn living near the Wayward Pool and gave directions to Little Oak.
- (2025-09-18) Lirian told Cuckoo they would have much to discuss once his memories are restored.
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna confirmed Lirian bargained away his memories to Granny Nightshade.

chunks.title: Red Caps
chunks.text:
NPC: Red Caps (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: redcaps
Role: murderous fae wielding rusty sickles
Faction: grown by Granny Nightshade
Status: three defeated
- (2025-09-18) Istyl used true sight to see that three goats were transformed red caps.
- (2025-09-18) Cuckoo punched a goat, which turned back into a red cap and started combat.
- (2025-09-18) Snarky shot another goat, turning it into a red cap, and later landed a 23-damage sneak attack critical.
- (2025-09-18) The party killed all the red caps.
- (2025-12-06) Eight Red Caps patrol Loomlurch in irregular patterns, and no new ones are being grown.

chunks.title: Grandfather Tree Pixies
chunks.text:
NPC: Grandfather Tree Pixies (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-09-18) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: pixies
Role: 24 pixies living in tiny twig houses
Location: Grandfather Tree
Attitude to party: grateful, friendly
- (2025-09-18) The pixies said they turned the red caps into goats with their magic.
- (2025-09-18) The pixies celebrated the party's victory and shared information about red caps and Granny Nightshade.

chunks.title: Owlbear
chunks.text:
NPC: Owlbear (first seen 2025-09-18, last seen 2025-10-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: owlbear yoked to an abandoned elven chariot
Location: forest path
Attitude to party: approaching
Status: tamed as Juniper
- (2025-09-18) The owlbear appeared domesticated and alert.
- (2025-09-18) The owlbear detected the party's hushed voices and began prowling toward them.
- (2025-10-16) The owlbear proved to be Juniper, a trained chariot owlbear wearing a harness with a golden disc carved with a juniper branch.

chunks.title: Juniper
chunks.text:
NPC: Juniper (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2025-10-16) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Juniper the Owlbear
Role: trained female owlbear that pulls the chariot
Location: Little Oak
Attitude to party: docile and friendly when fed
Status: alive
- (2025-10-16) Istyl offered friendship jerky while speaking broken Sylvan; the owlbear lunged clumsily and clawed her arm for 9 slashing damage.
- (2025-10-16) Cuckoo hit the owlbear twice with thunder-enhanced unarmed strikes for 7 and 9 damage.
- (2025-10-16) Abbigael threw dried meat around it and called the name Juniper; the owlbear recognized the name in Common and calmed down.
- (2025-10-16) The party gained Juniper as a companion able to pull their chariot; she needs about 8 pounds of meat daily to stay docile.

chunks.title: Winterbow
chunks.text:
NPC: Winterbow (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2025-10-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elderly centaur
Location: heading to the Grandfather Tree
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-10-16) Winterbow warned the party that Prismere is fading due to encroaching mists.
- (2025-10-16) He said Little Oak holds protected children and Loomlurch houses the hag and her goblins.
- (2025-10-16) He said a Jabberwock from the palace has been snatching creatures, including the elf who owned Juniper's chariot.
- (2025-10-16) He said he is too old to keep up with his clan and will spend his final days at the Grandfather Tree.

chunks.title: Lamorna
chunks.text:
NPC: Lamorna (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: unicorn, friend of Eladon
Location: lake in Thither
Attitude to party: friendly; forgave the party
Status: alive, stabbed twice
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna spoke telepathically and revealed that the hag sisters imprisoned Zybilna after capturing Lamorna's beloved Elidon and stealing his horn.
- (2025-10-16) She told the party that the alicorn was used to imprison Zybilna and may be the key to freeing her.
- (2025-10-16) She told them about Amidor, a talking dandelion in Yon who can guide them to the Palace of Heart's Desire, and warned about the Jabberwock there.
- (2025-10-16) She altered her magic so the party can return to the lake without the costume, and offered to remove diseases and poisons three times per day.
- (2025-10-16) An orc assassin stabbed her twice and she teleported away.
- (2025-10-16) She later forgave the party for inadvertently leading the assassin to her.
- (2025-12-06) Cuckoo lit the brazier at the Wayward Pool and summoned Lamorna, who had fully recovered from her injuries.
- (2025-12-06) Lamorna said Bavlorna likely intended to curse the party through the portrait bargain and that the pool could cleanse curses.
- (2025-12-06) Lamorna said a Jabberwock prowls the Palace of Heart's Desire and must never see the party.
- (2025-12-06) Lamorna said Amidor in Yon knows the way to the palace.
- (2025-12-06) Lamorna suggested the magic freezing Zybilna may involve her friend Eladon's horn, which might be recoverable and restorable.

chunks.title: Lamorna (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Lamorna (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-28) Eladon said he and Lamorna will come to the party's aid when called.

chunks.title: Elidon
chunks.text:
NPC: Elidon (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Eladon
Role: unicorn
Faction: captive of the hag sisters
Status: alive, restored
Location: Thither
Attitude to party: grateful, pledged aid
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna said the hag sisters captured Elidon and stole his horn, which became the alicorn.
- (2025-12-06) Lamorna called Eladon her friend and said his horn may be involved in freezing Zybilna.
- (2026-05-28) Abbigael touched the wooden rocking horse with the unicorn horn and spoke the name Eladon, transforming it into a hornless unicorn.
- (2026-05-28) Istyl used Healing Hands to bond the horn back onto Eladon's head, restoring his intelligence.
- (2026-05-28) Eladon spoke telepathically, thanked the party, and pledged aid.
- (2026-05-28) Eladon and Lamorna will come when called.

chunks.title: Amidor
chunks.text:
NPC: Amidor (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Amador
Role: three-foot-tall dramatic dandelion with a rapier; guide to the Palace of Heart's Desire
Location: Yon
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna said Amidor is outspoken and prone to wooing visitors but takes rejection well, and is the only known guide to the palace.
- (2025-12-06) Amidor met the party in Yon after Istyl waved and greeted him.
- (2025-12-06) Amidor confirmed he knows the way to the Palace of Heart's Desire but warned of the Jabberwock.
- (2025-12-06) Amidor led the party toward Lockbury Henge.
- (2025-12-11) Amidor attacked Mudlump with a tiny dandelion-leaf sling and hit him in the eye with a dandelion seed.
- (2025-12-11) Amidor told the party about Prince Elgarthus, who made a bargain with Endelyn that left him unable to find his way out of Yon.
- (2025-12-11) Amidor fell asleep to the Brigganock mine's sleep effect.
- (2026-01-08) Amidor and Gleam distracted Fina with tea parties and play-acting while the party examined the horn.
- (2026-01-22) Amidor hit the wooden owlbear with his seed sling for a critical hit.
- (2026-01-22) Amidor said he knows the way to the palace once Gleam and her sister are safe.
- (2026-02-19) Amidor dumped a bucket of living coals onto Endelyn from above.
- (2026-02-19) Amidor fetched Gleam and Glister to cast the eclipse.

chunks.title: Jabberwock
chunks.text:
NPC: Jabberwock (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Fae dragon occupying the palace
Location: Grand Ballroom, coiled around the black iron cauldron
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, dismissed from the palace
- (2025-10-16) Abbigael explained that Jabberwocks are cruel fae dragons that cause emotional suffering and are vulnerable only to the Vorpal Sword.
- (2025-10-16) The Jabberwock occupying the palace has been snatching creatures, including Juniper's former charioteer.
- (2025-12-06) The Jabberwock prowls the Palace of Heart's Desire and has tried many times to reach the Wayward Pool.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) Envy said the Jabberwock serves the Queen and that all current visitors were invited before any usurping.
- (2026-04-16) The party saw the Jabberwock asleep, coiled around the black iron cauldron in the frozen ballroom.
- (2026-04-16) The Jabberwock woke when Cuckoo called the cauldron 'Spittle Spew' and said that was not its name.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the Jabberwock is loyal to Zybilna, which keeps the League of Malevolence away from the cauldron.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the Vorpal Blade Snickersnack is the only weapon capable of truly harming the Jabberwock.
- (2026-04-16) The party chose not to attack the sleeping Jabberwock and retreated to explore further.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart confirmed Zybilna had banned the Jabberwock from the palace, so its nesting in the ballroom shows she is truly frozen.
- (2026-05-28) The Jabberwock paused when it saw Istyl in the legendary uniform holding Snickersnack.

chunks.title: Jabberwock (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Jabberwock (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-28) Zybilna commanded the Jabberwock to leave and it retreated out of the ballroom through the pond.

chunks.title: Zarak
chunks.text:
NPC: Zarak (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2026-04-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: assassin
Faction: League of Malevolence
Status: alive, escaped into the border mists
- (2025-10-16) Istyl recalled him from a wanted poster from her home world.
- (2025-10-16) He attacked Lamorna, killed a blink dog, and fled east.
- (2025-10-16) His trail ended at the border mists where he met two accomplices and all three entered the mists.
- (2025-12-06) Elkhorn named Zarak, an orc assassin, as a member of the League of Malevolence.
- (2026-04-16) GMAssistant noted Zarak as an assassin of the League of Malevolence who is currently at large.

chunks.title: Blink Dogs
chunks.text:
NPC: Blink Dogs (first seen 2025-10-16, last seen 2025-10-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: pack of five fae blink dogs
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive, mourning one packmate
- (2025-10-16) The party found them burying a packmate killed by the hooded orc.
- (2025-10-16) Abbigael spoke Elvish with them and learned they want revenge.
- (2025-10-16) Cuckoo placed an owlbear balloon toy in the grave as an offering.
- (2025-10-16) The blink dogs could not pass through the border mists.

chunks.title: Chucklehead
chunks.text:
NPC: Chucklehead (first seen 2025-10-30, last seen 2025-10-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: goblin with a toffee apple head at the goblin market
Location: Goblin market, Loomlurch
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive
- (2025-10-30) Chucklehead's head appears to be a real toffee apple with a maggot inside that he says keeps him relaxed and compliant.
- (2025-10-30) Chucklehead told Istyl he wants to rescue Mishka from Granny's kitchen but fears being baked.
- (2025-10-30) Chucklehead pointed out the kitchen's location and said red caps sleep during the day, making daytime safer.
- (2025-10-30) Chucklehead has a plan to get Granny to leave so someone could rescue Mishka.

chunks.title: Mishka
chunks.text:
NPC: Mishka (first seen 2025-10-30, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: young human girl held captive in Granny Nightshade's kitchen
Location: Granny Nightshade's Kitchen
Status: alive, freed
Attitude to party: cooperative
- (2025-10-30) Mishka was found chained to a work table peeling potatoes in the kitchen.
- (2025-10-30) Mishka is a friend of Chucklehead.
- (2025-11-13) Snarky picked the lock on Mishka's manacles and freed her.
- (2025-11-13) Mishka helped James Elkhorn find his sword and shield in a kitchen cupboard.
- (2025-11-13) Mishka is a mouse-like child and is terrified of the tin soldiers.
- (2025-11-13) Mishka escaped with the party.

chunks.title: Goblin Merchants
chunks.text:
NPC: Goblin Merchants (first seen 2025-10-30, last seen 2025-10-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: goblin candy sellers
Role: candy sellers at the goblin market
Faction: exclusive deal with Granny Nightshade
Location: Goblin Market
Attitude to party: transactional
- (2025-10-30) Six goblins work in pairs at three candy stalls selling magical candies made with insects.
- (2025-10-30) Istyl traded a ball and cup trinket to the goblins for six pieces of candy.

chunks.title: Green Dragon Wyrmling
chunks.text:
NPC: Green Dragon Wyrmling (first seen 2025-10-30, last seen 2025-10-30) [unconfirmed record]
Role: guard in Granny Nightshade's kitchen
Location: Granny Nightshade's Kitchen
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-10-30) The wyrmling emerged from behind the oven and attacked when the party entered the kitchen.
- (2025-10-30) Abbigael demanded in Draconic that it stand down and it refused.
- (2025-10-30) Cuckoo grappled it and pummeled it with his fists, and Istyl delivered the killing blow.

chunks.title: Imprisoned Dwarf
chunks.text:
NPC: Imprisoned Dwarf (first seen 2025-10-30, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: armored dwarf imprisoned by the hag; fights alongside the party
Location: Granny Nightshade's Kitchen
Status: alive, freed
Attitude to party: friendly
Faction: Valor's Call
- (2025-10-30) A dwarf with a rough, deep voice called out to be freed from beneath the kitchen floor grate.
- (2025-11-13) The dwarf introduced himself as James Elkhorn from a gray enclosure and said the hag hated him and now likely hated the party too.
- (2025-11-13) Snarky picked the lock on the enclosure and freed Elkhorn.
- (2025-11-13) Elkhorn retrieved his sword and shield from a cupboard with Mishka's help.
- (2025-11-13) Elkhorn fought the tin soldiers with his longsword, using feints to land critical hits.
- (2025-11-13) Elkhorn and Nal stayed in the workshop to try forging a new key from molten lead.
- (2025-12-06) Elkhorn revealed he is part of Valor's Call, hunting the League of Malevolence.
- (2025-12-06) Elkhorn's companions are trapped, frozen in time, in the Palace of Heart's Desire with Zybilna.

chunks.title: Workshop Children
chunks.text:
NPC: Workshop Children (first seen 2025-10-30, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: children in Loomlurch's workshop
Location: Loomlurch workshop
Status: alive
- (2025-10-30) Abbigael saw three children in the workshop, one dancing on a table with a bar of soap as if it were a prize.
- (2025-11-13) The party found three children around a workbench in the workshop, including Nal.
- (2025-11-13) The children said Roff and Wendell were in the sewing room, and Broder and Duppy in the upstairs bedroom.

chunks.title: Nal
chunks.text:
NPC: Nal (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: eldest child found in the workshop
Location: Loomlurch workshop
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2025-11-13) Nal hid a bar of soap behind his back when the party entered, then revealed it was split in half and held a perfect impression of a key from the hag's ring.
- (2025-11-13) Nal stayed with Elkhorn to try forging a new key from the impression using molten lead.

chunks.title: Roff
chunks.text:
NPC: Roff (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: plump halfling boy captive
Location: Loomlurch
Status: alive, freed
- (2025-11-13) Roff was found working at a bench in the sewing room.
- (2025-11-13) Abbigael persuaded Roff and Wendell to leave the room and go downstairs.

chunks.title: Wendell
chunks.text:
NPC: Wendell (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: young fluffy bugbear child captive
Location: Loomlurch
Status: alive, freed
- (2025-11-13) Wendell was found working at a bench in the sewing room.
- (2025-11-13) Abbigael persuaded Wendell and Roff to leave the room and go downstairs.

chunks.title: Broder
chunks.text:
NPC: Broder (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: child captive
Location: bedroom upstairs, Loomlurch
Status: alive, still trapped
- (2025-11-13) Nal said Broder is in the upstairs bedroom.

chunks.title: Duppy
chunks.text:
NPC: Duppy (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: child captive
Location: bedroom upstairs, Loomlurch
Status: alive, still trapped
- (2025-11-13) Nal said Duppy is in the upstairs bedroom.

chunks.title: Waddling Drum
chunks.text:
NPC: Waddling Drum (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: leader of the tin soldiers
Location: Toy Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-11-13) Cuckoo leaped onto the drum and dented it, and Istyl blasted it with magical force and necrotic energy.
- (2025-11-13) Snarky's critical arrow shattered the drum, leaving the tin soldiers disoriented and stunned.

chunks.title: Tin Soldiers
chunks.text:
NPC: Tin Soldiers (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: clockwork tin soldiers
Role: clockwork constructs guarding the toy room
Location: Toy Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-11-13) Cask-shaped tin soldiers marched out of the toy houses when the party opened the door and attacked with metal fists.
- (2025-11-13) Abbigael's flaming sphere and Hellish Rebuke melted soldiers, and her Grease spell knocked several prone.
- (2025-11-13) The party destroyed all the tin soldiers; Abbigael's flaming sphere melted the last one.

chunks.title: Animated Doll
chunks.text:
NPC: Animated Doll (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: overseer of the sewing room
Location: Sewing Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-11-13) The doll accused the party of trespassing, and its cackling left Istyl incapacitated by painful laughter.
- (2025-11-13) The doll healed from damage until it took fire damage.
- (2025-11-13) Snarky's arrow severed the doll's head, and it fell silent.

chunks.title: Animated Carpet
chunks.text:
NPC: Animated Carpet (first seen 2025-11-13, last seen 2025-11-13) [unconfirmed record]
Role: guard in the sewing room
Location: Sewing Room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2025-11-13) The carpet grappled and blinded Cuckoo, and later grappled Istyl.
- (2025-11-13) Snarky helped Istyl escape the grapple with his short sword.
- (2025-11-13) Cuckoo destroyed the carpet with flaming fists after Abbigael's firebolt left it bloodied; it burst into flames.

chunks.title: Philomena
chunks.text:
NPC: Philomena (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: rescued child
Status: alive, freed
- (2025-12-06) Philomena retrieved her beloved Piglet from its pen during the escape.

chunks.title: Piglet
chunks.text:
NPC: Piglet (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: pig from Loomlurch garden pens
Status: alive, rescued
- (2025-12-06) Piglet followed Philomena loyally as the group fled.

chunks.title: Lyrian Duskleaf
chunks.text:
NPC: Lyrian Duskleaf (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Lyrian
Role: satyr; believed to be Cuckoo's birth father
Location: Wayward Pool
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-12-06) Lyrian recognized the female satyr portrait as Thistlebell, a past sweetheart who warned him never to deal with hags.
- (2025-12-06) Lyrian said many of his memories have been stolen or traded away.
- (2025-12-06) Lyrian agreed to accompany the party to the Wayward Pool, leaving the pixies to tend the ailing Grandfather Tree.

chunks.title: Thistlebell
chunks.text:
NPC: Thistlebell (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: female satyr chambermaid; believed to be Cuckoo's mother
Location: Loomlurch
Status: alive, in service
- (2025-12-06) Her portrait shows her older and worn, still in service at Loomlurch.},{

chunks.title: Squirt
