NPC: Squirt (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: animated oil can; guide to Yon
Location: Yon
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive
- (2025-12-06) Granny Nightshade created Squirt, but he prefers living at Little Oak.
- (2025-12-06) Squirt guided the party through the mists to Yon and craves boggle oil.
- (2025-12-11) Squirt squirted boggle oil under Mudlump's feet, making him fall prone.

chunks.title: Gleam
chunks.text:
NPC: Gleam (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Selenelion twin
Role: elf in crescent moon mask; former Witchlight Carnival performer
Location: Yon
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive, reunited with sister
- (2025-12-06) Gleam said her twin sister is imprisoned in Motherhorn.
- (2025-12-06) Gleam hinted that a metaphorical eclipse involving the reunited twins might fulfill Endelyn's prophecy.
- (2025-12-11) Gleam tried to hit Mudlump with a moonlight beam from her mask but missed because he was prone.
- (2025-12-11) Gleam fell asleep to the Brigganock mine's sleep effect.
- (2026-01-08) Gleam worried that Endelyn would recognize her as one of the twins.
- (2026-01-22) Gleam hid during the fight with the animated props.
- (2026-01-22) Breakaleg asked Gleam whether she would tell on him for escaping.
- (2026-02-19) Gleam was reunited with her sister Glister in Motherhorn's prison.
- (2026-02-19) Gleam stepped in front of Glister to cast an eclipse shadow over Endelyn.

chunks.title: Polanella
chunks.text:
NPC: Polanella (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: giant honeybee, Amidor's companion
Status: alive
- (2025-12-06) Polanella hid in Amidor's blossom in fear at the sight of Mudlump, her former captor.

chunks.title: Mudlump
chunks.text:
NPC: Mudlump (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: beekeeper cyclops
Role: beekeeper cyclops who brews mead
Location: his cave home in the Fae Wild
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, knocked unconscious
- (2025-12-06) Mudlump called out 'Where you go?' and said 'There you are' on spotting Amidor and Polanella.
- (2025-12-11) Mudlump came out of the mountain passes of Yon calling for Paulinella and speaking only Giant, which no one in the party understood.
- (2025-12-11) The party tried Common, Goblin and Sylvan with him without success.
- (2025-12-11) Istyl lighting a torch enraged Mudlump and he charged, starting combat.
- (2025-12-11) Cuckoo delivered the final non-lethal blow and knocked Mudlump unconscious.
- (2025-12-11) Mudlump lives in a hollowed-out petrified tree trunk and brews mead in three hollowed-out mushroom casks.

chunks.title: Hourglass Goats
chunks.text:
NPC: Hourglass Goats (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Goats (Yon)
Role: three buffalo-sized prophetic goats
Location: Yon
Status: alive
- (2025-12-06) The goats delivered three prophecies in exchange for rations.

chunks.title: Alagarthas
chunks.text:
NPC: Alagarthas (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-06) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elven prince trapped by a bargain
Location: Yon
- (2025-12-06) Amidor and Gleam named him as someone the party could help to gain allies.

chunks.title: Korreds
chunks.text:
NPC: Korreds (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: stout fey with iron-hard hair
Location: Lochbury Henge
Attitude to party: friendly, allied
- (2025-12-06) Korreds gather and dance at Lockbury Henge.
- (2025-12-11) Eight Korreds emerged from the megaliths and danced to Istyl's music, and their moods cleared the weather.
- (2025-12-11) The Korreds had built angry statues to scare off the Brigganock, which only slowed the digging.
- (2025-12-11) Cuckoo convinced the Korreds that Endelyn had played them against the Brigganock, and they made peace.
- (2025-12-11) The Korreds pledged to help the party in Motherhorn when called upon.

chunks.title: League of Malevolence
chunks.text:
NPC: League of Malevolence (first seen 2025-12-06, last seen 2026-04-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: villains hunted by Valor's Call
Location: Palace of Heart's Desire
- (2025-12-06) Elkhorn listed its members as Zarak, Keledek, Warduke, Zargash and Skylla.
- (2026-01-22) Elkhorn identified Charmay as Skylla of the League of Malevolence.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the League consists of Keledek, Warduke and Zargash, left in the palace by the hag coven to guard the cauldron.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the League cannot get near the cauldron because the Jabberwock is loyal to Zybilna.

chunks.title: Paulinella
chunks.text:
NPC: Paulinella (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: queen bee of Mudlump's main hive
Location: nestled in Amidor's bloom
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-12-11) Paulinella felt torn between her hive family and her adventures with the party.
- (2025-12-11) She hid in Amidor's bloom during the fight.
- (2025-12-11) After Mudlump fell, she calmed the bees, led them back to the hive, then returned to Amidor.

chunks.title: Elkhorn
chunks.text:
NPC: Elkhorn (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Elkorn
Role: companion of the party, former member of Valor's Call
Faction: Valor's Call
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive, wounded and healed
- (2025-12-11) Elkhorn recognized Molliver as a former Valor's Call companion and they had an emotional reunion.
- (2025-12-11) Elkhorn was yanked out by a hag, who questioned him and kept him under her kitchen floor.
- (2025-12-11) Elkhorn struggled to land effective attacks against Mudlump.
- (2026-01-22) Elkhorn recognized Charmay as Skylla of the League of Malevolence.
- (2026-01-22) Elkhorn fought the wooden owlbear, struggled to hit it, and was bloodied by a 12-damage hit.
- (2026-01-22) Elkhorn and Cuckoo destroyed the wooden owlbear.
- (2026-02-19) Elkhorn hauled the unconscious Cuckoo out of the lightning zone with a rope and gave him a healing potion.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) Elkorn took the borrowed Woodcutter's Axe into his keeping.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) Elkorn leapt into the Rose Garden, became stuck in webs, and struck a wounded Ettercap with the axe.
- (2026-04-16) Elkhorn led the party to the double doors on the left side of the mezzanine and pushed them open.
- (2026-04-16) Elkhorn used the magical hooks to turn invisible.
- (2026-04-16) Elkhorn identified the frozen armored woman near the cauldron as Mercion, one of their allies.
- (2026-04-16) Elkhorn revealed himself to Thinnings, who recognized him as a friend.
- (2026-04-16) Elkhorn grabbed a white rose and walked the length of the rose room without incident.

chunks.title: Elkhorn (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Elkhorn (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-14) Elkhorn helped haul Strongheart over the edge after his rescue.
- (2026-05-14) Elkhorn charged Warduke first in the throne room and was left barely standing by two blows.
- (2026-05-14) Istyl restored ten hit points to Elkhorn with Healing Hands after combat.
- (2026-05-14) Elkhorn helped Strongheart guard the bound prisoners.

chunks.title: Argantle
chunks.text:
NPC: Argantle (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Argantel
Role: Korred
Location: Lochbury Henge
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-12-11) Argantle burst from a stone cheering when Abbigael won the Heaven and Hell game for the shale side.
- (2025-12-11) Argantle said Endelyn had captured her and stolen her hair for wires and ropes, and that she escaped with help from others.
- (2025-12-11) Argantle squeezed a stone into a warm star sapphire and gave it to Abbigael.
- (2025-12-11) Argantle hurled a huge rock toward the mining sound, screaming 'Death to the Brigganock!'

chunks.title: Brigganock
chunks.text:
NPC: Brigganock (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Brigganocks
Role: mouse-sized fae miners
Location: Brigganock Mine
Attitude to party: friendly, allied
Status: alive
- (2025-12-11) The Brigganock mine wishstones, and their mining rhythm puts intruders to sleep.
- (2025-12-11) They carted the sleeping party deeper into the mine.
- (2025-12-11) Several Brigganock hid in the party's backpacks and listened during the Korred talks.
- (2025-12-11) The Brigganock made peace with the Korreds and pledged to help in Motherhorn.

chunks.title: Molliver
chunks.text:
NPC: Molliver (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]

Faction: Valor's Call (former)
Location: Brigganock Mine
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2025-12-11) Molliver offered mulled wine that woke the sleeping party.
- (2025-12-11) Molliver revealed that Endelyn kidnapped the Brigganock architect Golmo and was stealing Korred hair.
- (2025-12-11) Molliver said he escaped before the time freeze.
- (2025-12-11) Molliver offered to guide the party through the secret tunnel to Motherhorn.
- (2026-01-08) Molliver guided the party through the mine tunnels to Ribbon Wish Chasm.
- (2026-01-08) He explained that crossing the chasm is a rite of passage to learn the secret passage's location.

chunks.title: Trig
chunks.text:
NPC: Trig (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Brigganock adviser to Molliver
Location: Brigganock Mine
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2025-12-11) Trig confirmed that Endelyn had been playing the Brigganock and Korreds against each other.
- (2025-12-11) Molliver suggested telling Golmo that Trig sent the party.

chunks.title: Golmo
chunks.text:
NPC: Golmo (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: brigganock architect forced to draw designs for Endelyn
Location: with the party, in Snarky's pouch
Status: alive, freed
Attitude to party: grateful, friendly
- (2025-12-11) Endelyn kidnapped Golmo and is forcing him to build contraptions.
- (2026-01-22) The party found Golmo chained to a hooded lantern in the Motherhorn workshop; Snarky picked the lock on his chain.
- (2026-01-22) Golmo revealed the wispy light near him was his soul, pulled out by Creeping Lyn, and he put it back in his chest.
- (2026-01-22) Golmo drew a detailed map of Motherhorn and asked the party to burn his designs in Creeping Lyn's library if found.
- (2026-01-22) Golmo hopped into Snarky's pouch to guide the party.

chunks.title: Prince Elgarthus
chunks.text:
NPC: Prince Elgarthus (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Prince Alagarthus, Prince Allagarthus, Crown Prince of Verda
Role: Crown Prince of Verda
Location: returned home to Verda through the lake portal
Status: alive, freed
Attitude to party: grateful, friendly
- (2025-12-11) Elgarthus made a bargain with Endelyn that left him unable to find his way out of Yon.
- (2025-12-11) He is trying to light the Fey Beacons to find his way home.
- (2026-01-08) He said he bargained with Lynn to save his kingdom from a great green dragon and had to spend a year in Yon.
- (2026-01-08) The party distracted the winged actors with a performance while he lit all eight beacons.
- (2026-01-08) He thanked the party, invited them to visit Verda, and leaped through the lake portal home.

chunks.title: Cowled Figure
chunks.text:
NPC: Cowled Figure (first seen 2025-12-11, last seen 2025-12-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: robed figure accompanying the pageant wagon
Faction: Endelyn Moongrave
Status: vanished
- (2025-12-11) The Cowled Figure offered three tickets to a private audience with Endelyn.
- (2025-12-11) It and the wagon vanished when Cuckoo took the last ticket.

chunks.title: Mazalkoth
chunks.text:
NPC: Mazalkoth (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: keeper of stars
Role: ancient astral elf astronomer who claimed to hail from a black star at the edge of night
Status: long gone; a fragment of his psyche passed to Abbigael
- (2026-01-08) His name and an Elvish inscription were carved on a stone throne beneath a brass sun symbol.
- (2026-01-08) Abbigael inherited a fragment of his psyche by sitting on his throne.

chunks.title: Fina
chunks.text:
NPC: Fina (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]
Role: goblin child cursed to fly a cursed kite
Location: her secret cave hideout near the kite hill
Attitude to party: grateful, friendly
Status: alive, freed from the curse
- (2026-01-08) Fina was forced by Creeping Lynn to fly a cursed kite or become 'an old thing'.
- (2026-01-08) The party freed her by cheering her up with music so the wind died, then untying the five blue bows.
- (2026-01-08) Fina said her parents are trapped in Motherhorn because she took one of Endelyn's hats.
- (2026-01-08) Fina hosted the party overnight in her secret cave, which holds hats from Motherhorn.

chunks.title: Cursed Kite
chunks.text:
NPC: Cursed Kite (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Evil Kite, Kite
Role: sentient cackling kite that taunted Fina
Status: blown away into the clouds
- (2026-01-08) The kite's taunts made Fina sadder and the wind stronger.
- (2026-01-08) After the bows were removed it screamed 'No!' and was blown into the clouds.

chunks.title: Winged Actors
chunks.text:
NPC: Winged Actors (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: winged creatures, transformed actors
Role: eight antlered, eagle-headed creatures, formerly actors transformed by Lynn
Location: northern lake
Attitude to party: delighted audience
- (2026-01-08) They put out Prince Allagarthus's beacons for dramatic effect.
- (2026-01-08) Captivated by the party's performance, they sat in two rows and applauded.
- (2026-01-08) One of them gave the party the leather-wrapped unicorn horn.

chunks.title: Obud
chunks.text:
NPC: Obud (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elderly brigganock elder, keeper of the secret tunnel to Motherhorn, carves Wishstones into gemstones
Location: Subterranean Grotto
Attitude to party: warm, hospitable
Status: alive
- (2026-01-08) Obud lives in a small wooden hut on a piebald pony with blinders, accompanied by a wispy bulb of light.
- (2026-01-08) He greeted the party warmly after they crossed the chasm.
- (2026-01-22) Obud welcomed the party, noting they got dinged a bit crossing the chasm, and hosted their long rest.
- (2026-01-22) Obud confirmed a secret tunnel into Motherhorn bypassing its defenses and asked the party to keep it secret from Creeping Lyn.
- (2026-01-22) Obud told the party the tunnel opens into a workshop beneath the stage, likely occupied by goblins.
- (2026-01-22) Obud said Creeping Lyn keeps captives through curses, deals and fear rather than a traditional prison.
- (2026-01-22) Obud warned that Creeping Lyn can see the future accurately but her deals based on those visions never turn out well.
- (2026-01-22) Obud had Keg walk to a spot in the cave to reveal the illusory wall hiding the tunnel.

chunks.title: Flaming Skulls
chunks.text:
NPC: Flaming Skulls (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-01-08) [unconfirmed record]
Role: three disembodied skulls with green flames guarding the Ribbon Wish Chasm bridge
Location: Ribbon Wish Chasm
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: one shattered, two remain
- (2026-01-08) The skulls cast Fireball at the party and are immune to fire.
- (2026-01-08) They did not spot Snarky but attacked the rest of the party.
- (2026-01-08) Snarky shattered one skull with a shot from hiding.
- (2026-01-08) They stopped pursuing once everyone crossed the bridge midpoint.

chunks.title: Keg
chunks.text:
NPC: Keg (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Obud's pony carrying his tiny hut
Location: Subterranean Grotto
- (2026-01-22) Keg walked to the specific spot in the cave that revealed the secret tunnel entrance.

chunks.title: Breakaleg
chunks.text:
NPC: Breakaleg (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: animated skeleton marionette found in Motherhorn's prop storage
Attitude to party: friendly, grateful
Status: alive
- (2026-01-22) Cuckoo untangled Breakaleg's strings and he thanked the party.
- (2026-01-22) Breakaleg revealed Endelyn is terrified of eclipses.
- (2026-01-22) Breakaleg revealed Endelyn wrote a secret about her sister Igwilv on invisible parchment in her library.
- (2026-01-22) Breakaleg said destroying or stealing the lightning rods on Motherhorn's roof would disable her contraptions.
- (2026-01-22) Breakaleg tried to escape through the tunnel but became tangled in the rocks again.
- (2026-02-19) Breakaleg's earlier intel on Endelyn's eclipse fear and the lightning rods shaped the party's plan.

chunks.title: Charmay
chunks.text:
NPC: Charmay (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: imperious stage manager in Motherhorn's workshop preparing a one-woman show
Faction: League of Malevolence
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, wounded, teleported away
- (2026-01-22) Elkhorn recognized Charmay as Skylla from the League of Malevolence and ducked out of sight.
- (2026-01-22) Charmay shouted 'Nocturly' and animated workshop props to attack the party.
- (2026-01-22) Istyl struck Charmay with a booming blade for 15 damage, bloodying her.
- (2026-01-22) Charmay used a crackling staff to teleport away after being wounded.

chunks.title: Motherhorn Goblin Stagehands
chunks.text:
NPC: Motherhorn Goblin Stagehands (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: workshop workers under Creeping Lyn
Location: Motherhorn Workshop
Attitude to party: afraid, cooperative
- (2026-01-22) Two stagehands saw the party and fled without raising an alarm.
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands revealed a jail on Tower Level One and that Hurly performs regularly on stage.
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands said goblins who anger Creeping Lyn are sometimes turned into wooden masks.
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands said Creeping Lyn boarded up a belfry in one of the turrets.
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands operated the manual chain lift to take the party upstairs.

chunks.title: Speckle-Nose

Location: Motherhorn
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands said Speckle-Nose and Zolt are Finia's parents and operate the cranes on the stage level.

chunks.title: Zolt

NPC: Zolt (first seen 2026-01-22, last seen 2026-01-22) [unconfirmed record]
Role: crane operator on Motherhorn's stage level, Fina's parent
Location: Motherhorn
- (2026-01-22) Stagehands said Speckle-Nose and Zolt are Finia's parents and operate the cranes on the stage level.

Faction: Charmay
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: all destroyed
- (2026-01-22) Charmay animated an iron grate, stovepipe, wooden owlbear, coffin, plaster cake table, canvas flesh golem, plaster king statue and a stuffed boar.
- (2026-01-22) The party destroyed all of the animated props.
- (2026-01-22) Snarky destroyed the stuffed boar with a critical hit.
- (2026-01-22) Abbigael's Firebolt made the plaster king statue explode in flames.

chunks.title: Glister

NPC: Glister (first seen 2026-02-19, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: elf with a sun mask, Gleam's sister
Location: Motherhorn
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive, freed
- (2026-02-19) Cuckoo found Glister reading and sipping wine in a comfortable cell, and the party freed her.
- (2026-02-19) Glister shone her sun mask to help form the eclipse that undid Endelyn.

chunks.title: Vex

NPC: Vex (first seen 2026-02-19, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: goblin librarian in Endelyn's library
Location: Motherhorn Library
Status: alive

chunks.title: Finneas's Parents

Location: Motherhorn

- (2026-03-05) An awakened bear that wants to be dumb again is among those waiting to speak with Zybilna.

chunks.text:
NPC: Eberron Noble (first seen 2026-03-05, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: petitioner with a complicated marriage contract
- (2026-03-05) An Eberron noble with a complicated marriage contract is waiting to speak with Zybilna.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The Eberron noble is a human woman seeking escape from a complicated arranged marriage.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) Her distinctive outfit led the party to think the frozen orcish warrior might also be from Eberron.

chunks.title: Badger Minstrels
chunks.text:
NPC: Badger Minstrels (first seen 2026-03-05, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: petitioners waiting to speak with Zybilna
- (2026-03-05) Badger minstrels are among those waiting to speak with Zybilna.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The badger minstrels play soft melodies in the pavilion.

chunks.title: Female Orc
chunks.text:
NPC: Female Orc (first seen 2026-03-05, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: orcish warrior
Role: caught in the time freeze
- (2026-03-05) A female orc was caught in the time freeze.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The orcish warrior is frozen mid-motion in the pavilion, present when the palace was frozen in time.

chunks.title: Halfling
chunks.text:
NPC: Halfling (first seen 2026-03-05, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: caught in the time freeze
- (2026-03-05) A halfling was caught in the time freeze.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The halfling is frozen mid-motion in the pavilion, present when the palace was frozen in time.

chunks.title: Zybina's Butler
chunks.text:
NPC: Zybina's Butler (first seen 2026-03-19, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: claimed butler; told arriving guests to wait
Location: pavilion
Status: unknown
- (2026-03-19) Guests described him as a lanky, soft-spoken fellow in faded brown clothes who told them to wait.
- (2026-03-19) The party is unsure whether he is truly the butler or an impostor.

chunks.title: Envy
chunks.text:
NPC: Envy (first seen 2026-03-19, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: iron lion
Role: iron lion guardian of the palace
Location: Tower of Envy
Attitude to party: demanding but helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-03-19) Envy demanded the party kneel; Abbigael knelt and pulled Istyl down with her, satisfying it.
- (2026-03-19) Envy explained that it and Wrath were created to protect the palace in the Queen's absence.
- (2026-03-19) Envy said the crown is a key to the palace, held by a keeper in Maiden's Pond.
- (2026-03-19) Envy said crowning the correct guardian turns the crown gold, while the wrong one is banished with the crown to a demi-plane.
- (2026-03-19) Envy called Wrath a piece of trash that cannot be trusted.
- (2026-03-19) Envy warned the party to obey the three laws of the Fae: hospitality, reciprocity and ownership.

chunks.title: Wrath
chunks.text:
NPC: Wrath (first seen 2026-03-19, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: iron hart
Role: iron hart guardian of the palace
Location: Tower of Wrath
Attitude to party: friendly after receiving the gift
Status: alive
- (2026-03-19) Wrath let the party enter after they knelt, and said it had worn the crown before.
- (2026-03-19) Wrath enjoys garden berries but cannot gather them; Cuckoo's basket of berries earned its favor.
- (2026-03-19) Istyl crowned Wrath and the silver crown turned into a golden crown of roses, confirming Wrath as the correct guardian.
- (2026-03-19) Wrath said its image would appear over doors now open to the party.
- (2026-03-19) Wrath claimed no knowledge of the Ettercaps and warned the party not to make themselves deserving of vengeance.

chunks.title: Ettercaps
chunks.text:
NPC: Ettercaps (first seen 2026-03-19, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Role: territorial guardians of the Rose Garden
Location: Rose Garden
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, entranced then returned underground
- (2026-03-19) Three Ettercaps burrowed up when Snarky leapt into the webbed Rose Garden, and they poisoned and wounded him.
- (2026-03-19) Istyl tried to talk to them but they only hissed.
- (2026-03-19) Abbigael's hypnotic pattern entranced all three, and they sank back underground as the spell faded.
- (2026-03-19) The party chose not to harm them, to avoid violating hospitality.

chunks.title: Water Spirit
chunks.text:
NPC: Water Spirit (first seen 2026-03-19, last seen 2026-03-19) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: keeper of Maiden's Pond
Role: keeper of the crown of silver needles
Location: Maiden's Pond
Status: alive
- (2026-03-19) It manifests as a hand of black water above a humanoid shape formed by black fish.
- (2026-03-19) It refused to release the crown to a longsword hook but let Istyl take it by hand.
- (2026-03-19) It whispered a Sylvan riddle to Istyl whose answer is WRATH.

chunks.title: Thinnings
chunks.text:
NPC: Thinnings (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: skinny Fae butler who feeds on secrets
Location: Staff Workroom, Palace of Heart's Desire
Attitude to party: friendly
Status: alive
- (2026-04-16) Abbigael spotted Thinnings hiding under a bed in the staff workroom, the only unfrozen figure there.
- (2026-04-16) Cuckoo gave Thinnings a piece of Sella's jerky as goodwill and offered him safety in the garden pavilion.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said only the great owl Bloodybeak can fight the Jabberwock.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said Snickersnack is at the top of the central tower vault.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said freeing someone frozen in time requires touching them with the alicorn horn while speaking their true name.
- (2026-04-16) Abbigael won Thinnings' full trust by whispering that her childhood pet was a three-headed dog.
- (2026-05-14) Thinnings guided the party through the palace kitchen and lower halls.
- (2026-05-14) Thinnings warned of a Fomorian eating everything in the banquet hall and of Bloody Beak in the aviary.
- (2026-05-14) Thinnings mentioned the palace library and its librarian Shon, who might know about the Infinite Archive.

chunks.title: Mercion
chunks.text:
NPC: Mercion (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Mercyon
Role: armored woman in a white cape
Location: Grand Ballroom
Status: alive, freed from stasis
Faction: Valor's Call
- (2026-04-16) Elkhorn identified the frozen armored woman near the cauldron as Mercion.
- (2026-05-28) Mercyon was found frozen near Zybilna's cauldron in the ballroom.
- (2026-05-28) Mercyon helped bind Zargash in the western tower.

chunks.title: Strongheart
chunks.text:
NPC: Strongheart (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: human paladin with a commanding mustache and heavy plate mail
Location: returning to the material plane with prisoners
Status: alive, freed from time stasis
Faction: Valor's Call
Attitude to party: friendly
- (2026-04-16) The party saw Strongheart frozen mid-fall outside the first tower's blown-out wall.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings identified him as the leader of the party's allied heroes.
- (2026-05-14) Abbigael flew out into the Court of Storms, touched Strongheart with the alicorn and spoke his name, freeing him from the time freeze without consuming the horn.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart fell until the rope anchored to the palace staircase caught him, then climbed hand over hand back to the stairs in plate mail.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart greeted the unfamiliar party cheerfully, not realizing he had been frozen for a long time.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart said Keledek blasted him through the tower wall.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart confirmed the Jabberwock was banned from the palace, so its presence proves Zybilna is truly frozen.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart was blasted by Keledek in the throne room battle, then charged Warduke, hit him three times and blinded him with holy light.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart revivified the slain Warduke so he could face justice, and rebuked Snarky's suggestion to cut out Keledek's tongue.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart and Elkhorn took custody of the bound prisoners Keledek and Warduke.

chunks.title: Strongheart (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Strongheart (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-05-28) Strongheart recognized Snickersnack as the vorpal sword Zybilna kept to hold dominion over the Jabberwock.
- (2026-05-28) Strongheart and Valor's Call agreed to escort all the prisoners back to the material plane to face justice.
- (2026-05-28) Strongheart arranged for the party's reward to be held by the Sheriff of Burle.

chunks.title: Warduke
chunks.text:
NPC: Warduke (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: armored warrior with glowing red eyes behind a concealing helm
Faction: League of Malevolence
Location: Central tower throne room
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive, revivified and captured
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings named Warduke as a warrior of the League of Malevolence guarding the palace.
- (2026-05-14) Warduke cut Elkhorn down with two devastating blows from his flaming sword.
- (2026-05-14) Snarky wounded Warduke with a bolt from invisibility, and Strongheart blinded him with holy light.
- (2026-05-14) Snarky killed Warduke with a final bolt, and Strongheart revivified him to face justice.
- (2026-05-14) Warduke was disarmed of his Flame Tongue longsword and Dread Helm and bound.

chunks.title: Zargash
chunks.text:
NPC: Zargash (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Role: priest of Orcus
Faction: League of Malevolence
Location: Western Tower, Palace of Heart's Desire
Status: alive, bound and in custody
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings named Zargash as an evil priest of the League of Malevolence guarding the palace.
- (2026-05-28) Zargash was found frozen in time at the door of the western tower room.
- (2026-05-28) The party, with Ringlerun and Mercyon, bound Zargash and handed him to Valor's Call.

chunks.title: Bloodybeak
chunks.text:
NPC: Bloodybeak (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Bloody Beak
Role: great owl
Location: Palace aviary
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said Bloodybeak is the only creature in the palace able to fight the Jabberwock.
- (2026-05-14) Thinnings described Bloody Beak as an owlbear living in the aviary who hates the Jabberwock.

chunks.title: Ringlerun
chunks.text:
NPC: Ringlerun (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Ringle Run
Role: wizard who owns a staff of power
Status: alive, freed from stasis
Faction: Valor's Call
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the League wants a unicorn to free Ringlerun so Keledek can take his staff of power.
- (2026-05-14) Strongheart said Ringlerun, a dear friend and fellow member of Valor's Call, was last heading to the ballroom to speak with Zybilna.
- (2026-05-28) Ringlerun helped the party bind Zargash in the western tower.

chunks.title: Rug of Smothering
chunks.text:
NPC: Rug of Smothering (first seen 2026-04-16, last seen 2026-04-16) [unconfirmed record]
Role: animate rug guarding the Room of White Roses
Location: Room of White Roses
Attitude to party: hostile unless a rose is taken
- (2026-04-16) The rug grappled, blinded and restrained Cuckoo when he entered without a rose.
- (2026-04-16) The rug released Cuckoo immediately once he took a rose, and settled still.

chunks.title: Shon
chunks.text:
NPC: Shon (first seen 2026-05-14, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Role: palace librarian
Location: Palace library
- (2026-05-14) Thinnings mentioned Shon as someone who might know about the Infinite Archive.

chunks.title: Glass Golems
chunks.text:
NPC: Glass Golems (first seen 2026-05-14, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: glasswork golems, Knights of Glass
Role: constructs formed from stained glass windows of armored knights
Faction: controlled by the gilded throne
Location: Central tower throne room
Attitude to party: obedient to Istyl after she used the throne
Status: dormant in window frames
- (2026-05-14) Keledek's rhyme animated four windows into glass golems that mended themselves as they fought.
- (2026-05-14) Istyl sat in the throne and recited the command rhyme, stopping the golems.
- (2026-05-14) The golems followed Istyl to the balcony and returned to their window frames during the rest.

chunks.title: Cockatrices
chunks.text:
NPC: Cockatrices (first seen 2026-05-14, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: three bird-like creatures
Faction: Keledek's pets
Status: dead
- (2026-05-14) Abbigael's fireball incinerated all three, saving Istyl from being petrified.

chunks.title: Pixie Chefs
chunks.text:
NPC: Pixie Chefs (first seen 2026-05-14, last seen 2026-05-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: eight frozen pixies
Location: Palace kitchen
Status: frozen in time
- (2026-05-14) Eight pixie chefs hover frozen around an enormous tiered cake in the kitchen.

chunks.title: Snickersnack
chunks.text:
NPC: Snickersnack (first seen 2026-05-28, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: sentient vorpal greatsword
Attitude to party: eager
Location: locked vault in Zybilna's tower
- (2026-05-28) Snickersnack spoke in a silvery voice, asking to kill something, particularly a dragon.
- (2026-05-28) It dropped its hilt into Istyl's palm when she reached for it.
- (2026-06-11) Snickersnack hinted that it knows where the Witchlight Dragon is if Zybilna would lend it out.

chunks.title: Uzsumei Nyota
chunks.text:
NPC: Uzsumei Nyota (first seen 2026-06-11, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Istyl's mother, ascended celestial
Faction: Court of Tyr
Location: Court within the House of the Triad
Status: alive, ascended to celestial form
- (2026-06-11) A magical portrait showed Uzsumei Nyota in shining armor with wings of light, appearing younger than Istyl remembers.
- (2026-06-11) Zybilna explained that Uzsumei ascended to an idealized celestial form and now serves in the Court of Tyr, happy and doing greater service.

chunks.title: Garut
chunks.text:
NPC: Garut (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Black Scale Lizardfolk warrior
Faction: Lizardfolk
Location: Saltmarsh council hall
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-06-25) Garut warned the party that the Sahuagin throw people from their homes, eat those they can and enslave the rest.
- (2026-06-25) Garut and the lizardfolk offered to guide the party underwater to a safe distance from the Sunken Isle.

chunks.title: Vith
chunks.text:
NPC: Vith (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: lizardfolk war leader
Faction: Lizardfolk
Location: Saltmarsh council
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-06-25) Vith described the Sunken Isle as a three-tiered stronghold in the Javan River estuary, once lizardfolk-held and built partly with Valdush's help.
- (2026-06-25) Vith revealed Valdush asked the lizardfolk to seal off a fourth level below the third floor, and no one knows what he did with it.
- (2026-09-03) Vith was surprised the party was still alive when they reported to the council.
- (2026-09-03) Vith acknowledged that Shern the lobster knew quite a bit.

chunks.title: Eren
chunks.text:
NPC: Eren (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Merfolk representative
Faction: Merfolk
Location: Saltmarsh council hall
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-06-25) Eren attended the war council on land under a wet cloak, and the Merfolk offered to keep sharks and other predators away during the party's approach.

chunks.title: Sakhil
chunks.text:
NPC: Sakhil (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Lokathah representative
Faction: Lokathah
Location: Saltmarsh council hall
Attitude to party: cooperative
Status: alive
- (2026-06-25) Sakhil, a rare Lokathah who uses a barbed spear as a walking stick, attended the war council and the Lokathah offered to keep predators away from the party's approach.

chunks.title: Janos Mordaunt
chunks.text:
NPC: Janos Mordaunt (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: assassin, former owner of Second Grin
Status: dead
- (2026-06-25) Janos Mordaunt was slain long ago by adventurers including the wizard Valdush, who took his scimitar.

chunks.title: Valdush
chunks.text:
NPC: Valdush (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Role: wizard adventurer, friend to the lizardfolk
Status: deceased
- (2026-06-25) Valdush helped build the Sunken Isle and had a sealed fourth level made below the third floor.
- (2026-06-25) Valdush locked Second Grin in a sealed vault, which Zybilna believes is in the Saltmarsh region.

chunks.title: Sahuagin
chunks.text:
NPC: Sahuagin (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: sea devils
Role: shark-like sea raiders
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: Sunken Isle, underwater levels
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: scattered
- (2026-06-25) The Sahuagin hold the Sunken Isle as their fortress and threaten Saltmarsh and the coastal peoples.
- (2026-06-25) Sahuagin can be driven into a frenzy by blood in the water, use forced laborers (coerced, charmed or undead), and are led by magic-wielding barons and baronesses.
- (2026-07-23) Sahuagin and sharks circle the prison barge to stop prisoners jumping overboard, not to watch for infiltrators from below.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace said the Sahuagin use prisoners to tunnel into the upper, air-filled parts of the Sunken Isle.
- (2026-08-06) Sahuagin and their trained sharks escorted the prison barge to a partially submerged sandbar causeway at the island.
- (2026-08-06) The party met numerous Sahuagin warriors, powerful Coral Smashers wielding large hammers, and a formidable Champion who appeared to be in a leadership role.
- (2026-08-06) The Sahuagin are building a larger base and use shackled prisoners as slave labor.
- (2026-08-06) About ten Sahuagin were in the guardroom behind the entrance doors and were fooled by the party's disguises.
- (2026-08-06) A Sahuagin champion spotted Snarky peeking into the work chamber, and the party retreated.
- (2026-08-06) Four Sahuagin still guarded the main work chamber after the shift ended.

chunks.title: Sahuagin (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Sahuagin (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-10-29)
- (2026-08-20) Istyl found dozens of Sahuagin warriors sparring and resting in a large barracks room with about 30 present.
- (2026-08-20) A Sahuagin champion leaped backward into the invisible Istyl, who avoided detection by sinking to the floor.
- (2026-08-20) Istyl saw a Sahuagin champion address a formation of warriors and coral smashers.
- (2026-08-20) The party saw at least 50 Sahuagin watching an event in an arena on the lower level.
- (2026-08-20) Armored sharks guard a storage room full of weapons and are penned in other rooms.
- (2026-09-03) A Sahuagin guard at the Sunken Isle door was deceived by Abbigael's claim of bringing a prisoner and opened the gate.
- (2026-09-03) The party killed a dozen Sahuagin in the gatehouse in under thirty seconds, including multiple champions and a Coral Smasher.
- (2026-09-03) Elder Sahuagin royalty grow larger, sprout extra limbs and telepathically control sharks and carnivorous sea creatures.
- (2026-09-03) The Sahuagin appear to be building a permanent royal palace, judging by murals and tunneling.
- (2026-09-03) The Sahuagin show no sign of Kraken influence and may be unaware of the Deep Scions.
- (2026-09-17) The Sahuagin proved particularly vicious when attacking an opponent who had already taken damage.
- (2026-09-17) Most of the Sahuagin in the throne room, including two champions, a priestess and two large sharks, were fought by the party and most were slain.

chunks.title: Sahuagin (part 3)
chunks.text:
NPC: Sahuagin (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-10-29)
- (2026-10-29) The GM said the Sunken Isle stronghold was shattered and its leadership killed. Stragglers escaped into the deeps, so sea devils will linger but are no longer an organized threat. Sahuagin nobles take decades to develop telepathy and extra limbs, and that telepathy is what keeps them organized.

chunks.title: Barkeep of the Vulgar Kraken
chunks.text:
NPC: Barkeep of the Vulgar Kraken (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: barkeep at the Vulgar Kraken
Location: Vulgar Kraken, Seaton
Attitude to party: wary but helpful for coin
Status: alive
- (2026-06-25) The barkeep took Istyl's gold coin and said Seaton's militia makes secretive night deployments, returning soaked and exhausted.
- (2026-06-25) The barkeep refused to eat Istyl's Fae fairy cake and said she never gets mixed up in Fae stuff.
- (2026-06-25) The barkeep suggested the party talk to soldiers for more information.
- (2026-07-09) The barkeep is named Dana (also written Dena) and has naval tattoos.
- (2026-07-09) Dana earlier told Istyl that soldiers make secretive night deployments and return soaked and hollow-eyed.
- (2026-07-09) Dana kept a close ear on patrons' conversations, as Snarky observed.
- (2026-07-09) Dana recommended the Sea Lion and the Kelp Bed to Cuckoo as safe, honest inns.

chunks.title: Dendar Cobb
chunks.text:
NPC: Dendar Cobb (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: halfling dockworker skilled at tying and untying knots
Location: Vulgar Kraken, Seaton
Attitude to party: grateful, desperate to escape Seaton
Status: alive, bound by contract to Abbigael
- (2026-07-09) Dendar Cobb is a nervous, hollow-eyed halfling who taught Abbigael dragon chess.
- (2026-07-09) He saw a barge loaded with people in manacles leave the long jetty at night about two weeks earlier and return empty.
- (2026-07-09) Abbigael judged his barge account truthful but his wider conspiracy theories unreliable.
- (2026-07-09) He has no family or connections in Seaton and dreams of Saltmarsh or Dunclad.
- (2026-07-09) He signed Abbigael's contract giving his soul on death and aid on call, in exchange for transport to Saltmarsh and a financial stake.
- (2026-07-09) He promised to meet the party at the Vulgar Kraken in a couple of days.

chunks.title: Captain Rasa
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Rasa (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Rasa
Role: dwarven sea captain of the Argent Maiden, runs silver from Copperlock Mines to Dunclad
Location: Vulgar Kraken, Seaton
Attitude to party: friendly after Istyl shared lizard jerky
Status: alive
- (2026-07-09) Rasa claimed the Sunken Isle is abandoned and the coast is safe in daylight.
- (2026-07-09) Rasa praised the Seaton magistrates and said the keys to success are good luck and silver.
- (2026-07-09) Istyl won him over with lizard jerky.
- (2026-07-09) Cuckoo asked about chartering the Argent Maiden to the Sunken Isle.

chunks.title: Tuna
chunks.text:
NPC: Tuna (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: former prison guard and fisherman
Location: Vulgar Kraken, Seaton
Attitude to party: opened up after Cuckoo bought him a drink
Status: alive, traumatized
- (2026-07-09) Tuna told Cuckoo he marched prisoners to the long jetty and loaded them on barges that returned empty.
- (2026-07-09) One barge came back sopping wet and smelling of the ocean without a storm, so he believes prisoners were drowned.
- (2026-07-09) He quit and suspects the magistrates profit by selling prisoners into slavery or worse.

chunks.title: Leo
chunks.text:
NPC: Leo (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: dock worker, Tuna's friend
Location: Vulgar Kraken, Seaton
Status: alive
- (2026-07-09) Istyl saw a flash of fear and anger on Leo's face before he put on a friendly expression.
- (2026-07-09) Leo said Tuna was once a beloved fisherman and storyteller broken by gradual hardship.

chunks.title: Mother Finch
chunks.text:
NPC: Mother Finch (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Role: cook
Location: Vulgar Kraken kitchen, Seaton
Status: alive
- (2026-07-09) Snarky overheard Mother Finch muttering that the fishing catches are too good and too steady.
- (2026-07-09) She muttered about people being traded for gold or fish.
- (2026-07-09) She mourned Finney, missing for three years.

chunks.title: Finney
chunks.text:
NPC: Finney (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Status: missing for three years
- (2026-07-09) Mother Finch mourned Finney as missing for three years.

chunks.title: Magistrate Ferris Aldenmore
chunks.text:
NPC: Magistrate Ferris Aldenmore (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Aldenmore
Role: Seaton magistrate, possibly coerced
Location: fourth floor of the magisterial keep, Seaton
Status: alive
- (2026-07-09) Aldenmore has been hiring a mix of local and foreign guards, suggesting he fears something.
- (2026-07-09) A clerk told Cuckoo his quota of out-of-town guards was already filled.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace believes Aldenmore acts under blackmail or coercion and might be turned.

chunks.title: Magistrate Vane
chunks.text:
NPC: Magistrate Vane (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Seaton magistrate, corrupt
Status: alive
- (2026-07-09) A clerk at the Rusty Cutlass said Vane's court records show more hard labor sentences than court appearances.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace said Vane profits from the booming fishing industry and uses wrongful convictions to terrorize and extort the town.

chunks.title: Merva Soultide
chunks.text:
NPC: Merva Soultide (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: High Priestess Merva Soultide, High Priestess Myrva, Myrva
Role: High Priestess of Poseidon in Seaton, revealed as a Kraken Priestess
Status: alive
Location: Temple of Poseidon, Seaton
Attitude to party: unaware of the party; enemy
- (2026-07-09) Snarky overheard that her sermons now speak of 'ancient sovereigns' of the deep rather than Poseidon, unsettling soldiers.
- (2026-07-23) An acolyte said Myrva was lost at sea for a long time and returned claiming to have communed with Poseidon.
- (2026-07-23) Since her return the temple invokes sharks, krakens, dragon turtles and great squids in every sacrifice, and fishing harvests have boomed.
- (2026-07-23) Istyl used the Eyes of the Fey Queen at the morning sermon and saw Myrva with fully black eyes and a suckered tentacle where her tongue should be.
- (2026-07-23) The party concluded Myrva is a Kraken Priestess still wielding divine power, implying a Kraken in the region.

chunks.title: Captain Thrace
chunks.text:
NPC: Captain Thrace (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Thrace
Role: Captain of the Guard in Seaton, secretly working against the Sahuagin
Location: Militia Headquarters, Seaton
Attitude to party: cooperative ally
Status: alive
- (2026-07-09) Thrace is exhausted and reportedly burns documents in his office at night.
- (2026-07-09) Istyl told him about Granny Nightshade's weakened coven, her green dragon ally, the disappearing people and the sahuagin threat.
- (2026-07-09) Thrace demanded hard evidence and told Istyl to bring it to him, not the magistrates.
- (2026-07-09) He secretly tucked a note into Istyl's armor collar arranging a meeting.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace met Istyl, Cuckoo and Snarky at the northeast corner of the Market Square after midnight and revealed his face.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace confirmed suspicions about the High Priestess and said he has a changeling spy among the Sahuagin.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace has been destroying every informant report after memorizing it to protect his spy.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace named Magistrate Vane, Magistrate Aldenmore and Harbor Master Colliwell as corrupt or coerced officials.
- (2026-07-23) Thrace proposed delivering the party to the Sunken Isle as prisoners on a night barge and agreed to delay the next barge up to a week.
- (2026-07-23) Cuckoo slipped into Thrace's office disguised as a guard; Thrace confirmed the barge would leave the following night, burned Cuckoo's warning note and gave the code phrase 'Silverfin'.

chunks.title: Harbor Master Colliwell
chunks.text:
NPC: Harbor Master Colliwell (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Harbor Master of Seaton
Location: Seaton
Status: alive
- (2026-07-23) Thrace said Colliwell goes along with the regime out of a belief that cooperation is the only way to keep the town from being wiped out.

chunks.title: Changeling Informant
chunks.text:
NPC: Changeling Informant (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Thrace's changeling spy
Role: Thrace's spy, outrider among the Sahuagin near the Sunken Isle
Faction: Captain Thrace
Location: Sunken Isle
Attitude to party: ally, identified by the code phrase 'Silverfin'
Status: alive
- (2026-07-23) She wears the skin of a Sahuagin; Thrace has never seen her true form and she once appeared to him as an elf.
- (2026-07-23) She feeds Thrace intelligence and helps delay or redirect the Sahuagin's plans.

chunks.title: Acolyte of Poseidon
chunks.text:
NPC: Acolyte of Poseidon (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: temple acolyte
Location: Temple of Poseidon, Seaton
Attitude to party: informative
Status: alive
- (2026-07-23) The acolyte told Istyl and the party about Poseidon worship, sacrifices, and the High Priestess's return.

chunks.title: Erin
chunks.text:
NPC: Erin (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Merfolk councilor on the Saltmarsh War Council
Location: Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-07-23) Erin explained that Deep Scions are drowned people revived by dark ritual who keep their memories and personality.
- (2026-07-23) Erin warned that a Deep Scion priestess would have lost her divine power, but a willing Kraken Priestess would imply a Kraken in the region.

chunks.title: Deep Scions
chunks.text:
NPC: Deep Scions (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: aquatic humanoids
Role: drowned townsfolk remade in service to the deep
Faction: Sunken Isle forces
Location: Seaton, disguised among townsfolk and guards
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: hostile
- (2026-07-23) Istyl's true sight revealed seven disguised aquatic humanoids at the temple sermon.
- (2026-07-23) Istyl also found disguised creatures among shopkeepers, crowds and town guards in the Market Square and the Rusty Cutlass.
- (2026-07-23) The party decided not to capture or interrogate one for fear of alerting the Sunken Isle.
- (2026-09-03) The sea peoples of the council confirmed a young Kraken is extending influence over the region through the Deep Scions in Seaton.
- (2026-09-03) Istyl scanned the council room with the Eyes of the Fey Queen and found no Deep Scions present.

chunks.title: Wave Shaper
chunks.text:
NPC: Wave Shaper (first seen 2026-08-20, last seen 2026-10-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Sahuagin spellcaster
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: Sunken Isle, underwater levels
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2026-08-20) Istyl saw a hunched, twisted wave shaper stacking coins at a table in a chamber next to the address hall.
- (2026-08-20) A wall mosaic showed a similar creature creating a whirlpool to sink a ship.
- (2026-08-20) The party saw another wave shaper on the lower level.
- (2026-08-20) The party chose not to confront the wave shaper.
- (2026-10-01) The wave shaper summoned a massive whirlpool to trap the party and impress the Baroness.
- (2026-10-01) Snarky resisted the vortex and swam toward safety.

chunks.title: Maw of Sekolah
chunks.text:
NPC: Maw of Sekolah (first seen 2026-08-20, last seen 2026-08-20) [unconfirmed record]
Role: massive two-headed shark placated by Sahuagin priests
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: Temple of Sekolah
Attitude to party: hostile
- (2026-08-20) The two-headed shark has pearl and gold bands on its fins and circles above the glowing altar.
- (2026-08-20) Sahuagin priests sacrificed hatchlings to it in a placation ritual.
- (2026-08-20) The party retreated without disturbing the ritual or the shark.

chunks.title: Shern
chunks.text:
NPC: Shern (first seen 2026-08-20, last seen 2026-10-29)
Role: telepathic lobster guide to the vault
Location: With the party in his fishbowl
Attitude to party: friendly, helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-08-20) Istyl and Snarky heard Shern's telepathic plea for rescue in an empty shark pen.
- (2026-08-20) Istyl agreed to free him and hid him in her cloak hood.
- (2026-08-20) Shern said most Sahuagin are on the lowest level, ruled by two four-armed champions.
- (2026-08-20) Shern told the party of a secret, unguarded entrance into the prison cells on the lowest level.
- (2026-08-20) Shern promised to lead the party to a cave of shiny things if returned to the open ocean.
- (2026-08-20) At the palace Istyl found a bowl of salt water for him, and he described the two lowest levels and the external entrances.
- (2026-09-03) Shern introduced himself telepathically to Vith at the Saltmarsh council, surprising her.
- (2026-09-03) The party carried Shern from the Feywild to Saltmarsh in an enchanted fishbowl.
- (2026-09-03) Shern reported overhearing chatter resembling a royal court in rooms north of where he was held on the second level.
- (2026-09-17) The party followed Shern's directions and reached a huge east-west feast hall.
- (2026-10-29) Cuckoo told Shern the Baroness was no more, the Baron was still out there, and the Sahuagin were scattered.
- (2026-10-29) Shern agreed to guide the party to the treasure vault, saying he could lead them there but might not be able to get in himself.

chunks.title: Shern (part 2)
chunks.text:
NPC: Shern (first seen 2026-08-20, last seen 2026-10-29)
- (2026-10-29) Shern could not find the way while above water and had to go underwater to get his bearings; Cuckoo carried him down in the sea.
- (2026-10-29) At the vault entrance Shern said it was where he used to hide and that the boulder was different from before. He then stayed behind to muck about in the sludge.

chunks.title: Priest of Poseidon
chunks.text:
NPC: Priest of Poseidon (first seen 2026-09-03, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: local priest who joined the assault force
Faction: Saltmarsh
Attitude to party: allied
Status: alive
- (2026-09-03) The priest lowered the tide to a seasonal low, exposing the causeway to the Sunken Isle so the militia could cross on foot.

chunks.title: Sahuagin Champion
chunks.text:
NPC: Sahuagin Champion (first seen 2026-09-03, last seen 2026-10-01) [unconfirmed record]
Role: gatehouse guard
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: Sunken Isle gatehouse
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-03) A champion opened the door after Abbigael's deception and ordered the prisoner taken to the cells.
- (2026-09-03) Several champions fought the party in the gatehouse and resisted Cuckoo's stunning strikes.
- (2026-09-03) Istyl struck down the last champion with her flaming sword.
- (2026-10-01) A champion hurled a spear at the fleeing party as they went through the door; it missed and the party slammed the door shut.

chunks.title: Coral Smasher
chunks.text:
NPC: Coral Smasher (first seen 2026-09-03, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Role: Sahuagin warhammer fighter
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: Sunken Isle gatehouse
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-03) The Coral Smasher survived Abbigael's first fireball and was struck down by Istyl's flaming blade.

chunks.title: Sahuagin Baron
chunks.text:
NPC: Sahuagin Baron (first seen 2026-09-17, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: the Baron
Role: Sahuagin ruler directing the defense of the Sunken Isle
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: extraplanar prison
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-09-17) The party overheard the Baron shouting orders and saying he would direct his forces to repel the invaders on the first level.
- (2026-09-17) Abbigael cast Banishment on the Baron, removing him from the fight and sequestering him in an extraplanar prison.
- (2026-10-01) Abbigael maintained Banishment to keep the Baron trapped on another plane. [superseded 2026-10-29: The REC says the Baron is still out there, which contradicts the claim that he was kept trapped on another plane.]
- (2026-10-29) Cuckoo told Shern the Baron was still out there somewhere, while the Baroness was dead.

chunks.title: Sahuagin Baron's Mate
chunks.text:
NPC: Sahuagin Baron's Mate (first seen 2026-09-17, last seen 2026-10-01) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: large female noble sahuagin, Sahuagin Baroness, Baroness
Role: enraged fiendish sea devil leader who avenges her banished mate
Faction: Sahuagin
Location: Sunken Isle feast hall
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-09-17) She entered the throne room screaming for those who removed her mate.
- (2026-10-01) The Baroness charged the party, eager to avenge her missing mate and devour the intruders.
- (2026-10-01) She bled acidic, fiendish blood that tainted the water after Cuckoo turned her own blow back on her.
- (2026-10-01) Istyl killed her instantly with a psychic explosion released as she teleported through the magical doorway.
- (2026-10-01) Her death, together with the Baron's banishment, broke the Sahuagin horde's coordination.
- (2026-10-01) GMAssistant's notes call her the Sahuagin Baroness; she was killed by Istyl this session.

chunks.title: Giant Squid
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant Squid (first seen 2026-10-29, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: grabber eater, squiddy
Role: guardian beast of the vault entrance
Location: the entrance to the vault of Valdush
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: dead
- (2026-10-29) A local fish charmed by Istyl said a big grabber eater lived in the vault, came out to hunt, and pulled the boulder in behind itself. The squid shot out of the doorway and Istyl's dominate beast on it failed.
- (2026-10-29) The squid bit Istyl for 36 damage after a tentacle crush for 18. The party killed it with Rhymes Binding Ice (26 cold), Snarky's 28 damage shot, and chromatic orb and Cuckoo's elemental burst. Local fish then began eating it.

chunks.title: Local Fish
chunks.text:
NPC: Local Fish (first seen 2026-10-29, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: friendly local fish
Attitude to party: charmed, helpful
Status: alive
- (2026-10-29) Istyl charmed a small fish with dominate beast. It told her about the grabber eater, then warned that it was coming and left.

chunks.title: Lobstrosities
chunks.text:
NPC: Lobstrosities (first seen 2026-10-29, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: rock lobsters, lobstrosity
Role: guards in the vault antechamber
Location: flooded chamber inside the vault of Valdush
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: one killed by Cuckoo, other bloodied
- (2026-10-29) Two giant lobster creatures disguised as rock formations attacked when Abbigael's light lit the room. They grapple and have paralytic tentacles; Cuckoo made his Constitution save against them. Their shells held up against many attacks.
- (2026-10-29) Cuckoo killed one lobstrosity, which Snarky and Abbigael had hurt.

chunks.title: Giant Lightning Eels
chunks.text:
NPC: Giant Lightning Eels (first seen 2026-10-29, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: lightning eels
Location: passages of the vault of Valdush
Attitude to party: hostile
Status: alive
- (2026-10-29) Giant lightning eels emerged from several passages, signaling each other with lightning flashes. The GM said they respond specifically to the use of lightning, which drew them in after Abbigael's lightning orb. They are not AC 10.

chunks.title: Saltmarsh
chunks.text:
Location: Saltmarsh (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-10-29)
Type: town
Parent: Kingdom of Keoland
Description: fishing town and the biggest port in the area; hosts the Witchlight Carnival
- (2024-10-10) A contingent of royal soldiers is stationed in a barracks in Saltmarsh.
- (2024-11-22) An overladen jolly boat was seen making its way toward Saltmarsh.
- (2025-01-30) The party learned the town council is split between traditionalists and loyalists.
- (2025-01-30) The party took a long rest in town.
- (2026-06-11) A courier met the party with an urgent summons from the town council, saying the town is in great danger.
- (2026-06-25) The party returned to Saltmarsh to find only a few days had passed and the town crowded with carnival visitors.
- (2026-06-25) Merchants raised prices for tourists but kept old rates for locals, including the party.
- (2026-07-23) The party returned to consult the War Council and resupply; a lizardfolk army is massing on the former carnival grounds.
- (2026-09-03) The former carnival field is now a lizardfolk encampment, with merfolk and sea lions gathering near the docks.
- (2026-09-03) The council granted the party full Saltmarsh citizenship and the deed to a manor vacated by a convicted smuggling councilman.
- (2026-10-29) The party is staying in Primewater Manor in Saltmarsh. They hold a renown score of 3 with Saltmarsh, so people there know them and are friendly by default. The party can get free passage on ships leaving the port.

chunks.title: Reeking House
chunks.text:
Location: Reeking House (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: haunted house, mansion
Type: abandoned mansion
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: Burned down after a fireburst mushroom ignited; the fire was visible from Saltmarsh.
- (2024-10-10) An alchemist who trafficked in things from the other world once lived in the Reeking House.
- (2024-10-10) Winnie said the Reeking House is a center of unsanctioned criminal activity.
- (2024-10-10) The party set up at the gate to watch the road and the rosebush burrow.
- (2024-10-10) After the fight the party heard a regular thudding like something striking wood.
- (2024-10-24) The party heard a thudding from the upper floor near the front of the house, which came from the bound prisoner Ned.
- (2024-10-24) Cuckoo, Istyl and Islinel entered the house, found a key on the second floor and freed Ned from a locked room.
- (2024-10-24) The party explored the outside and found a back door near the well.
- (2024-10-24) The well was once a wishing well, with coins glittering at the bottom, but the snakes' nest made the party judge it not worth the risk.
- (2024-10-24) Four days in, a group of travelers came up the road to look at the house, and Cuckoo persuaded them not to enter without a note from Gellen.
- (2024-11-02) The party made loud noises to avoid surprising the snakes and passed through the Snake Garden.
- (2024-11-02) The party found fresh foot traffic in the main hallway leading toward the back of the house.

chunks.title: Reeking House (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Reeking House (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
- (2024-11-02) The party entered by the front door and went directly to the hidden trapdoor, bypassing much of the house.
- (2024-11-22) The party found a ring of red mushrooms around a fireplace and a mold-infested kitchen on the ground floor.
- (2024-11-22) The party found stairs to the cellar but a blood-curdling scream sounded when someone stepped on the first step, deterring them.
- (2024-11-22) The party fought a spider swarm in an upstairs room.
- (2024-11-22) The party found a small crystal sphere in an upstairs fireplace.
- (2024-11-22) The party stashed a box they couldn't open in the weasel lair.
- (2024-12-05) The upper floor room had a fireburst mushroom in the fireplace, an old trunk and a bedroll suggesting squatters.
- (2024-12-05) The house caught fire and the party evacuated through a window, by rope and through the cellar.
- (2024-12-05) The basement has a secret door to stairs leading deeper underground, a barred door with a warning, and caverns leading to the sea.
- (2024-12-05) The house burned, sending its smoke up to be seen from Saltmarsh.
- (2025-03-14) The ruins are now foundations and a basement, with a hidden stairway under scorched floorboards and a snake-infested well.
- (2025-03-14) The party returned to investigate the ruins and was attacked by snakes from the well.

chunks.title: Dreadwood
chunks.text:
Location: Dreadwood (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2025-02-23) [unconfirmed record]
Type: forest
Description: seemingly living forest, possibly an extrusion of the Shadowfell, difficult to map, divided into Outer, Middle and Inner Reaches and the Dreaded Deeps
- (2024-10-10) Abbigael sensed the actual influence of the Shadowfell on the Dreadwood and saw a shadowy presence.
- (2024-10-10) Istyl felt something was wrong there but could not say what.
- (2025-02-23) Cuckoo and Istyl read a book about the Dreadwood.
- (2025-02-23) The Outer Reaches hold bandits, a clan of elves and typical forest creatures.
- (2025-02-23) The Middle Reaches are darker and more influenced by the Shadowfell, and nightmares there can haunt explorers and feed their secrets to denizens.
- (2025-02-23) The Inner Reaches are a nightmare zone known only through hearsay.
- (2025-02-23) The Dreaded Deeps stifle natural light and constrain magical light, even normal darkvision.

chunks.title: Silverstand Forest
chunks.text:
Location: Silverstand Forest (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2024-10-10) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Sliverstand
Type: forest
Description: Small forest that is oddly bright and airy compared to the Dreadwood.

chunks.title: Burle
chunks.text:
Location: Burle (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2024-10-10) [unconfirmed record]
Type: fortress
Parent: Kingdom of Keoland
Description: Garrison fortress outside Saltmarsh.

chunks.title: Winston's
chunks.text:
Location: Winston's (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Winnie's Shop
Type: trading house
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: shop with a secure back room with a cage-like structure for valuable items
- (2025-02-23) The party sold gear here for 122g total, 12g 2s per person, and examined a Cursed Luck Stone and a Pipe of Remembrance.
- (2025-03-14) Snarky received a secret message here.
- (2025-04-24) The party discussed protection against fey magic with Winnie and learned cold iron weapons are effective against fey.
- (2025-04-24) The party bought holy water here and left a note for Lady Oweland about their absence.
- (2026-06-25) Winnie's shop was stocked with water gear, and the party bought aquatic magic items there.

chunks.title: Seaton
chunks.text:
Location: Seaton (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: Seton
Type: village
Description: Military-minded port city with stone and brick buildings and a royal garrison; all businesses face east.
- (2024-10-24) Ned said he came from Seaton, a nearby village.
- (2026-06-25) The party reached Seaton by the North Road to investigate why the Sahuagin never attack it.
- (2026-06-25) Abbigael sensed an undercurrent of desperation beneath Seaton's bustle.
- (2026-10-29) Seaton is over 40 leagues from Saltmarsh, too far for the silver raven to deliver a message. The party judged that Seaton knows the Sahuagin were defeated.

chunks.title: Hidden Cellar
chunks.text:
Location: Hidden Cellar (first seen 2024-11-02, last seen 2024-11-02) [unconfirmed record]
Type: cellar
Parent: Reeking House
Description: Torch-lit cellar reached by a hidden trapdoor and steep stairs, with multiple beds and a large dining table, used as bandit living quarters. Has a northern door, a door barred from the inside in the east wall with a sign reading "DANGER!!!", and a hidden door to the west.
- (2024-11-02) The party found the cellar occupied by bandits, and combat broke out.
- (2024-11-02) A booming voice warned 'Welcome fool, welcome to your death' and all party members resisted the fear effect.
- (2024-11-02) Mysterious rattling sounds were heard from behind the door marked 'danger'.

chunks.title: Gellen Primewater's Mansion
chunks.text:
Location: Gellen Primewater's Mansion (first seen 2024-11-22, last seen 2026-10-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Gellen's mansion, Primewater Estate, Primewater Manor
Type: manor
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: Grand noble manor awarded to the party.
Unconfirmed dates: 2026-10-29
- (2024-11-22) The overladen jolly boat's cargo was unloaded here, which Snarky observed.
- (2026-10-01) The Saltmarsh council gave the party the deed to the Primewater Estate.
- (2026-10-29) The party rested at Primewater Manor in Saltmarsh before heading to the vault.

chunks.title: Caverns beneath the Reeking House
chunks.text:
Location: Caverns beneath the Reeking House (first seen 2024-12-05, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: caverns, Underground Lair, Secret Hideout, Reeking House Basement
Type: cavern
Parent: Reeking House
Description: Caverns that lead to the sea, where the smugglers left a small rowboat.
- (2024-12-05) Snarky led the party through the caverns to the sea.
- (2024-12-05) The party found a small rowboat left by the smugglers and used it to escape the fire.
- (2025-03-14) The party discussed using the former smuggler hideout as a secure hideout, noting its rooms, secret areas and storage.
- (2025-03-14) The hideout is largely intact despite the fire above.
- (2025-03-14) The party discussed monitoring smuggler signals from there.
- (2026-06-25) The party rested in their hideout caverns and found them undisturbed.
- (2026-09-03) The Yon beacon portal returned the party to this cellar lair.

chunks.title: Crabber's Cove
chunks.text:
Location: Crabber's Cove (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Type: coastal area
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: known for large aggressive crabs; an abandoned house stands at its end

chunks.title: Abandoned House at Crabber's Cove
chunks.text:
Location: Abandoned House at Crabber's Cove (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-01-30) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Abandoned House
Type: dilapidated fisherman's shack on stilts
Parent: Crabber's Cove
Description: recently repaired but made to look abandoned; built over a giant crab's pond lair, with a hidden basement holding Xolec's coffin
- (2025-01-30) Snarky found a loose floorboard revealing a coffin in the crawl space.
- (2025-01-30) The party found signs of recent repair and activity.

chunks.title: Snapping Line Inn
chunks.text:
Location: Snapping Line Inn (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-03-14) [unconfirmed record]
Type: inn and tavern
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: known for seafood, reeks of fish, serves Claw Wine
- (2025-01-30) The party had the giant crab cooked here.
- (2025-01-30) The party learned of the traditionalist and loyalist split here.
- (2025-02-23) The party spent downtime here studying books and discussing languages until news of the Witchlight Carnival's arrival interrupted them.
- (2025-03-14) Travelers' tales of a three-headed dog near Dreadwood led Abbigael to reveal her own similar dog.

chunks.title: Weekly Market
chunks.text:
Location: Weekly Market (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2025-02-23) [unconfirmed record]
Type: market
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: bustling market centered around the town's first well, with fishmongers, exotic goods merchants, textile sellers and craftspeople
- (2025-02-23) The party met Sella and Jade at the market, and Snarky bought a self-mending rope and smart hook from a gnome tinkerer.
- (2025-02-23) Various council members were seen at the market.

chunks.title: Green Market
chunks.text:
Location: Green Market (first seen 2025-01-30, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Type: market
Parent: Saltmarsh
Description: stalls and shops where most conventional items can be found

- (2025-02-27) The party fought the crew on the Sea Ghost and retreated without casualties.

- (2025-03-14) The party entered the carnival through deals with the goblin ticket taker.
- (2025-03-14) A treant paraded through showering guests with golden sycamore seeds.
- (2025-03-27) The party found a notice for an upcoming pumpkin contest requiring natural growth and no magic.
- (2025-03-27) The party watched chaotic pixie chariot races in the Big Top and learned of an evening extravaganza show.
- (2025-03-27) The carnival has a snail racing area.
- (2026-06-11) The party returned through the Hall of Illusions mirror; only a couple of days had passed in the material world.
- (2026-06-11) The carnival appeared shinier and better maintained, with a celebratory mood.
- (2026-06-11) The party attended the Big Top show as guests of honor.

chunks.text:

Parent: Witchlight Carnival
Description: Wagon near the entrance storing lost items, with large mushrooms nearby
- (2025-03-14) Dirlagraun guards the wagon.

chunks.text:

Type: carnival tent
Parent: Witchlight Carnival
Description: Main tent with spinning golden stars and animated wall panels; hosts shows and pixie chariot races.
- (2025-03-27) The party watched pixies race weasel-drawn chariots, cheating with sleep darts and pixie dust, ending in a pile-up.
- (2025-04-10) The party won the pumpkin contest here by rolling their pumpkin to crush 70% of the target pumpkins.
- (2025-04-10) Mr. Light hosted the carnival extravaganza here, during which Snarky stole Mr. Witch's pocket watch.

Parent: Witchlight Carnival
Description: Twenty-foot animated teapot where visitors float in bubbles from the spout; visitors can shrink to enter a pixie-sized carnival.
- (2025-03-27) Abbigael took a brief ride before her bubble popped.
- (2025-03-27) Istyl's longer ride showed the staff area, gondola swans, and a bug bear in a pumpkin helmet patrolling thorny walls.
- (2025-03-27) Cuckoo used a bubble ride to spot a missing child.
- (2025-04-24) The party took magical bubble rides from the giant teapot.

chunks.title: Carousel

Parent: Witchlight Carnival

- (2025-03-27) Istyl restored the names of the carousel's unicorns here.

Parent: Feywild

- (2025-03-27) Cuckoo learned he is from Thither.
- (2025-04-24) The party entered Prismere through the Hall of Illusions and arrived on a broken causeway.

chunks.text:

Parent: Saltmarsh

- (2025-03-27) The party fought vine blights and twig blights here.
- (2026-06-11) Matty dug up his buried chest in the giant pumpkin patch.
- (2026-06-11) The party took a long rest at the farm and divided the gear.

chunks.title: Palace of Heart's Desire
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of Heart's Desire (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-09-17) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Palace of Heart's Delight
Type: palace
Parent: Prismere
Description: Zybilna's residence in the heart of Prismere.
- (2025-03-27) It was mentioned as a possible place to find the missing Fae Queen.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The party entered through the main doors unlocked by Wrath's crown and found a starry painted corridor with four other sealed door sets.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) A north balcony overlooks a floorless courtyard of storm clouds with a marble tower connected by four stone staircases.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The party took a long rest in one of the symmetrical turret chambers.
- (2026-04-16) The party explored the mezzanine, carriage house, rose room, changing room, bath, armory, towers and staff workroom.
- (2026-04-16) The palace is filled with frozen courtiers and the Jabberwock lairs in the ballroom.
- (2026-05-14) The party explored the kitchen, a beanstalk-lifted tower, the Hall of Roses and the central tower.
- (2026-05-14) The party returned the memory gems to their coffers across the towers.
- (2026-06-11) The party received rewards from Zybilna at the palace.
- (2026-06-11) The party now has a permanent connection to the palace via Abbigael's doorknob.
- (2026-08-06) The party used Abbigael's magical doorknob to teleport to a red guest bedroom here.
- (2026-08-06) Magical hooks in a changing room or bathing area made the whole party invisible.
- (2026-08-06) The party planned to store stolen Sahuagin tools in Abbigael's red bedroom.

chunks.title: Palace of Heart's Desire (part 2)
chunks.text:
Location: Palace of Heart's Desire (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-09-17) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-08-20) The party used the doorknob from a secret dry room on the upper level of the Sunken Isle to return to the red bedroom.
- (2026-09-17) The party used the wardrobe in the palace's bathing chamber to become invisible before returning to the Sunken Isle.

chunks.title: Silver Song Lake

Parent: Witchlight Carnival
Description: magical lake surrounded by sparkling mists, with swan gondolas and Palasha's performance in a giant water bowl
- (2025-04-10) The party took a swan gondola ride with Featherine around the lake.

chunks.title: Hall of Illusions
chunks.text:

Parent: Witchlight Carnival
Description: tent with magical mirrors showing past and future reflections, Tasha's fortune-telling booth and shifting colored patterns on the fabric
- (2025-04-10) The party restored Candlefoot's voice here.
- (2025-04-10) Cuckoo reunited Reuben with Wean here.
- (2025-04-10) Snarky was enlisted to watch the entry.
- (2025-04-24) The mirrors revealed the carnival masters' past as shadowfell elves.
- (2025-04-24) The party learned a magical rhyme to activate the mirror portal and entered Prismere through it.

- (2025-04-10) A dwarf's dragonfly ride went awry before it was properly secured; the party calmed the dragonfly and Abbigael rescued the dwarf from a fall.

- (2025-04-24) The party shrank to tiny size, rode Pinecone the pug, met Biscuit the hamster and played hide and seek with pixies.

- (2025-04-24) The party emerged here from the Hall of Illusions mirror portal and spotted a crashing balloon in the distance.
- (2025-06-19) The harengon brigands ambushed the party here.

Parent: Prismere swamp

- (2025-06-19) The party killed two giant snakes here and rescued Sir Talavar.
- (2025-06-19) The tower interior was empty and cobwebbed with spiral stairs.

Parent: Prismere
Description: sentient hill above the mist with silvery moss, fruit scent and animated willow trees; one of the safest places
- (2025-06-19) The party short rested at its base and long rested in Jingle Jangle's cave.

chunks.text:
Location: Jingle Jangle's Cave (first seen 2025-06-19, last seen 2025-06-19) [unconfirmed record]
Type: cave
Parent: Telami Hill
Description: cave entrance carved like a giant keyhole, with a wall of about 10,000 keys
- (2025-06-19) The party traded keys here and rested under the rules of hospitality.

Parent: Prismere

- (2025-06-19) The party decided to head north toward Downfall.
- (2025-06-26) The party rowed a skiff to Downfall and was greeted by bullywug guards.
- (2025-07-17) The party was escorted from the docks across stepping stones, through the balloon factory and across the bridge of chattering heads to the king.

chunks.title: Inn at the End of the Road
names: Inn at the End of the Road

Parent: Hither

- (2025-06-19) The inn approached the party and settled about 100 yards away; the session ended with the party deciding whether to trust it.
- (2025-06-26) The party went inside, ate plum pie, and sang with Sue.
- (2025-06-26) The inn is sentient, communicates with Sue non-verbally, and is stuck in Hither by the mists.

Type: magical stream
Parent: Hither
Description: Flows from Downfall and shows visions of events upstream in its reflection; each viewer sees different things.
- (2025-06-26) Istyl saw a cloaked figure whose shadow detached and crawled through a window, and rows of severed bullywug heads on spikes chatting.
- (2025-06-26) Cuckoo saw a satyr in a metal cage suspended over a lake.
- (2025-06-26) Snarky saw Bavlorna bathing with miniature versions of herself.
- (2025-06-26) An earlier north-south stream did not connect to Downfall; Abbigael saw only her own reflection there.

Location: Causeway Network (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
