Parent: Brigand Territory
Description: Rickety five-foot-wide wooden walkways above the bog under a 20-foot fog bank, converging on an ivy-covered stump.

chunks.text:
Location: Ancient Battlefield (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-06-26) [unconfirmed record]
Type: flooded battlefield
Parent: Brigand Territory
Description: Shallow water littered with rusted weapons, shields and armor, with animated elven armor; an abandoned skiff was found here.

chunks.text:
Location: Soggy Court (first seen 2025-06-26, last seen 2025-08-21) [unconfirmed record]

Parent: Downfall
Description: Where bullywugs live around Bavlorna's cottage; reportedly holds her living cauldron.
- (2025-07-17) Only Soggy Court members may speak with Bavlorna, and King Gullop offered the party membership in exchange for returning a book.
- (2025-07-17) The party was fitted in court attire and received a note indicating a revolutionary resistance in the court.
- (2025-08-07) Bullywugs argued politics and ate bugs while the party visited.
- (2025-08-21) King Gullop was assassinated here and Illig crowned himself king, with the party and conspirators shouting support.
- (2025-08-21) Snarky judged most nobles cowardly but the five glaive-wielding knights dangerous.

chunks.title: Bavlorna's Cottage
chunks.text:
Location: Bavlorna's Cottage (first seen 2025-07-17, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]
Type: cottage
Parent: Downfall
Description: Wooden cottage on stilts 35 feet above the lake, built around a stone well, with a recessed pool of acidic water
- (2025-07-17) The pool water began dissolving the party's boots.
- (2025-07-17) The cottage holds a taxidermy room, a fabric storage room with two humanoid pincushions, and a dark room with a hourglass-sigil cupboard.
- (2025-07-24) The pool room has a low water level and a blocked well; Cuckoo found the blockage with plumber's tools.
- (2025-07-24) The pool room mirror is an escape route to the Witchlight Carnival via the password 'Bandersnatch'.
- (2025-07-24) The second floor has a portrait hallway of unhappy people and an emotion-stripping mirror hiding a secret shrinking hallway to the study.
- (2025-07-24) Rooms explored include a guest room with mummified pixies in shadow boxes, a dining room with rotting banquet food and goblin heads, a distillery, a kitchen, a pantry and a freezer.
- (2025-07-24) A multi-year-old wasp nest blocks the external stairway door, so the spiral staircase is the main route.
- (2025-07-24) Many frogs gathered outside and croaked loudly like an alarm.
- (2025-08-07) The party used the trapdoor hatch to enter and leave the cottage while the knights waited outside.
- (2025-08-07) The party heard footsteps from upstairs, then something heavy sinking into the pool above and an audible Wow.
- (2025-08-07) Abbigael's chromatic orb leapt through the closed door and damaged the wasp nest.

chunks.title: Bavlorna's Study

Location: Bavlorna's Study (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-07-24) [unconfirmed record]

Parent: Bavlorna's Cottage
Description: Filthy, decaying room with stained furniture and dirty dishes where Bavlorna takes tea
- (2025-07-24) The party met Bavlorna and Charm here.

Location: Secret Shrinking Hallway (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-07-24) [unconfirmed record]

Parent: Bavlorna's Cottage

- (2025-07-24) Istyl and Cuckoo shrank to mouse size in it and spied on the study; the effect lasted about one minute.

Location: Portrait Hallway (first seen 2025-07-24, last seen 2025-07-24) [unconfirmed record]

- (2025-08-07) Cookie was rapidly processing vultures here.

Parent: Bavlorna's Cottage
Description: Room with a pool of brackish water and a central well, a magical lily pad and a mirror.
- (2025-08-07) The well was unclogged and water flowed freely and overflowed into the pool.

chunks.text:

- (2025-08-07) The party sailed their skiff south to the village to search for the hunter's crate.

chunks.text:
Location: Illig's Hut (first seen 2025-08-07, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]

Parent: Southern Huts Village
Description: Hut with a solid wooden door, holding Illig, armed bullywugs and the hunting gear crate.
- (2025-08-07) A voice asked for the note under the door in Bullywug, then Common.

chunks.text:
Location: Muckstump (first seen 2025-08-07, last seen 2025-08-07) [unconfirmed record]

Description: Illig's claimed barony; the heads suspect it may not exist.

- (2025-09-18) The party arrived by balloon and landed at the edge of Thither in a healthy forest clearing.
- (2025-09-18) The party decided to head north-northeast toward Little Oak or the Wayward Pool.

chunks.text:
Location: Yon (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]

Parent: Prismere

- (2025-08-21) Contains Motherhorn citadel.
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna said Amidor the dandelion in Yon can guide travelers to the palace.
- (2025-12-06) The party reached Yon guided by Squirt.
- (2026-09-03) The party lit eight beacons around the lake in Yon to open a one-way portal home.

chunks.title: Loom Lurch
chunks.text:
Location: Loom Lurch (first seen 2025-08-21, last seen 2026-06-11) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: Loomlurch
Type: fallen oak workshop
Parent: Thither
Description: Granny Nightshade's workshop inside a gigantic fallen oak, to the north.
- (2025-08-21) The portrait Bavlorna wants hangs in plain view here.
- (2025-09-18) Nib said Granny Nightshade keeps children there making toys.
- (2025-09-18) The pixies said red caps are grown in her garden at Loomlurch.
- (2025-10-16) Cuckoo learned its layout from Will: workshop, dormitories, tin soldier barracks, textile mill, red caps quarters, creepy portrait room, garden with screaming scarecrows, and Granny Nightshade's parlor and study.
- (2025-10-30) The party scouted Loomlurch, crossing a creaky root bridge to reach the goblin market beside it.
- (2025-10-30) The party learned its thick wooden walls stop sound traveling between rooms.
- (2025-10-30) The party crossed the river on a fallen branch and reached the portrait gallery door, where a large jack-in-the-box stood and was left untouched.

- (2026-09-03) The Saltmarsh militia poured through the open gate after the party held the portcullis mechanism.
- (2026-09-03) The council planned a surface diversion while sea allies attack through the secret prison entrance.
- (2026-09-17) After opening the outer gate, the party crept invisibly past masses of Sahuagin troops heading up toward the entrance.

chunks.title: Vault of Valdush
chunks.text:
Location: Vault of Valdush (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-10-29) [unconfirmed record]

Type: sealed vault
Parent: Saltmarsh region
Description: Undersea vault reached through an archway sealed by a huge boulder, followed by flooded cave passages
Unconfirmed dates: 2026-10-29
- (2026-06-25) Zybilna told Cuckoo the vault lies somewhere in the Saltmarsh region.
- (2026-10-29) Shern guided the party to the vault's entrance on the sea floor, in a valley between two undersea cliffs south of where the ship had been. It is many miles from the Sunken Isle complex but still in the general area, close enough that Cuckoo's charm of finding picked it up.
- (2026-10-29) The entrance is an archway of placed, rune-marked stones covered in sea growth, sealed by a roughly 10-foot round boulder. The boulder is pockmarked with sucker marks that look like craters.
- (2026-10-29) A giant squid lived behind the boulder and rolled the stone out of the way with a jet of water when it left to hunt. The party killed it in combat. Afterward the stone was found back in place.
- (2026-10-29) Beyond the doorway is a mostly natural undersea cave that someone widened with picks and chisels long ago, for large creatures. It heads north, back toward Seaton and the island, and ends in a crevasse opening into a larger chamber.
- (2026-10-29) The first chamber is dark and flooded and has passages east, west and north. It held two giant lobstrosities disguised as rock formations. Cuckoo killed one; the other was bloodied.

Also known as: Trident of Command Fish
Type: trident
Holder: Istyl
Significance: Recovered as spoils of war.
Properties: Can be carried without attunement and works as a normal trident; attuned, it lets the wielder cast dominate beast (DC 15 wisdom save) using charges.
Magic: Requires attunement; Istyl is attuned
- (2026-10-01) The trident was awarded to Abbigael. [superseded 2026-10-29: The REC names Istyl as the one who attuned the trident instead of Abbigael, contradicting the award to Abbigael.]
- (2026-10-29) The party discussed attunement and Istyl chose to swap out her hat of disguise to attune to the Trident of Fish Command for the underwater journey, rather than Abbigael.
- (2026-10-29) Istyl used the Trident's dominate beast to charm a small local fish (it failed to resist) and communicated with it telepathically; the fish said a big grabber eater lived in the vault.
- (2026-10-29) Istyl cast dominate beast on the giant squid; it succeeded on its save with a 15, so it resisted.

chunks.title: Wand of Web
chunks.text:
Item: Wand of Web (first seen 2026-10-01, last seen 2026-10-29)
Type: wand
Holder: Party (stored in the bag of holding)

- (2026-10-01) The Saltmarsh council awarded the wand to Snarky.
- (2026-10-29) Nobody attuned to the Wand of Web; it was left in the bag of holding since attuning would take an hour regardless.

chunks.title: Silver Raven Figurine of Wondrous Power
names: Silver Raven Figurine of Wondrous Power
chunks.text:
Item: Silver Raven Figurine of Wondrous Power (first seen 2026-10-01, last seen 2026-10-29) [unconfirmed record]
Also known as: silver raven statuette
Type: figurine
Properties: Becomes a tiny raven for twelve hours; animal messenger delivers a message of up to 25 words, about 25 miles over its duration; it obeys commands and can scout; reverts to a statue where it is when time runs out.
Unconfirmed dates: 2026-10-29
Holder: Abbigael
- (2026-10-01) The council gave the party the silver raven figurine as a reward.
- (2026-10-29) Abbigael became keeper of the figurine; it needs no attunement. The party found Seaton is too far (about 40 leagues) for a message, and Kyle ruled it carries no reply.

chunks.title: Watch the Reeking House
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Watch the Reeking House (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2024-10-24) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Gellen pays the party 5 gp per day each to watch the Reeking House for two weeks without going inside.
Status: advanced
Linked: Gellen, Reeking House
- (2024-10-10) Gellen paid a platinum piece up front and the party took the job.
- (2024-10-10) The party killed four weasels that came from a burrow under the rosebush.
- (2024-10-10) The party heard a thudding sound like a wooden heartbeat after the fight.
- (2024-10-24) The party rescued Ned from the Reeking House while on the watch, and Islinel worried this had blown the contract.
- (2024-10-24) On day 10 the party saw a four-man rowboat head out to sea from under the cliffs and return that night laden with cargo.

chunks.title: Silver mine suspicions
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Silver mine suspicions (first seen 2024-10-10, last seen 2024-10-10) [unconfirmed record]

Status: open
Linked: Winston
- (2024-10-10) Winnie was unsure what the soldiers are for.
- (2024-10-10) Snarky overheard Winnie trade the Cant message about six guards, twice the usual.

chunks.title: Night boat under the cliffs
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Night boat under the cliffs (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: A non-seagoing boat with a crew of four rows out to sea at dusk and returns laden with cargo, vanishing under the cliffs.
Status: advanced
Linked: Gellen, Saltmarsh, Sea Ghost
- (2024-10-24) The party saw the boat row out near twilight on day 10 and could not tell where it launched; the path is not visible from Saltmarsh.
- (2024-10-24) Cuckoo saw the boat return that night fully laden with cargo and vanish under the cliffs.
- (2024-11-02) The party discussed the previous night's jolly boat ferrying mysterious cargo beneath the cliffs.
- (2024-11-02) The party found a bandit hideout in the Reeking House cellar, suggesting a link to the smuggling.
- (2024-11-22) Istyl and Abbigael spotted an overladen jolly boat heading toward Saltmarsh while on watch.
- (2024-11-22) Snarky followed the boat to Gellen Primewater's mansion and saw suspicious cargo unloaded.
- (2024-12-05) The party found a rowboat left by the smugglers in the caverns that lead to the sea.
- (2025-01-30) Fireborn and Oweland offered 500 gold for identifying the smuggling ship and 1000 gold for disabling or destroying it.
- (2025-02-23) Using Snarky's almanac findings, the party positioned themselves at the cliff ruins to intercept the smuggler's ship.
- (2025-02-23) The party spotted signal lights from a ship offshore and intercepted a coded message about a shipment.
- (2025-02-27) The party identified the smuggling ship as the Sea Ghost and reported its name and crew to Oweland.

chunks.title: Night boat under the cliffs (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Night boat under the cliffs (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2025-02-27) [unconfirmed record]
- (2025-02-27) The party was driven off the ship in combat and did not disable it.
- (2025-02-27) Eda Oweland offered a further 1000 gold if the ship is disabled.

chunks.title: Who attacked Ned
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Who attacked Ned (first seen 2024-10-24, last seen 2024-11-02) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Ned was knocked on the head and bound in the Reeking House, and Istyl thinks something is going on.
Status: advanced
Linked: Ned
- (2024-10-24) Istyl questioned Ned about the attack, but he had no further information.
- (2024-10-24) Istyl said there was something going on at the house.

chunks.title: Bandit organization
chunks.text:

Status: advanced
Linked: Hidden Cellar, Ned, Sanbalet

- (2024-11-02) Ned escaped through a hidden door to the West shouting warnings to his confederates.
- (2024-11-02) Sanbalet's notes and alchemical transaction documents were found in the study.
- (2024-11-22) The party defeated the bandit wizard Sanbalet, while Ned escaped and sounded an alarm.
- (2024-11-22) The party found a code sheet for a lantern in Sanbalet's hand.
- (2024-12-05) The Reeking House burned down, destroying the bandits' base above ground.
- (2024-12-05) The party found a smugglers' rowboat in sea caverns below the house.

- (2026-06-25) Gellen Primewater was revealed and arrested as the smuggling ringleader.

chunks.title: Find Zybilna
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Find Zybilna (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Free Zybilna from stasis.
Status: resolved
Linked: Alicorn, Matty, Prismere, Wayward Pool, Zybilna
- (2025-03-27) The unicorns told the party they need a cauldron, a unicorn horn and a poem or name for their quest.
- (2025-03-27) Matty offered a reward for proof of Zybilna's wellbeing.
- (2025-04-24) Mr. Light's rhyme tells the party to find the alicorn and free the dormant queen.
- (2025-06-19) The party learned Zybilna is frozen in time in her palace by Iggwilv's Cauldron.
- (2025-06-19) Sir Talavar knew nothing about alicorns when the party asked.
- (2025-07-17) The Darkling merchants told the party they sold an alicorn to someone in Yon, so the party learned they need to go to Yon.
- (2025-09-18) Lirian told the party a unicorn lives near the Wayward Pool.
- (2025-10-16) Lamorna told the party the alicorn was Elidon's horn stolen by the hags, and that Amidor in Yon can guide them to the palace.
- (2025-10-16) The party learned a Jabberwock occupies the Palace of Heart's Desire.
- (2025-12-06) The party chose to head to Yon and meet Amidor, postponing action against Skabitha.
- (2026-01-08) The party obtained the alicorn needed to free Zybilna.
- (2026-02-19) Charm offered to take the party to the Palace of Heart's Desire, and a belfry route was learned.
- (2026-03-19) (GMA) The party reached the palace, found guests waiting and gained entry via Wrath's crown.
- (2026-04-16) The party found Zybilna frozen in the ballroom beside the cauldron and the Jabberwock.

chunks.title: Find Zybilna (part 2)
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Find Zybilna (first seen 2025-03-27, last seen 2026-05-28) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-04-16) Cuckoo's attempts to free Zybilna by naming the cauldron Iggwilv, Tasha and Spittle Spew failed.
- (2026-04-16) Thinnings said the true name plus alicorn touch frees those frozen in time.
- (2026-05-14) The party returned from the Infinite Archive knowing how to free Zybilna.
- (2026-05-14) The party returned the black, white and green memory gems to their coffers.
- (2026-05-28) Abbigael freed Zybilna in the Grand Ballroom with the unicorn horn and her true name.

- (2026-06-11) Granny Nightshade fled to the Dreadwood and Bavlorna to the Hells.

Status: resolved
Linked: Endelyn Moongrave
- (2025-12-11) Istyl declined her ticket, distrusting fey bargains.
- (2026-01-22) Obud and Breakaleg gave the party intel on Creeping Lyn, including her fear of eclipses and the lightning rods powering her contraptions.
- (2026-01-22) Charmay fled toward Creeping Lyn and may report the party.
- (2026-02-19) The party killed Endelyn rather than meeting her in an audience.

Plot Thread: Free Fina's parents from Motherhorn (first seen 2026-01-08, last seen 2026-02-19) [unconfirmed record]

Linked: Fina, Motherhorn, Speckle-Nose, Zolt

- (2026-02-19) The party freed Glister, Hurley and Finneas's parents.

chunks.title: Unlock the palace doors with the crown

- (2026-05-28) The party found Snickersnack and Istyl attuned to it.

Linked: Zybilna

chunks.title: Saltmarsh council summons
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Saltmarsh council summons (first seen 2026-06-11, last seen 2026-06-25) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: The Saltmarsh town council urgently requests the party's counsel because the town is in great danger.
Status: resolved
Linked: Saltmarsh
- (2026-06-11) A courier met the party after their long rest at Matty's farm with the council's summons.
- (2026-06-25) The party met the council and learned of the Sahuagin threat.

chunks.title: Scout the Sunken Isle
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Scout the Sunken Isle (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-09-03) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: The council gave the party an exclusive 5,000 gold contract to map the Sunken Isle and count the Sahuagin.
Status: resolved
Linked: Sahuagin, Sunken Isle
- (2026-06-25) The party accepted the council's exclusive contract after Istyl checked the attendees for illusions with the Eyes of the Fey Queen.
- (2026-06-25) The council offered a keelboat, lizardfolk underwater guides and merfolk and Lokathah protection from predators.
- (2026-07-23) The party consulted the Saltmarsh War Council, resupplied, and set out toward the isle.
- (2026-08-06) The party explored the upper level, saw shackled laborers under guard, and went invisible past the guards toward the flooded lower levels.
- (2026-08-06) The party continued searching for the informant Sekkerin in the lower levels.
- (2026-08-20) The party mapped several lower levels and counted dozens of Sahuagin before retreating.
- (2026-08-20) Shern revealed a secret prison-cell entrance as the best route for a future infiltration.
- (2026-09-03) The party reported their findings to the Saltmarsh council and received 5,000 gold in total.

chunks.title: Seaton's suspicious safety
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Seaton's suspicious safety (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Seaton sits near the Sunken Isle yet has never been attacked, suggesting collusion or hidden dealings.
Status: advanced
Linked: Captain Thrace, Seaton, The Long Jetty
- (2026-06-25) Istyl and Cuckoo suspected Seaton's safety was suspicious, so the party detoured there before the Sunken Isle.
- (2026-06-25) The Vulgar Kraken barkeep described secretive night militia deployments.
- (2026-07-09) Dendar Cobb, Tuna, Mother Finch and soldiers described prisoners barged away from the long jetty and unnaturally bountiful fishing.
- (2026-07-09) Captain Thrace asked the party for hard evidence and arranged a secret midnight meeting.

chunks.title: Second Grin and the Vault of Valdush
names: Second Grin and the Vault of Valdush
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Second Grin and the Vault of Valdush (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-10-29) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Cuckoo seeks the scimitar Second Grin in the Vault of Valdush, which Shern has now guided the party to.
Status: advanced
Linked: Second Grin, Shern, Vault of Valdush
Unconfirmed dates: 2026-10-29
- (2026-06-25) Cuckoo asked the council about Valdush and learned of the sealed fourth level of the Sunken Isle.
- (2026-08-20) Cuckoo's charm placed Second Grin deep below and east of the stairs.
- (2026-08-20) Shern promised to lead the party to a sunken treasure, likely the Vault of Valdush.
- (2026-09-03) Cuckoo remains eager to retrieve Second Grin, rumored to be in the Sahuagin royal treasure trove. [superseded 2026-10-29: The REC places Second Grin in the Vault of Valdush, not in the Sahuagin royal treasure trove.]
- (2026-10-29) The party took a fishing boat east toward Seaton, then asked the captain to go a bit farther south; Shern needed to surface to get his bearings and judged them within a mile of the vault.
- (2026-10-29) Cuckoo carried Shern down; Shern showed an archway of rune-marked stones sealed by a 10-foot boulder with crater-like marks. Shern chose to stay behind in the muck.
- (2026-10-29) Beyond the archway the cave was lightly modified by a tool-using species, and ran north toward Seaton and the island. Kyle said it is not part of the Sunken Isle complex.

chunks.title: Second Grin and the Vault of Valdush (part 2)
names: Second Grin and the Vault of Valdush
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Second Grin and the Vault of Valdush (first seen 2026-06-25, last seen 2026-10-29) [unconfirmed record]
- (2026-10-29) Inside, a flooded chamber held rotted study remains and a locked stone door with a puzzle lock: five sockets for five-pointed stars. Thaumaturgy failed to open it, and Snarky found it unpickable.
- (2026-10-29) Lightning eels answered Abbigael's lightning spells and attacked as the session ended; the party will resume in the vault.

chunks.title: Prisoner barges from the long jetty
names: Prisoner barges from the long jetty
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Prisoner barges from the long jetty (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Prisoners are loaded onto barges at the long jetty that return empty or wet.
Status: advanced
Linked: The Long Jetty
- (2026-07-09) Abbigael and Cuckoo gathered consistent accounts from Dendar Cobb and Tuna.
- (2026-07-23) The party saw ten bound prisoners loaded onto the barge and followed it beneath the hull.

chunks.title: Midnight meeting with Captain Thrace
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Midnight meeting with Captain Thrace (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-23) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Thrace's note asks the party to meet at the northeast corner of the Market Square after midnight.
Status: resolved
Linked: Captain Thrace
- (2026-07-09) Istyl found the note in her collar after her audience with Thrace.
- (2026-07-23) Istyl, Cuckoo and Snarky met Thrace at the Market Square and learned of his spy and the corrupt officials.

chunks.title: Dendar Cobb's contract
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Dendar Cobb's contract (first seen 2026-07-09, last seen 2026-07-09) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Abbigael must arrange Dendar's transport to Saltmarsh and a stake; he owes his soul and aid.
Status: open
Linked: Dendar Cobb
- (2026-07-09) Dendar will meet the party at the Vulgar Kraken in a couple of days.

chunks.title: Operation Barnacle
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Operation Barnacle (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-08-06) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: The party clings to a prison barge's hull to infiltrate the Sunken Isle.
Status: resolved
Linked: Captain Thrace, Sunken Isle
- (2026-07-23) The party chose swimming beneath the barge over arriving as prisoners.
- (2026-07-23) The party slipped into the water and clung to the barge hull as it sped toward the Sunken Isle.
- (2026-08-06) The party rode under the barge unnoticed, dropped off at the sandbar after it left, and entered the Sunken Isle disguised as Sahuagin.

chunks.title: Kraken Priestess of Seaton
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Kraken Priestess of Seaton (first seen 2026-07-23, last seen 2026-10-29) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: A Kraken may be extending influence over the region through Deep Scions in Seaton.
Status: advanced
Linked: Deep Scions, Merva Soultide
Unconfirmed dates: 2026-10-29
- (2026-07-23) Istyl confirmed Myrva's nature with true sight.
- (2026-07-23) Erin said a Kraken Priestess implies a Kraken in the region.
- (2026-09-03) The sea peoples concluded a young Kraken is influencing Seaton's temple and seeding agents.
- (2026-09-03) The party and council considered turning the Sahuagin against the Kraken's agents but found no way to warn them.
- (2026-10-29) Istyl and Abbigael judged the boulder-moving creature was not a full-grown Kraken, but believed some Kraken is likely in the region given the Deep Scions in Seaton. It turned out to be a giant squid.
- (2026-10-29) Istyl wants to check on Seaton after the vault, and the table recalled they never learned who was behind the prison barges.

chunks.title: Assault on the Sunken Isle
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Assault on the Sunken Isle (first seen 2026-09-03, last seen 2026-10-01) [unconfirmed record]
Hook: Hold the front gate open for the Saltmarsh army while allies attack through the prison entrance, then pursue the Sahuagin royalty and treasury.
Status: resolved
Linked: Captain Eliander Fireborn, Sunken Isle
- (2026-09-03) The party cleared the gatehouse and held the portcullis open for the militia.
- (2026-09-03) The party discussed a decapitation strike on the Sahuagin royalty and looting the treasury next.
- (2026-09-17) The party decided to attempt to assassinate the Sahuagin Baron after the outer gate was opened.
- (2026-09-17) Abbigael banished the Baron and the party slew most of the creatures in the throne room.
- (2026-09-17) The Baron's mate arrived screaming for those who removed him.
- (2026-10-01) Istyl killed the Sahuagin Baroness, and with the Baron banished, the Sahuagin coordination collapsed.
- (2026-10-01) The party escaped through the magical doorway and sealed it.
- (2026-10-01) The Saltmarsh council rewarded the party with gold, magical items, free ship passage and the deed to the Primewater Estate.

chunks.title: Giant squid guarding the vault entrance
names: Giant squid guarding the vault entrance
chunks.text:
Plot Thread: Giant squid guarding the vault entrance (first seen 2026-10-29, last seen 2026-10-29)
Also known as: grabber eater
Hook: A giant squid sealed the vault entrance with a boulder; the party fought it and killed it.
Status: resolved
Linked: Vault of Valdush
- (2026-10-29) A local fish told Istyl a huge grabber eater lived in the vault and only pulled the boulder in behind itself. Istyl's Dominate Beast on the squid failed against DC 15.
- (2026-10-29) The squid grabbed and bit Istyl for 18 and 36; Istyl escaped with Misty Step. Cuckoo, Snarky, Abbigael (Rime's Binding Ice 26 cold, chromatic orb 22 lightning) and Istyl hurt it and Cuckoo finished it with Elemental Burst.

- (2024-10-10) Realized Gellen's prices were double the norm and grew suspicious.

- (2024-10-10) Killed a wounded weasel with Fire Bolt and wounded another.
- (2024-10-24) Stayed with Snarky to watch the path while the others scouted.
- (2024-11-02) Heard rattling marble sounds with Istyl.
- (2024-11-02) Tried to negotiate surrender from the top of the stairs, without success.
- (2024-11-02) Killed the wizard Sanbalet with a Firebolt.
- (2024-11-02) Hit Ned with an Eldritch Blast.
- (2024-11-22) Cast spells against the spider swarm.

- (2024-11-22) Spotted the overladen jolly boat while on watch with Istyl.

- (2025-02-27) Was healed with a potion by Istyl.
- (2025-03-14) Studied Sylvan during downtime.
- (2025-03-14) Killed a baby snake with a firebolt.

chunks.text:
Player character: Abbigael

- (2025-03-14) Revealed her three-headed dog LarryCurlyMoe at the Snapping Line.
- (2025-03-14) Accepted the deal to carry a precious pumpkin into the carnival.
- (2025-03-27) Took the first Bubble Pop Teapot ride and got a brief aerial view before her bubble popped.

- (2025-04-10) Rescued the dwarf from a potential fall on the dragonfly ride.

- (2025-04-24) Critically hit a bullywug with a firebolt.
- (2025-06-19) Confirmed with nature checks that the flooding was unnatural.
- (2025-06-19) Hit with hellish rebuke after a snake bit her.
- (2025-06-19) Became a potted plant and had about nine wild magic surges, including a modron summoning and an astral plane visit.
- (2025-06-26) Looked for visions in a still eddy of the first stream but saw only her own reflection.
- (2025-07-17) Cast Shield against a Merrow's claws, gaining resistance to all damage from a Wild Magic Surge, but was still poisoned by its bite.
- (2025-07-17) Missed with Chromatic Orb and identified the Merrows' Abyssal speech as demonic heritage.
- (2025-07-17) Tried to catch the animated coals with buckets and a quarterstaff.

Player character: Abbigael
- (2025-07-17) Cast detect magic in Bavlorna's cottage, finding the mirror (conjuration) and lily pad (transmutation) magical; a Wild Magic Surge gave everyone in 30 feet vulnerability to piercing damage.

- (2025-08-07) Wild magic surge gave her a third eye.

- (2025-08-07) Persuaded Illig's door open.
- (2025-08-21) Offered the party's services to kill King Gullop.
- (2025-08-21) Offered Illig demonic support for a soul contract and got him to sign.
- (2025-08-21) Had her luckstone's curse removed by Bavlorna.
- (2025-10-16) Calmed the owlbear with dried meat and its name.

- (2025-10-30) Demanded in Draconic that the dragon stand down.
- (2025-10-30) Cast Chromatic Orb, triggering a wild magic surge that granted teleportation for a minute, and landed a critical Firebolt.

Player character: Abbigael
- (2025-11-13) Cast flaming sphere and Grease against the tin soldiers.
- (2025-11-13) Cast Hellish Rebuke, triggering a wild magic surge that turned the party invisible.
- (2025-11-13) Persuaded Roff and Wendell to leave the sewing room.
- (2025-12-06) Created an illusion of Bavlorna to distract Skabitha.
- (2025-12-06) Chose Fireball, Counterspell, Dispel Magic and Hypnotic Pattern at level-up.
- (2025-12-11) Offered the magic wine bottle to Mudlump.
- (2025-12-11) Cast Fireball on Mudlump and triggered a wild magic lightning strike.
- (2025-12-11) Won the Heaven and Hell game for the shale side.
- (2025-12-11) Received the star sapphire from Argantle.
- (2025-12-11) Took her ticket to Endelyn.
- (2026-01-08) Sat on Mazalkoth's throne twice and fell into a trance of a dead star, gaining a fragment of his psyche and a long rest.

- (2026-01-08) Failed to counterspell a Fireball but gained a spectral shield from a wild magic surge.

- (2026-01-22) Identified goblin voices behind the rockfall by ear.

- (2026-01-22) Used Firebolt to explode the plaster king statue.
